conditions.title_ko: 핵심기술(Critical Technology) 대학원 연구 사전승인 의무
conditions.title_en: No Critical Technology Postgraduate Study/Research Change Without Approval
conditions.summary_ko: 모든 학생비자(500) 주신청자·동반가족에게 강제 부착(cl 500.611(1)(aa))되며, 비자 신청 시 이미 제출한 과정 외에 핵심기술(AI·양자·반도체 등) 관련 대학원 연구과정·논문 주제로 변경하려면 장관의 사전 서면 승인이 필요합니다.
conditions.summary_en: Mandatory on all Subclass 500 visas: you cannot switch into critical-technology postgraduate research (or its bridging course/thesis topic) not evidenced in your visa application without prior written ministerial approval.
forbidden_ko: 기존 신청서에 없던 핵심기술 관련 대학원 연구과정(Postgraduate Research)·브리징 코스·논문 주제를 장관 서면 승인 없이 시작·변경
forbidden_en: Undertaking critical-technology postgraduate research, thesis topics, or bridging courses not covered in your grant application without written approval
obligations_ko: 핵심기술 분야 석·박사 연구(연구과정/논문)로 변경 전 비자 컨디션 변경/사전 승인 절차 진행
obligations_en: Apply for written ministerial approval before switching to a critical-technology research course or thesis
exceptions_ko: (2) 비자 신청 당시 이미 증빙·신고한 학업 과정이나 연구 활동 그대로 진행하는 경우
일반 학사·수업석사(Coursework)·어학연수·VET 과정 변경(연구과정 Postgraduate Research가 아님)
exceptions_en: (2) Studying the intended course/research already evidenced in your visa application
Non-research courses (e.g., undergraduate, VET, or non-research coursework unless covered)
conditions.waiver_ko: 장관이 '원치 않는 핵심기술 이전 위험이 불합리하게 크지 않다'고 판단해 서면 승인해야 변경이 가능합니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Minister must be satisfied there is no unreasonable risk of unwanted critical technology transfer and approve in writing.

clause_notes_ko.text: 2022년 도입 후 현재는 모든 Subclass 500 주·부신청자에게 기본 부착됩니다. 다만 신청 시 제출한 연구 그대로라면((2)) 별도 승인이 필요 없습니다.
'critical technology related study'는 500.111 정의상 대학원 연구과정(postgraduate research course), 선행 브리징 코스, 연구 논문 주제를 뜻합니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Applies universally to Subclass 500 grants, but (2) exempts the study/activities already evidenced when you applied.
Defined via cl 500.111 postgraduate research courses, prerequisite bridging courses, and research thesis topics relating to critical technology.

conditions.statutory_text:
8208(1)The holder must not undertake critical technology related study unless:
(a)the Minister is satisfied that there is not an unreasonable risk of an unwanted transfer of critical technology by the holder; and
(b)the Minister has approved in writing the holder undertaking that critical technology related study.
(2)Subclause (1) does not apply in relation to the intended course of study, or activities related to study in Australia, evidenced in the holder’s visa application.
(3)In this clause:
critical technology related study means:
(a)a postgraduate research course within the meaning of clause 500.111 of Schedule 2 that relates to critical technology; or
(b)a bridging course required as a prerequisite to a course mentioned in paragraph (a); or
(c)a thesis or research topic that:
(i)is for a postgraduate research course within the meaning of clause 500.111 of Schedule 2; and
(ii)relates to critical technology.
statutory_paragraphs: 8208(1)The holder must not undertake critical technology related study unless:
(a)the Minister is satisfied that there is not an unreasonable risk of an unwanted transfer of critical technology by the holder; and
(b)the Minister has approved in writing the holder undertaking that critical technology related study.
(2)Subclause (1) does not apply in relation to the intended course of study, or activities related to study in Australia, evidenced in the holder’s visa application.
(3)In this clause:
critical technology related study means:
(a)a postgraduate research course within the meaning of clause 500.111 of Schedule 2 that relates to critical technology; or
(b)a bridging course required as a prerequisite to a course mentioned in paragraph (a); or
(c)a thesis or research topic that:
(i)is for a postgraduate research course within the meaning of clause 500.111 of Schedule 2; and
(ii)relates to critical technology.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8208 - No study change related to critical technology without approval
conditions.dha_web_summary:
If your visa is subject to condition 8208 and you started your course after 1 April 2024, you must not start critical technology related studies without the approval of the Minister of Home Affairs. If you do not comply with this condition, we may cancel your visa.
We have specified the technologies that we consider critical technology for condition 8208 and related purposes in Migration (Critical Technology – Kinds of Technology) Specification (LIN24/010) 2024.
Critical technology related study includes a:
postgraduate research course that relates to critical technology – leading to either a Masters degree (research) or doctoral degree
thesis or research topic that relates to critical technology (in a course at Masters degree (research) or doctoral degree level)
bridging course that is a prerequisite to a postgraduate research course that relates to critical technology.
Visa holders do not need approval to start a Masters by coursework.
To request approval to start a critical technology-related course in the postgraduate research sector:
Login to ImmiAccount.
Go to the ‘update details’ section.
Click on the link for ‘Change of course approval request’.
Complete the ‘Condition 8208 – Change of course approval request form’and provide any evidence we request.
The Minister will approve a request to start critical technology related study if the Minister is satisfied that there is not an unreasonable risk of an unwanted transfer of critical technology by the visa holder.
Note: Condition 8208 does not apply in relation to the intended course of study, or activities related to study in Australia, evidenced in your student visa application.
For more information see Critical technology—enhanced visa screening measures.​

conditions.title_ko: 입국 후 미이행 공익기준(PIC) 사후 충족 의무
conditions.title_en: Satisfy Outstanding Public Interest Criteria After Entry
conditions.summary_ko: 호주 입국 시점까지 미처 완료하지 못한 공익기준(건강검진·신원조회 등 PIC)을 입국 후 비자 만료 전까지 반드시 충족해야 합니다.
conditions.summary_en: After entering Australia, you must satisfy the relevant public interest criteria (e.g. deferred health/character checks) before your visa expires.
forbidden_ko: 부과된 건강·신원 등 공익기준(PIC) 이행 지시를 비자 종료 시점까지 이행하지 않고 방치
forbidden_en: Failing to complete deferred Public Interest Criteria before the visa ceases
obligations_ko: 이민성 요청 또는 입국 조건에 따라 지정 기한 내 건강검진·신원서류 제출 완료
obligations_en: Complete required medical or character clearances after entry before visa cessation
exceptions_ko: 없음
exceptions_en: None.
conditions.waiver_ko: 특수한 사정으로 입국 전 PIC 심사를 유예하고 비자를 내준 경우 적용되므로 반드시 기한 내 마무리해야 합니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Must be satisfied post-entry as directed.

clause_notes_ko.text: 주신청자 본인의 입국 후 PIC 충족 조건입니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Requires the primary holder to satisfy deferred PICs post-arrival.

conditions.statutory_text: 8301After entry to Australia, the holder must satisfy relevant public interest criteria before the visa ceases.
statutory_paragraphs: 8301After entry to Australia, the holder must satisfy relevant public interest criteria before the visa ceases.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8301 - Meet any outstanding public interest criteria
conditions.dha_web_summary: You must satisfy outstanding public interest criteria after you enter Australia and before the visa ceases.

conditions.title_ko: 입국 후 동반가족 전원 미이행 공익기준(PIC) 충족 의무
conditions.title_en: All Family Unit Members Must Satisfy PIC After Entry
conditions.summary_ko: 주신청자뿐 아니라 비자에 포함된 관련 가족 구성원 전원이 호주 입국 후 비자 종료 전까지 해당 공익기준(PIC)을 충족해야 합니다.
conditions.summary_en: All relevant members of the holder's family unit must satisfy applicable public interest criteria after entry and before the visa ceases.
forbidden_ko: 동반가족 중 일부라도 유예된 건강·신원 등 공익기준 심사를 완료하지 않는 경우
forbidden_en: Any relevant family unit member failing to satisfy required PICs before visa expiry
obligations_ko: 해당 가족 구성원 전원의 후속 PIC 심사 완료 확인
obligations_en: Ensure all relevant family members complete deferred PIC checks
exceptions_ko: 없음
exceptions_en: None.
conditions.waiver_ko: 8301의 가족 확장 조항입니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Family-unit counterpart to 8301.

clause_notes_ko.text: 8301과 달리 '관련 가족 구성원(all relevant members of the family unit)'에게 부과됩니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Places the post-entry PIC obligation on relevant family unit members.

conditions.statutory_text: 8302After entry to Australia, all relevant members of the family unit must satisfy the relevant public interest criteria before the visa ceases.
statutory_paragraphs: 8302After entry to Australia, all relevant members of the family unit must satisfy the relevant public interest criteria before the visa ceases.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8302 - Meet any outstanding public interest criteria
conditions.dha_web_summary: All members of the family unit must satisfy outstanding public interest criteria after they enter Australia and before the visa ceases.

conditions.title_ko: 호주 지역사회 교란·폭력 위협 활동 금지
conditions.title_en: Not Be Disruptive or Threaten Violence to Australian Community
conditions.summary_ko: 호주 사회 전체 또는 특정 집단에 혼란을 초래하거나 폭력적 위해를 가할 우려가 있는 행위에 관여해서는 안 됩니다(482·500·417·870 등 광범위 부착).
conditions.summary_en: You must not become involved in activities disruptive to, or violence threatening harm to, the Australian community or any group within it.
forbidden_ko: 호주 사회나 특정 집단에 대한 폭력 위협, 선동, 공공질서 교란 행위
forbidden_en: Involvement in disruptive activities or violence threatening harm to the Australian community or any group
obligations_ko: 호주 법질서 및 지역사회 안전 준수
obligations_en: Conduct yourself peacefully and lawfully within the Australian community
exceptions_ko: 합법적·평화적 표현의 자유 행사(폭력 위협이나 질서 교란에 해당하지 않는 범위)
exceptions_en: Lawful, non-disruptive civic expression
conditions.waiver_ko: 웨이버 대상이 아니며, 위반 시 공공안전·질서 사유로 즉각 비자 취소(s 116) 대상이 될 수 있습니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Cannot be waived; breach triggers s 116 cancellation powers.

clause_notes_ko.text: 482(613 재량), 500(611(2)(b) 재량), 870(강제), 070(강제) 등 수많은 비자에 폭넓게 쓰이는 핵심 품행·안전 조건입니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Broad public-order condition appearing across 482, 500, 417, 870, and bridging visas.

conditions.statutory_text: 8303The holder must not become involved in activities disruptive to, or violence threatening harm to, the Australian community or a group within the Australian community.
statutory_paragraphs: 8303The holder must not become involved in activities disruptive to, or violence threatening harm to, the Australian community or a group within the Australian community.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8303 - Not be disruptive
conditions.dha_web_summary:
You must not become involved in activities disruptive to, or violence threatening harm to, the Australian community or a group within the Australian community.
For example, engaging or promoting extremist views and interrupting the operation of the Australian community.

conditions.title_ko: 이민성 지정 일시·장소·방식 출석 보고 의무
conditions.title_en: Report at Specified Times, Places & Manner
conditions.summary_ko: 이민성 장관이 구두 또는 서면으로 지정한 일시·장소·방식(출석·전화·온라인 등)에 따라 정기 또는 수시 보고 의무를 이행해야 합니다.
conditions.summary_en: You must report to Immigration at the times, places, and manner directed orally or in writing by the Minister (exempt while in custody or inpatient hospital care under reg 2.25AF).
forbidden_ko: 지정된 출석 보고 일시·장소 무단 불출석 및 연락 두절
forbidden_en: Missing any scheduled reporting appointment or failing to report in the directed manner
obligations_ko: (a) 지정 일시 및 (b) 지정 장소·방식 엄수 (주로 050 BVE, 070 BVR)
obligations_en: Comply strictly with reporting times (a) and place/manner (b)
exceptions_ko: Note(reg 2.25AF): 체포·구금 상태이거나 병원·정신건강시설 등에 입원 치료 중인 기간에는 이 조건이 적용되지 않는 것으로 간주
exceptions_en: Note (reg 2.25AF): Condition does not apply during periods of arrest, custody, or inpatient admission at a registered hospital/mental health facility
conditions.waiver_ko: 출석 일정 변경이 불가피하면 사전에 담당 부서와 서면 조율해야 합니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Contact Immigration in advance if unable to attend.

clause_notes_ko.text: reg 2.25AF 주석에 따라 구속 또는 병원 입원 기간 동안에는 자동 적용 정지됩니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Includes statutory suspension under reg 2.25AF during custody or hospital inpatient admission.

conditions.statutory_text:
8401The holder must report:
(a)at the time or times; and
(b)at a place or in a manner;
specified, orally or in writing, by the Minister from time to time.
Note:Under regulation 2.25AF, a visa is taken to not be subject to this condition during any period in which the visa holder is:
(a)under arrest or detained in custody; or
(b)admitted as an inpatient to receive treatment at a public or private hospital, registered mental health facility or other registered medical facility.
statutory_paragraphs: 8401The holder must report:
(a)at the time or times; and
(b)at a place or in a manner;
specified, orally or in writing, by the Minister from time to time.
Note:Under regulation 2.25AF, a visa is taken to not be subject to this condition during any period in which the visa holder is:
(a)under arrest or detained in custody; or
(b)admitted as an inpatient to receive treatment at a public or private hospital, registered mental health facility or other registered medical facility.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8401 - Report at the time/s and place specified
conditions.dha_web_summary: You must report at the time/s and at a place or in the manner specified.​

conditions.title_ko: 비자 승인 5영업일 내 첫 출석 및 매주 첫 영업일 보고
conditions.title_en: Report Within 5 Working Days of Grant & Weekly Thereafter
conditions.summary_ko: 비자 승인일로부터 5영업일 이내에 이민성 사무소에 출석해 보고하고, 이후 매주 첫 영업일마다 정기 보고해야 합니다(주로 050 BVE).
conditions.summary_en: You must report to an Immigration office within 5 working days of grant and on the first working day of every subsequent week.
forbidden_ko: 첫 5영업일 내 보고 누락 또는 주간 정기 출석(매주 첫 영업일) 불이행
forbidden_en: Failing to report within 5 working days of grant or missing weekly first-working-day check-ins
obligations_ko: (a) 승인 후 5영업일 이내 첫 방문 보고
(b) 이후 매주 첫 영업일(통상 월요일, 공휴일 시 화요일)마다 반복 보고
obligations_en: (a) Report within 5 working days of grant; (b) report on the first working day of every week thereafter
exceptions_ko: 공휴일인 경우 해당 주의 첫 영업일에 출석
exceptions_en: If Monday is a public holiday, report on the next working day of that week.
conditions.waiver_ko: 8401보다 훨씬 엄격한 법정 주간 출석 조건입니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Fixed statutory reporting schedule on applicable BVE grants.

clause_notes_ko.text: 8401이 '지정된 때'라면 8402는 조문 자체가 '5영업일 내 + 매주 첫 영업일'로 못 박고 있습니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Prescribes rigid 5-working-day initial reporting and weekly attendance on the first working day.

conditions.statutory_text:
8402The holder must report:
(a)within 5 working days of grant, to an office of Immigration; and
(b)to that office on the first working day of every week after reporting under paragraph (a).
statutory_paragraphs: 8402The holder must report:
(a)within 5 working days of grant, to an office of Immigration; and
(b)to that office on the first working day of every week after reporting under paragraph (a).
conditions.dha_web_title: 8402 - Reporting requirements
conditions.dha_web_summary: You must make an appointment to report to one of our Visa and Citizenship offices within 5 working days of the grant of your visa (the initial report). After the initial report, you must report to the same office on the first working day of every week.

conditions.title_ko: 적정한 의료보험(OSHC/OVHC) 상시 유지 의무
conditions.title_en: Maintain Adequate Health Insurance (OSHC / OVHC)
conditions.summary_ko: 호주에 체류하는 전체 기간 동안 단 하루의 공백도 없이 적정한 수준의 해외 유학생 보험(OSHC) 또는 방문자·근로자 건강보험(OVHC)을 유지해야 합니다.
conditions.summary_en: You must maintain adequate health insurance (such as OSHC for students or OVHC for temporary workers/visitors) throughout your entire stay in Australia.
forbidden_ko: 호주 체류 중 의료보험 해지·만료 방치 또는 미가입 상태 체류
동반가족 포함 비자에서 일부 가족의 보험 누락
forbidden_en: Letting OSHC/OVHC lapse or cancelling cover while still in Australia
Leaving dependants covered by the visa uninsured
obligations_ko: 학생비자(500)는 전체 비자 기간을 덮는 OSHC, 482·485·600 등은 체류 기간 동안 유효한 OVHC 상시 유지
obligations_en: Keep compliant OSHC (Subclass 500) or OVHC (482/485/600 etc.) active without gaps
exceptions_ko: 호주와 상호의료협정(RHCA)이 체결된 국가 국민은 메디케어 가입 후에도 비자 승인 시 요구되는 기준 및 공백 방지 요건 확인 필요(대한민국은 호주와 RHCA 미체결 국가이므로 반드시 민간 OSHC/OVHC 유지 필요)
exceptions_en: Reciprocal Health Care Agreement (RHCA) nationals may have Medicare access, though initial grant/private cover rules depend on subclass; South Korea does not have an RHCA with Australia, so private cover is strictly required
conditions.waiver_ko: 웨이버 대상이 아니며 보험 공백이 생기면 즉시 소급·갱신 가입해야 8501 위반 리스크를 줄일 수 있습니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Cannot be waived; reinstate adequate cover immediately if a gap occurs.

clause_notes_ko.text: 한국은 호주와 상호의료협정(RHCA) 체결국이 아니므로 메디케어 대상 비자(예: 820/801 신청 후 메디케어 발급)가 아닌 한 500·482·485·방문비자 체류 중 반드시 개인 유학생/방문자 보험을 유지해야 합니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Obligation continues throughout your stay; gaps in cover breach the condition.

scenarios.q_ko: 482나 485에서 영주권을 신청해 메디케어 카드를 받았는데도 8501 때문에 OVHC를 유지해야 하나요?
scenarios.q_en: If I get Medicare after applying for PR while still holding a 482 or 485 visa, do I still need OVHC?
scenarios.a_ko: 영주권 신청으로 메디케어 자격을 취득해 실효성 있는 보장이 확보된 경우라도, 기존 임시 비자(482/485)가 살아있는 동안 이민성이 요구하는 적정 보험 기준을 충족하는지 확인한 뒤 해지 여부를 결정해야 안전합니다(특히 가족 동반 여부·구급차 보장 등).
scenarios.a_en: Holders who become eligible for Medicare upon lodging certain PR visas should carefully verify whether Medicare satisfies 'adequate arrangements' for their visa (e.g., private/ambulance exclusions or family coverage) before cancelling OVHC.

conditions.statutory_text: 8501The holder must maintain adequate arrangements for health insurance while the holder is in Australia.
statutory_paragraphs: 8501The holder must maintain adequate arrangements for health insurance while the holder is in Australia.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8501 - Maintain adequate health insurance
conditions.dha_web_summary:
You must have and maintain  adequate health insurance
for the whole of your stay in Australia.
For more information on how this condition mi​ght apply to you see
your visa details.

conditions.title_ko: 지정된 주신청자보다 먼저 호주 입국 금지
conditions.title_en: Must Not Enter Australia Before Specified Person
conditions.summary_ko: 동반가족 비자에 부과되며, 비자에 지정된 주신청자(primary visa holder)가 호주에 먼저 입국하거나 동반 입국하기 전에는 먼저 혼자 입국할 수 없습니다.
conditions.summary_en: Secondary visa holders must not arrive in Australia before the specified primary visa holder enters Australia.
forbidden_ko: 주신청자가 아직 호주에 입국하지 않은 상태에서 동반가족이 단독으로 먼저 호주 입국
forbidden_en: Entering Australia prior to the primary applicant specified on your visa grant
obligations_ko: 주신청자와 함께 입국하거나, 주신청자가 해당 비자로 호주에 먼저 입국한 것을 확인한 뒤 입국
obligations_en: Arrive with or after the specified primary visa holder
exceptions_ko: 주신청자가 이미 호주에 입국해 있거나 같은 항공편 등으로 동시 입국하는 경우
exceptions_en: Travelling together or entering after the primary holder has entered
conditions.waiver_ko: 웨이버 규정이 없으므로 주신청자보다 먼저 입국하면 공항에서 입국 거부 또는 비자 취소 사유가 됩니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Not waivable; schedule travel on or after the primary holder's entry.

clause_notes_ko.text: 309·482·491·494·189·190 등 해외 승인 동반가족에게 자주 붙으며, 주신청자보다 하루라도 일찍 도착하면 안 됩니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Prevents dependants from activating their visa ahead of the primary applicant.

conditions.statutory_text: 8502The holder of the visa must not enter Australia before the entry to Australia of a person specified in the visa.
statutory_paragraphs: 8502The holder of the visa must not enter Australia before the entry to Australia of a person specified in the visa.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8502 - Not arrive before person specified in visa
conditions.dha_web_summary: You must not enter Australia before the person specified in the visa has entered Australia. This is usually the main visa holder or other relevant person such as your sponsor in the case of a Partner visa.

conditions.title_ko: 호주 내 추가 비자 신청 전면 금지 (No Further Stay · 보호비자만 예외)
conditions.title_en: No Further Stay (Blocks Almost All Onshore Substantive Visas)
conditions.summary_ko: 호주 입국 후 호주 내에 머무르는 동안에는 보호비자(Protection Visa)를 제외한 어떠한 실질 비자도 호주 내에서 유효하게 신청할 수 없도록 막습니다.
conditions.summary_en: Once in Australia, you cannot make a valid application for any substantive visa other than a protection visa while remaining onshore, unless Condition 8503 is waived.
forbidden_ko: 호주 체류 중 8503 웨이버(면제) 승인 없이 학생(500)·파트너(820)·취업(482)·관광(600) 등 모든 실질 비자 국내 접수 금지
forbidden_en: Lodging any substantive visa onshore (other than a protection visa) without first obtaining a formal 8503 waiver
obligations_ko: 추가 비자가 필요하면 호주 출국 후 해외에서 신청하거나, 법정 사유를 갖춰 사전 서면 웨이버(reg 2.05(4)/(4AA)) 승인 확보
obligations_en: Depart Australia to apply offshore, or secure a written waiver under reg 2.05(4) or (4AA) before lodging onshore
exceptions_ko: 보호비자(Subclass 866) 신청
reg 2.05(4) 웨이버: 비자 발급 후 본인이 통제할 수 없는 중대하고 인도적·불가피한 사정(compelling and compassionate circumstances)이 발생해 상황의 중대한 변화가 생긴 경우
reg 2.05(4AA) 특례 웨이버: GSM(189/190/491)·186·191·482(SID)·494 비자 신청의 진정한 의사가 있는 경우
exceptions_en: A Protection visa application
Waiver under reg 2.05(4): compelling and compassionate circumstances developed since grant beyond your control causing a major change
Waiver under reg 2.05(4AA): genuine intention to apply for GSM (189/190/491), 186, 191, 482 (SID), or 494
conditions.waiver_ko: s 41(2A) 및 reg 2.05(4)/(4AA)에 따라 서면 웨이버 신청이 가능합니다. 단순 '연인과의 동거·결혼'만으로는 reg 2.05(4)가 쉽게 승인되지 않으므로 전문 검토가 필요합니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Waivable in writing under reg 2.05(4) (major change beyond control) or reg 2.05(4AA) (skilled/employer pathways). Merely wishing to lodge an onshore Partner visa without an uncontrollable major change often fails.

clause_notes_ko.text: 8534(485·590 허용), 8535(정부후원 학생 허용)와 달리 호주 내 예외 실질 비자가 사실상 보호비자 하나뿐인 가장 강력한 국내 신청 차단 조항입니다.
웨이버를 받더라도 이미 체류가 불법(unlawful) 상태이거나 기존 비자가 만료된 뒤라면 s 48·Schedule 3·PIC 4014가 추가로 얽힐 수 있습니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Stricter than 8534 and 8535: bars every onshore substantive visa except Protection visas while you remain in Australia.
Waiver requests must be made in writing; note reg 2.05(4AA) provides a specific waiver ground for genuine skilled/employer visa intentions.

conditions.drift_ko: ⚡ 2026년 11월 28일 시행 개정(F2026L01503): 2026.11.28 이후 접수되는 Subclass 600(일반 관광·상용 포함)·601(ETA)·651(eVisitor) 비자에도 Condition 8503이 재량이 아닌 '강제 부착(mandatory)'으로 전환됩니다(2026.11.27까지 접수분은 기존 규정 적용).
conditions.drift_en: ⚡ 28 Nov 2026 Reform (F2026L01503): For applications lodged on or after 28 Nov 2026, Condition 8503 becomes MANDATORY across Subclass 600 (Tourist & Business Visitor), 601 (ETA), and 651 (eVisitor).

scenarios.q_ko: 관광비자(600)나 ETA(601)에 8503이 붙었는데 호주에서 파트너 비자(820)를 바로 신청할 수 있나요?
scenarios.q_en: My Visitor/ETA visa has 8503—can I lodge an onshore Partner (820) visa?
scenarios.a_ko: 웨이버가 먼저 승인되지 않으면 ImmiAccount에서도 신청 자체가 불가능하거나 무효 신청(invalid application)이 됩니다. 파트너 비자는 reg 2.05(4AA) 면제 대상이 아니므로, 통제 불가한 중대한 사정 변화(reg 2.05(4), 예: 중증 질환·출산 불가피 사정·호주 내 긴급 위기 등)로 웨이버를 받거나 출국 후 309로 신청해야 합니다.
scenarios.a_en: No, unless 8503 is waived first. Partner visas are not listed in reg 2.05(4AA), so you must either qualify for a reg 2.05(4) waiver (compelling/compassionate circumstances beyond your control) or apply offshore (Subclass 309).

conditions.statutory_text: 8503The holder will not, after entering Australia, be entitled to be granted a substantive visa, other than a protection visa, while the holder remains in Australia.
statutory_paragraphs: 8503The holder will not, after entering Australia, be entitled to be granted a substantive visa, other than a protection visa, while the holder remains in Australia.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8503 - No further stay
conditions.dha_web_summary:
While you are in Australia, you are unable to make a valid visa application for any new
substantive visa, with limited exceptions.
conditions.dha_web_scenario:
Condition 8503 is mandatory on the:
Visitor visa (subclass 600) Sponsored Family stream
Visitor visa (subclass 600) Approved Destination Scheme stream
Visitor visa (subclass 600) Tourist stream, if we required you to be sponsored for the visa​
​You can ask us to
waive the condition if there is a major change in your circumstances.​

conditions.title_ko: 최초 입국 기한 (Initial Entry Date) 준수 의무
conditions.title_en: Must Make First Entry Before Specified Date
conditions.summary_ko: 해외에서 비자를 승인받은 경우 승인 통지서에 명시된 'Must not arrive after / Initial entry date' 이전에 반드시 호주에 첫 입국을 해야 합니다.
conditions.summary_en: If granted offshore, you must enter Australia for the first time as the visa holder before the specified initial entry date.
forbidden_ko: 승인서에 지정된 최초 입국 마감일(Initial Entry Date)을 넘겨 입국 시도
forbidden_en: Allowing the specified initial arrival deadline to pass without first entering Australia
obligations_ko: 비자 승인 통지서(Grant Notice)에 적힌 최초 입국 기한 내 호주 입국 완료 (단기 방문 입국 포함)
obligations_en: Make first entry to Australia before the date specified in your grant notice
exceptions_ko: 조문상 자동 예외는 없으나, 기한 내 입국이 불가한 불가피한 사유(예: 출산·의료·국경 통제)가 있을 때는 기한 경과 전 이민성에 사전 통보·조치 확인 필요
exceptions_en: No automatic statutory exception; if unforeseen emergencies prevent arrival, seek urgent confirmation from Home Affairs before expiry
conditions.waiver_ko: 정당한 사유 없이 최초 입국일을 넘기면 조건 위반(s 116 비자 취소 사유)이 되어 비자가 취소될 수 있습니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Missing the initial entry date is a breach exposing the visa to s 116 cancellation.

clause_notes_ko.text: 주로 189·190·491·309·100·143 등 해외 승인 이민/임시비자에 적용됩니다(일부는 8504 번호 대신 Schedule 2에 동일 문구로 직접 규정됨).

clause_notes_en.text: Failure to make initial entry by the grant-letter date creates cancellation exposure even for permanent visas granted offshore.

conditions.statutory_text: 8504The holder must enter Australia as the holder of the visa to which the condition applies before a date specified by the Minister.
statutory_paragraphs: 8504The holder must enter Australia as the holder of the visa to which the condition applies before a date specified by the Minister.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8504 - Initial entry date
conditions.dha_web_summary: You must enter Australia before the date specified in your grant letter.

conditions.title_ko: 비자 승인 전 신고한 주소지 계속 거주 의무
conditions.title_en: Continue to Live at Pre-Grant Specified Address
conditions.summary_ko: 비자 승인 전에 이민성에 신고한 호주 내 거주지 주소에서 계속 거주해야 합니다(주로 050 BVE, 070 BVR).
conditions.summary_en: You must continue to reside at the residential address you specified to Immigration before the visa was granted.
forbidden_ko: 사전 주소 변경 신고 없이 지정 주소지에서 임의로 이사·퇴거
forbidden_en: Moving away from your pre-grant notified address without following advance notification rules
obligations_ko: 신고한 주소지에 실거주 유지 (주소 변경 시 8506 등과 연동해 사전 신고 필수)
obligations_en: Reside at the address specified prior to visa grant
exceptions_ko: 연동된 8506·8625 규정에 따라 적법하게 새 주소를 신고한 경우
exceptions_en: Where an address change is properly notified under applicable reporting conditions
conditions.waiver_ko: 050 브리징 비자 E 및 070 BVR 등에 부과되는 거주지 고정 조건입니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Strict residence condition on bridging visas such as 050 and 070.

clause_notes_ko.text: 8506(변경 2영업일 전 사전 신고)과 세트로 부과되는 경우가 많습니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Frequently paired with Condition 8506 (2 working days advance notice of address change).

conditions.statutory_text: 8505The holder must continue to live at the address specified by the holder before grant of the visa.
statutory_paragraphs: 8505The holder must continue to live at the address specified by the holder before grant of the visa.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8505 - Continue to live at specified address
conditions.dha_web_summary: You must continue to live at the address you specified before we granted you the visa.

conditions.title_ko: 주소 변경 시 최소 2영업일 전 사전 신고 의무
conditions.title_en: Notify Address Change at Least 2 Working Days in Advance
conditions.summary_ko: 거주지 주소를 바꿀 경우 이사 후가 아니라 변경 발생 최소 2영업일 전에 미리 이민성에 통지해야 합니다.
conditions.summary_en: You must notify Immigration at least 2 working days BEFORE any change in your residential address.
forbidden_ko: 먼저 이사한 뒤 사후에 주소 변경 신고 (사전 신고 위반)
forbidden_en: Moving first and notifying Immigration afterwards
obligations_ko: 주소 변경 최소 2영업일 전까지 이민성에 새 주소 통지
obligations_en: Lodge address change notice at least 2 working days prior to moving
exceptions_ko: 없음
exceptions_en: None.
conditions.waiver_ko: 491/494의 8578(변경 후 14일)과 달리 '사전(in advance)' 신고 의무이므로 기한 계산에 각별히 주의해야 합니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Unlike 8578 (14 days after), 8506 requires advance notice before moving.

clause_notes_ko.text: BVE(050) 등에서 이민성 연락망 유지를 위해 엄격히 적용됩니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Advance-notice rule common on BVE (050) visas.

conditions.statutory_text: 8506The holder must notify Immigration at least 2 working days in advance of any change in the holder’s address.
statutory_paragraphs: 8506The holder must notify Immigration at least 2 working days in advance of any change in the holder’s address.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8506 - Notify us of your new address
conditions.dha_web_summary:
If you change your address, you must notify us at least 2 working days before this change occurs.
See what to do if
your contact details have changed.

conditions.title_ko: 이민 구금(Detention) 비용 납부 또는 분할약정 의무
conditions.title_en: Pay or Arrange Payment of Immigration Detention Costs
conditions.summary_ko: 이민 구금시설 수용 기간 중 발생한 구금 비용을 지정 기한 내에 전액 납부하거나 장관이 수락하는 납부 약정을 체결해야 합니다.
conditions.summary_en: Within the specified period, pay or make a satisfactory arrangement with the Minister to pay your immigration detention costs.
forbidden_ko: 지정 기한 내 구금 비용 납부·약정 불이행
forbidden_en: Ignoring detention cost recovery notices past the specified due date
obligations_ko: (a) 구금 비용 완납 또는 (b) 장관이 만족할 수 있는 분할 납부 약정 체결
obligations_en: Pay detention costs (a) or maintain an approved payment arrangement (b)
exceptions_ko: 없음
exceptions_en: None.
conditions.waiver_ko: 주로 이민 구금에서 석방되며 발급되는 BVE(050)에 부과됩니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Common on BVE (050) visas granted upon release from detention.

clause_notes_ko.text: Migration Act Part 2 Division 10상 구금 비용(costs of detention) 상환 의무입니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Covers detention debt under Part 2 Division 10 of the Act.

conditions.statutory_text:
8507The holder must, within the period specified by the Minister for the purpose:
(a)pay; or
(b)make an arrangement that is satisfactory to the Minister to pay;
the costs (within the meaning of Division 10 of Part 2 of the Act) of the holder’s detention.
statutory_paragraphs: 8507The holder must, within the period specified by the Minister for the purpose:
(a)pay; or
(b)make an arrangement that is satisfactory to the Minister to pay;
the costs (within the meaning of Division 10 of Part 2 of the Act) of the holder’s detention.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8507 - Pay the costs of your detention
conditions.dha_web_summary: You must pay, or make an arrangement to pay, the costs of your detention, within the period specified by the Minister. The Minister must be satisfied with the arrangement made.

conditions.title_ko: 지정 기한 내 호주 내 승인 가능 비자 유효 신청 의무
conditions.title_en: Make a Valid Application for an Eligible Onshore Visa Within Time
conditions.summary_ko: 이민성 장관이 정한 기간 내에 호주에서 승인이 가능한 비자 종류를 선택해 적법한 유효 신청(valid application, s 46)을 접수해야 합니다.
conditions.summary_en: Within the specified timeframe, make a valid application (s 46) for a visa of a class that can be granted in Australia.
forbidden_ko: 지정 기한 내 유효한 비자 신청 미접수 또는 요건 미비로 무효 처리
forbidden_en: Missing the specified deadline or lodging an invalid application
obligations_ko: 지정 기한 내 s 46 요건(서식·수수료·국내 신청 가능 비자군)을 모두 맞춘 유효 신청 완료
obligations_en: Lodge a legally valid onshore visa application within the specified period
exceptions_ko: 조문 Note: 'valid application'은 반드시 승인된다는 뜻이 아니라 s 46상 형식적 접수 요건을 갖춘 유효 신청을 의미
exceptions_en: Statutory note: 'valid application' refers to formal validity under s 46 rather than guaranteed grant.
conditions.waiver_ko: 050 BVE 보유자에게 출국 준비 대신 국내 비자 신청 유예를 줄 때 부여됩니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Attached to BVE grants issued to allow lodgement of an onshore substantive visa.

clause_notes_ko.text: s 46상 유효 신청 요건(서명·수수료·국내 신청 자격)을 놓치면 8508 위반이 됩니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Highlights statutory note referencing Migration Act s 46 validity requirements.

conditions.statutory_text:
8508The holder must make a valid application for a visa of a class that can be granted in Australia, within the time specified by the Minister for the purpose.
Note:For the meaning of valid application see s 46 of the Act. Broadly, a valid application is one that is formally in order for consideration, not necessarily one that can be granted.
statutory_paragraphs: 8508The holder must make a valid application for a visa of a class that can be granted in Australia, within the time specified by the Minister for the purpose.
Note:For the meaning of valid application see s 46 of the Act. Broadly, a valid application is one that is formally in order for consideration, not necessarily one that can be granted.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8508 - Make valid visa application
conditions.dha_web_summary:
You must make a valid application for a visa within the timeframe we specify.
The visa must be one that can be granted to you while you are in Australia.

conditions.title_ko: 비자 승인 5영업일 내 실질 비자 신청 또는 출국 항공권 제시
conditions.title_en: Apply for Substantive Visa or Show Departing Ticket Within 5 Working Days
conditions.summary_ko: 비자 승인일로부터 5영업일 이내에 (a) 실질 비자를 유효하게 신청하거나 (b) 입국 가능한 제3국·본국행 출국 항공권을 제시해야 합니다.
conditions.summary_en: Within 5 working days of visa grant, either lodge a valid substantive visa application or show an acceptable outbound travel ticket.
forbidden_ko: 승인일 후 5영업일 이내 아무 조치(비자 접수 또는 항공권 제시) 없이 경과
forbidden_en: Letting 5 working days pass post-grant without lodging a substantive visa or presenting an outbound ticket
obligations_ko: 승인일 기준 5영업일 내 (a) 실질 비자 유효 신청 또는 (b) 출국 티켓 제출
obligations_en: Within 5 working days: lodge a valid substantive visa (a) OR show a valid outbound ticket (b)
exceptions_ko: 없음
exceptions_en: None.
conditions.waiver_ko: 단기 출국 준비용 BVE(050)에 주로 붙으며 기한이 매우 짧습니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Strict 5-working-day deadline on applicable BVE visas.

clause_notes_ko.text: 050 BVE 승인 직후 5영업일 카운트가 즉시 시작됩니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Two compliance options within 5 working days of grant.

conditions.statutory_text:
8509Within 5 working days after the date of grant, the holder must:
(a)make a valid application for a substantive visa; or
(b)show an officer a ticket for travel to a country other than Australia that the Minister is satisfied will allow the holder to enter on his or her arrival.
statutory_paragraphs: 8509Within 5 working days after the date of grant, the holder must:
(a)make a valid application for a substantive visa; or
(b)show an officer a ticket for travel to a country other than Australia that the Minister is satisfied will allow the holder to enter on his or her arrival.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8509 - Apply for a substantive visa or show ticket
conditions.dha_web_summary:
Within 5 working days of grant, the you must:
make a valid application for a substantive visa, or
show us a ticket for travel to a country, other than Australia, that the Minister is satisfied will allow you to enter that country on your arrival.

conditions.title_ko: 유효 여권 제시 또는 여권 발급 절차 이행 의무
conditions.title_en: Show Valid Passport or Satisfactory Passport Arrangements
conditions.summary_ko: 장관이 정한 기간 안에 유효한 여권을 담당관에게 제시하거나, 여권을 발급받기 위한 납득할 만한 조치를 취해야 합니다.
conditions.summary_en: Within the specified timeframe, present a valid passport or make satisfactory arrangements to obtain one.
forbidden_ko: 여권 미보유 상태에서 기한 내 여권 발급 신청·협조 불이행
forbidden_en: Failing to show a valid passport or take genuine steps to obtain one within time
obligations_ko: (a) 유효 여권 제시 또는 (b) 대사관 발급 신청 등 만족스러운 조치 증빙
obligations_en: Present a current passport (a) or arrange passport issuance (b) within the set period
exceptions_ko: 없음
exceptions_en: None.
conditions.waiver_ko: 주로 출국 준비용 BVE(050)에서 여행서류 확보를 위해 부과됩니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Standard identity/travel-document compliance condition on BVE.

clause_notes_ko.text: 여권 만료자나 무여권 상태의 BVE 소지자에게 적용됩니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Requires valid passport production or bona fide procurement steps.

conditions.statutory_text:
8510Within the time specified by the Minister for the purpose, the holder must, either:
(a)show an officer a passport that is in force; or
(b)make an arrangement satisfactory to the Minister to obtain a passport.
statutory_paragraphs: 8510Within the time specified by the Minister for the purpose, the holder must, either:
(a)show an officer a passport that is in force; or
(b)make an arrangement satisfactory to the Minister to obtain a passport.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8510 - Show valid passport or make arrangements to apply for a passport
conditions.dha_web_summary:
Within a specified time you must either:
show us a current passport, or
make a satisfactory arrangement to get a passport

conditions.title_ko: 지정 기한 내 입국 가능 국가행 출국 항공권 제시 의무
conditions.title_en: Show Acceptable Outbound Travel Ticket Within Specified Time
conditions.summary_ko: 장관이 정한 기간 내에 호주를 떠나 입국이 허용되는 국가로 향하는 확정 항공권을 담당관에게 제시해야 합니다.
conditions.summary_en: Within the specified time, show an officer a ticket to travel to a country other than Australia where you will be permitted entry.
forbidden_ko: 기한 내 확정 출국 항공권 미제시 또는 입국 불가 경유지 티켓 제출
forbidden_en: Failing to present an onward ticket to an admissible country within the specified timeframe
obligations_ko: 입국이 허용되는 국가로의 유효 항공권 기한 내 제시
obligations_en: Present a confirmed ticket to a destination permitting your entry
exceptions_ko: 없음
exceptions_en: None.
conditions.waiver_ko: 050 BVE 출국 목적 조건입니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Departure-compliance condition on BVE.

clause_notes_ko.text: 단순 가예약이 아닌 실제 입국 가능한 목적지 항공권을 요구합니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Destination country must satisfy the Minister that entry will be allowed.

conditions.statutory_text: 8511Within the time specified by the Minister for the purpose, the holder must, show an officer a ticket for travel to a country other than Australia that the Minister is satisfied will allow the holder to enter on his or her arrival.
statutory_paragraphs: 8511Within the time specified by the Minister for the purpose, the holder must, show an officer a ticket for travel to a country other than Australia that the Minister is satisfied will allow the holder to enter on his or her arrival.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8511 - Show ticket
conditions.dha_web_summary: Within a time frame we specify, you must show us a ticket for travel to a country, other than Australia, that we are satisfied will allow you to enter that country on your arrival.

conditions.title_ko: 장관이 지정한 날짜까지 호주 출국 의무
conditions.title_en: Depart Australia by Specified Date
conditions.summary_ko: 장관이 별도로 지정한 날짜(specified date)가 지나기 전에 반드시 호주를 떠나야 합니다.
conditions.summary_en: You must leave Australia on or before the date specified by the Minister for that purpose.
forbidden_ko: 지정된 출국 기한 도과 후 호주 잔류
forbidden_en: Remaining in Australia past the specified departure date
obligations_ko: 지정 기한 내 출국 완료
obligations_en: Depart Australia by the specified date
exceptions_ko: 지정 기한 전에 다른 유효 비자를 승인받거나 이민성과 기한 조정이 확정된 경우
exceptions_en: Grant of another visa or formal variation before the specified date
conditions.waiver_ko: 8531(비자 체류기간 만료 전 출국)과 달리 별도 통지된 특정일까지 출국해야 하는 조건입니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Enforces departure by an individually specified deadline.

clause_notes_ko.text: 주로 출국 유예용 BVE(050)에서 사용됩니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Common on departure-basis BVE visas.

conditions.statutory_text: 8512The holder must leave Australia by the date specified by the Minister for the purpose.
statutory_paragraphs: 8512The holder must leave Australia by the date specified by the Minister for the purpose.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8512 - Depart by specified date
conditions.dha_web_summary: You must leave Australia by a specified date.

conditions.title_ko: 비자 승인 5영업일 이내 거주지 주소 신고 의무
conditions.title_en: Notify Residential Address Within 5 Working Days of Grant
conditions.summary_ko: 비자가 승인된 날로부터 5영업일 이내에 본인의 호주 내 거주지 주소를 이민성에 통지해야 합니다(주로 070 BVR·050 BVE).
conditions.summary_en: You must notify Immigration of your residential address within 5 working days of visa grant.
forbidden_ko: 비자 승인 후 5영업일이 지나도록 거주지 미신고
forbidden_en: Failing to report your residential address within 5 working days of grant
obligations_ko: 승인일로부터 5영업일 내 실제 거주 주소 등록 완료
obligations_en: Provide residential address to Immigration within 5 working days
exceptions_ko: 없음
exceptions_en: None.
conditions.waiver_ko: 070 BVR의 경우 이후 주소 변경은 8625(2영업일 내)와 연동됩니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Initial address notice on 070/050; subsequent changes are typically governed by 8506 or 8625.

clause_notes_ko.text: 8505·8620 등과 함께 070 BVR 필수 조건 중 하나입니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Initial 5-working-day residential notification rule.

conditions.statutory_text: 8513The holder must notify Immigration of his or her residential address within 5 working days of grant.
statutory_paragraphs: 8513The holder must notify Immigration of his or her residential address within 5 working days of grant.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8513 - Notify immigration of your residential address
conditions.dha_web_summary:
You must tell us where you live within 5 working days of the grant of your visa.
You can tell us through your
ImmiAccount or complete and submit
Form 929 - Change of address and/or passport details (PDF).

conditions.title_ko: 비자 승인 근거 사정의 중대한 변동 금지
conditions.title_en: No Material Change in Visa Grant Circumstances
conditions.summary_ko: 비자 기간 동안 최초 비자 승인의 기초가 되었던 핵심 사정(관계·초청·상태 등)에 중대한 변동(material change)이 발생해서는 안 됩니다.
conditions.summary_en: During the visa period, there must be no material change in the circumstances on the basis of which the visa was granted.
forbidden_ko: 비자 승인 전제가 된 사실관계·자격 근거의 본질적 상실 또는 중대한 변경 방치
forbidden_en: Material alteration in the factual basis supporting the visa grant
obligations_ko: 비자 발급 근거가 된 핵심 사정 유지 (변동 시 즉시 이민성 통보 또는 대안 검토)
obligations_en: Maintain the circumstances underpinning the grant
exceptions_ko: 사소한 비본질적 변화는 제외되나 '중대한 변경(material change)' 해당 시 위반 위험
exceptions_en: Only material changes to the grant basis breach the condition.
conditions.waiver_ko: 8516(자격 요건 계속 충족)과 비슷하나 '사실관계의 중대한 변동 금지'에 초점을 둔 조항입니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Focuses on preventing material factual changes to the basis of grant (compare 8516).

clause_notes_ko.text: 070 BVR(강제) 및 050 BVE 등에 부과됩니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Mandatory on 070 BVR and discretionary on several other subclasses.

conditions.statutory_text: 8514During the visa period of the visa, there must be no material change in the circumstances on the basis of which it was granted.
statutory_paragraphs: 8514During the visa period of the visa, there must be no material change in the circumstances on the basis of which it was granted.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8514 - No material change in circumstances
conditions.dha_web_summary: During the visa period there must be no material change in the circumstances on which we based grant of your visa.

conditions.title_ko: 호주 입국 전 결혼 또는 사실혼 관계 개시 금지 (동반자녀 등)
conditions.title_en: Must Not Marry or Enter a De Facto Relationship Before Entry
conditions.summary_ko: 해외에서 비자를 승인받은 후 호주에 최초 입국하기 전까지 결혼하거나 사실혼(de facto) 관계를 맺어서는 안 됩니다(주로 미혼 자녀·부양가족 조건).
conditions.summary_en: You must not marry or enter into a de facto relationship between visa grant and your first entry into Australia.
forbidden_ko: 비자 승인 후 호주 첫 입국 전에 혼인신고, 결혼식 또는 사실혼 동거 개시
forbidden_en: Marrying or commencing a de facto relationship before activating the visa by entering Australia
obligations_ko: 미혼·독립 가족 구성원 자격을 입국 시점까지 그대로 유지한 채 최초 입국 완료
obligations_en: Remain single / outside a de facto relationship until after entering Australia
exceptions_ko: 호주에 최초 입국(활성화)을 마친 뒤에는 8515 적용 종료 (일부 비자 제외)
exceptions_en: Applies strictly before entry into Australia; does not govern conduct after arrival
conditions.waiver_ko: 영주권(189/190/101/309 등)이나 491/494/485 해외 승인 부양자녀에게 붙는 경우가 많아 입국 전 혼인 시 비자가 취소될 수 있습니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Breach before entry can result in cancellation under s 116 even for permanent dependent visas.

clause_notes_ko.text: 부양자녀가 해외에서 비자를 받은 뒤 입국하기 전에 결혼·동거를 시작하면 '부양가족' 요건 붕괴로 보고 입국 시 문제가 됩니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Common discretionary/conditional condition on offshore-granted dependants across skilled, family, and permanent visas.

scenarios.q_ko: 부모와 함께 영주권(190/186 등)이나 491을 해외에서 받은 자녀가 호주 입국 전에 결혼하면 어떻게 되나요?
scenarios.q_en: What happens if a dependent child granted a 190/491 offshore marries before arriving in Australia?
scenarios.a_ko: 8515 위반으로 s 116 비자 취소 대상이 됩니다. 반드시 입국 전 혼인·사실혼 여부를 확인해야 하며, 사정 변경 시 입국 전 별도 법률 검토가 필요합니다.
scenarios.a_en: Marrying or starting a de facto relationship before first entry breaches Condition 8515 and exposes the visa to cancellation under s 116.

conditions.statutory_text: 8515The holder of the visa must not marry or enter into a de facto relationship before entering Australia.
statutory_paragraphs: 8515The holder of the visa must not marry or enter into a de facto relationship before entering Australia.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8515 - Must not marry or enter into a de facto relationship before entry
conditions.dha_web_summary:
You must not marry or enter into a de facto relationship before entering Australia.
See what to do if your contact details have changed.
We might cancel your visa if we find out you were engaged, married or in a de facto relationship before we granted you the visa but did not tell us.

conditions.title_ko: 비자 승인 당시의 자격 요건 계속 충족 의무
conditions.title_en: Continue to Satisfy Visa Grant Criteria
conditions.summary_ko: 비자를 받은 뒤에도 처음 비자 승인을 받기 위해 충족했던 주신청자 또는 동반가족 자격 요건(예: 재정능력·학생 진정성·동반가족 관계 등)을 계속 유지해야 합니다.
conditions.summary_en: You must continue to be a person who would satisfy the primary or secondary criteria for the grant of the visa.
forbidden_ko: 비자 승인 후 관계 파탄(동반가족), 재정·학업 전제 붕괴 등 최초 승인 기준을 더 이상 충족하지 못하는 상태
forbidden_en: Ceasing to meet the primary or secondary grant criteria (e.g., relationship breakdown for dependants without notifying)
obligations_ko: 비자 보유 기간 내내 승인 기준(관계·연수·자격 등) 지속 충족
obligations_en: Maintain ongoing compliance with all grant criteria throughout the visa period
exceptions_ko: 일부 비자의 동반가족 결별·가정폭력 특례 등은 별도 비자 절차(예: 820/801)로 구제 검토 가능
exceptions_en: Specific legislative exceptions (such as family violence provisions on Partner visas) operate under separate visa rules rather than waiving 8516
conditions.waiver_ko: 학생비자(500) 전원과 500 동반가족에게 강제 부착됩니다. 특히 학생 주신청자와 동반배우자가 별거·이혼해 '가족 구성원(member of family unit)' 요건이 깨지면 8516 위반으로 배우자 비자가 취소될 수 있습니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Mandatory on Subclass 500 primary and secondary holders. If a student dependant separates permanently from the primary student, 8516 is breached.

clause_notes_ko.text: 학생비자에서 가장 광범위하게 취소(s 116) 사유로 인용되는 조항 중 하나입니다. 예: 처음엔 대학 학사 과정으로 500을 받았으나 요건 미달 상태로 전락하거나 동반가족 관계가 종료된 경우.

clause_notes_en.text: Broad ongoing-eligibility condition mandatory on Student 500 (primary & secondary) and Guardian 590 visas.

conditions.statutory_text: 8516The holder must continue to be a person who would satisfy the primary or secondary criteria, as the case requires, for the grant of the visa.
statutory_paragraphs: 8516The holder must continue to be a person who would satisfy the primary or secondary criteria, as the case requires, for the grant of the visa.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8516 - Continue to satisfy the criteria for the grant of the visa
conditions.dha_web_summary: You must continue to satisfy the criteria for the grant of the visa.

conditions.title_ko: 동반 학령기 자녀(만 5~17세) 적정 교육 유지 의무
conditions.title_en: Maintain Adequate Education for School-Age Dependants
conditions.summary_ko: 학생비자(500) 주신청자가 동반가족 비자로 호주에 3개월 초과 체류하는 학령기 자녀를 두고 있다면, 해당 자녀가 학교 교육을 계속 받을 수 있도록 등록·학비 등 적정한 조치를 유지해야 합니다.
conditions.summary_en: Primary Student visa holders must maintain adequate schooling arrangements for any school-age dependant in Australia for more than 3 months on a dependant student visa.
forbidden_ko: 3개월 이상 호주에 체류하는 동반 학령기 자녀를 학교에 등록하지 않거나 학비 미납 등으로 제적 상태 방치
forbidden_en: Leaving a school-age dependant in Australia for over 3 months without active school enrolment/arrangements
obligations_ko: 자녀의 주립·사립학교 등록 및 학업 유지 (학생비자 주신청자 의무)
obligations_en: Keep school-age dependants enrolled in school throughout stays exceeding 3 months
exceptions_ko: 호주 체류 기간이 3개월 이하인 단기 방문 자녀 또는 학령기 이전/이후 자녀
exceptions_en: Dependants staying 3 months or less, or outside school age
conditions.waiver_ko: 모든 Subclass 500 주신청자에게 강제 부착(cl 500.611(1)(a))되며, 주별 공립학비 면제 여부도 미리 확인해야 합니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Mandatory on all primary Subclass 500 visas.

clause_notes_ko.text: 주신청자 부모에게 부과되는 자녀 교육 유지 의무이고, 실제 자녀 본인 비자에는 8518이 붙습니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Imposed on the primary parent holder; the school-age dependant receives 8518.

conditions.statutory_text: 8517The holder must maintain adequate arrangements for the education of any schoolage dependant of the holder who is in Australia for more than 3 months as the holder of a student visa (as a person who has satisfied the secondary criteria).
statutory_paragraphs: 8517The holder must maintain adequate arrangements for the education of any schoolage dependant of the holder who is in Australia for more than 3 months as the holder of a student visa (as a person who has satisfied the secondary criteria).
conditions.dha_web_title: 8517 - Maintain adequate arrangements for the education of your school-age dependants
conditions.dha_web_summary:
You must maintain adequate arrangements for the education of your school-age dependants who are in Australia for more than 3 months as a dependant on your visa.
For the full list of conditions relevant to your visa, see the Federal Register of Legislation.

conditions.title_ko: 만 18세 미만 동반학생 본인 교육 조치 유지 의무
conditions.title_en: Maintain Adequate Education Arrangements for Under-18 Dependant
conditions.summary_ko: 학생비자 동반가족 중 만 18세 미만 자녀 비자에 직접 부과되는 조건으로, 호주 체류 중 적정한 교육(학교 등록 등)이 계속 유지되어야 합니다.
conditions.summary_en: Imposed on under-18 Student visa dependants (cl 500.612(1)(b)): adequate arrangements must be maintained for the child's education while in Australia.
forbidden_ko: 만 18세 미만 동반가족이 호주 체류 중 정당한 사유 없이 학교 교육에서 이탈
forbidden_en: Under-18 dependant remaining in Australia without adequate education arrangements
obligations_ko: 호주 체류 기간 동안 연령에 맞는 정규 학교 등록·출석 유지
obligations_en: Maintain valid schooling arrangements while in Australia
exceptions_ko: 미취학 아동(유아기) 등은 해당 주 교육 기준에 따른 적정 돌봄·교육 확인
exceptions_en: Assessed by age-appropriate schooling requirements in the relevant state/territory.
conditions.waiver_ko: cl 500.612(1)(b)에 따라 만 18세 미만 학생 동반가족에게 강제 부착됩니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Mandatory for under-18 secondary Subclass 500 applicants.

clause_notes_ko.text: 부모의 8517과 짝을 이루는 만 18세 미만 동반자녀 본인의 의무 조항입니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Counterpart to 8517 placed directly on the under-18 secondary student visa.

conditions.statutory_text: 8518Adequate arrangements must be maintained for the education of the holder while he or she is in Australia.
statutory_paragraphs: 8518Adequate arrangements must be maintained for the education of the holder while he or she is in Australia.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8518 - Maintain adequate arrangements for your education
conditions.dha_web_summary:
You must maintain adequate arrangements for your education while you are in Australia.
See what to do if there are
changes to your study situation.

conditions.title_ko: 약혼비자(300) 유효기간 내 약혼자와 혼인 완료 의무 (주신청자)
conditions.title_en: Marry Fiancé Within Visa Period (Subclass 300 Primary)
conditions.summary_ko: 약혼비자(Prospective Marriage Subclass 300) 주신청자는 비자 유효기간이 끝나기 전에 스폰서(약혼자)와의 법적 혼인을 반드시 완료해야 합니다.
conditions.summary_en: Primary Subclass 300 (Prospective Marriage) holders must enter into the intended marriage within the visa period.
forbidden_ko: 비자 만료일까지 약혼자와 결혼하지 않은 채 체류하거나 타인과 결혼
forbidden_en: Allowing the Subclass 300 visa period to expire without marrying the sponsoring fiancé
obligations_ko: 유효기간(통상 9~15개월) 내 법적 혼인식·혼인신고 완료 (이후 파트너 비자 820 연계)
obligations_en: Complete the legal marriage to your sponsor before the visa expires
exceptions_ko: 혼인이 무산됐더라도 가정폭력·공동자녀 등 파트너 비자 예외 요건 해당 여부는 별도 상담 필요
exceptions_en: Specific Partner visa breakdown exceptions (e.g., family violence) are assessed separately under Subclass 820 criteria
conditions.waiver_ko: 약혼비자(300)의 존재 목적 자체이므로 연장이나 단순 웨이버가 어렵습니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Core purpose of Subclass 300.

clause_notes_ko.text: 8520(동반자녀 등)과 달리 약혼비자 주신청자 본인에게 적용됩니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Applies to the primary Subclass 300 fiancé visa holder.

conditions.statutory_text: 8519The holder must enter into the marriage in relation to which the visa was granted within the visa period of the visa.
statutory_paragraphs: 8519The holder must enter into the marriage in relation to which the visa was granted within the visa period of the visa.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8519 - Marry your partner while the visa is valid
conditions.dha_web_summary:
You must marry the person specified in your visa application while your visa is valid.
Tell us if there is a
change to your situation.

conditions.title_ko: 약혼비자(300) 주신청자의 기한 내 혼인 의무 (동반가족 연동)
conditions.title_en: Primary Subclass 300 Holder Must Marry Within Visa Period (Dependant Link)
conditions.summary_ko: 약혼비자(300) 동반가족(예: 동반자녀) 비자에 부과되는 조건으로, 주신청자가 약혼비자 기간 내에 스폰서와 결혼해야 함을 전제합니다.
conditions.summary_en: Imposed on Subclass 300 secondary holders: requires that the primary Subclass 300 holder enters into the marriage within the visa period.
forbidden_ko: 주신청자가 비자 기간 내 스폰서와 혼인하지 못함
forbidden_en: Primary Subclass 300 holder failing to marry within the visa period
obligations_ko: 주신청자의 기한 내 법적 혼인 완료 확인
obligations_en: Ensure the primary Subclass 300 holder marries within the visa period
exceptions_ko: 없음
exceptions_en: None.
conditions.waiver_ko: 동반가족 비자 효력이 주신청자의 혼인 성사 여부에 연동됩니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Ties secondary holder's compliance to the primary holder marrying in time.

clause_notes_ko.text: 8519가 주신청자용, 8520이 동반가족용입니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Secondary-applicant counterpart to 8519.

conditions.statutory_text: 8520The relevant person who holds a Subclass 300 visa on the basis of having satisfied the primary criteria must enter into the marriage in relation to which that visa was granted within the visa period of that visa.
statutory_paragraphs: 8520The relevant person who holds a Subclass 300 visa on the basis of having satisfied the primary criteria must enter into the marriage in relation to which that visa was granted within the visa period of that visa.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8520 - Marry your partner while the visa is valid
conditions.dha_web_summary: If you are the primary holder of a subclass 300 (Prospective Marriage) visa you must marry the person specified in your visa application before your visa ceases.

conditions.title_ko: 주신청자 출국 시점보다 늦지 않게 호주 출국 의무
conditions.title_en: Must Leave Australia No Later Than Primary Holder
conditions.summary_ko: 동반가족(secondary) 비자에 부과되며, 주신청자가 호주를 떠날 때 함께 떠나거나 그보다 먼저 출국해야 하고 주신청자 출국 후 혼자 남을 수 없습니다.
conditions.summary_en: Dependants must depart Australia no later than when the primary visa holder departs.
forbidden_ko: 주신청자가 출국한 뒤 동반가족만 호주에 계속 남아 있는 행위
forbidden_en: Remaining in Australia after the primary holder departs
obligations_ko: 주신청자와 동시 또는 그 이전에 출국
obligations_en: Leave Australia on or before the primary holder's departure
exceptions_ko: 별도 유효 비자를 취득한 경우 외 예외 없음
exceptions_en: Requires holding another visa permitting independent stay.
conditions.waiver_ko: 주로 단기 동반 비자·임시 비자에 재량 부과됩니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Discretionary condition on selected temporary dependant grants.

clause_notes_ko.text: 8523(학생 주신청자에게 부과해 동반가족을 데리고 나가도록 하는 조항)과 방향이 정반대입니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Placed on the dependant, whereas 8523 places the duty on the primary student holder.

conditions.statutory_text:
8522The holder must leave Australia not later than the time of departure of the person:
(a)who has satisfied the primary criteria; and
(b)of whose family unit the holder is a member.
statutory_paragraphs: 8522The holder must leave Australia not later than the time of departure of the person:
(a)who has satisfied the primary criteria; and
(b)of whose family unit the holder is a member.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8522 - Must leave Australia with or before the primary visa holder
conditions.dha_web_summary:
You must leave Australia with or before the
member of your family unit who satisfied the primary criteria for grant of the visa.
For the full list of conditions relevant to your visa, see the Federal Register of Legislation.

conditions.title_ko: 학생 주신청자 출국 시 동반 배우자·자녀 동반 출국 의무
conditions.title_en: Student's Dependant Family Must Depart No Later Than Student
conditions.summary_ko: 학생비자 주신청자가 출국할 때 그 비자에 연계된 동반 배우자·미성년 자녀도 주신청자보다 늦지 않게 호주를 떠나야 합니다.
conditions.summary_en: Requires each secondary-criteria spouse, partner, or unmarried under-18 child holding a student visa to leave no later than the primary student holder.
forbidden_ko: 주신청자 학생만 귀국하고 동반 가족을 호주에 남겨두는 행위
forbidden_en: Leaving secondary-criteria student dependants behind in Australia after the primary student departs
obligations_ko: 주신청자 출국 시 동반 가족도 함께 출국하거나 사전에 독립 비자 전환
obligations_en: Ensure dependants depart with or before you
exceptions_ko: 없음
exceptions_en: None.
conditions.waiver_ko: 8522와 짝을 이루는 조항입니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Paired with 8522.

clause_notes_ko.text: 구형·특정 학생 섹터 규정에서 유래한 동반 출국 조건입니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Applies to spouse/partner and unmarried under-18 children holding dependant student visas.

conditions.statutory_text:
8523Each person who:
(a)is a member of the family unit of the holder (being a spouse or de facto partner of the holder or an unmarried child of the holder who has not turned 18); and
(b)has satisfied the secondary criteria; and
(c)holds a student visa because of paragraphs (a) and (b);
must leave Australia not later than the time of departure of the holder.
statutory_paragraphs: 8523Each person who:
(a)is a member of the family unit of the holder (being a spouse or de facto partner of the holder or an unmarried child of the holder who has not turned 18); and
(b)has satisfied the secondary criteria; and
(c)holds a student visa because of paragraphs (a) and (b);
must leave Australia not later than the time of departure of the holder.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8523 - Must leave Australia with or before the primary visa holder
conditions.dha_web_summary:
Members of the family unit must leave Australia with or before the primary visa holder.
For the full list of conditions relevant to your visa, see the Federal Register of Legislation.

conditions.title_ko: 지정된 교통수단·기일·기간 내 호주 출국 의무
conditions.title_en: Leave Australia by Specified Transport & Date/Period
conditions.summary_ko: 비자에 지정된 특정 교통편과 날짜·기간 내에 반드시 호주를 떠나야 합니다.
conditions.summary_en: You must leave Australia by the specified means of transport on the specified day or within the specified period.
forbidden_ko: 지정된 운송수단(선박·항공 등)이나 날짜를 어기고 출국 지연
forbidden_en: Failing to depart by the specified transport and date
obligations_ko: 지정 교통편 및 출국 기일 엄수
obligations_en: Depart using the specified transport and timeframe
exceptions_ko: 없음
exceptions_en: None.
conditions.waiver_ko: 승무원·특수 단기 입국 등에서 주로 재량 부과됩니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Used where strict departure logistics are attached.

clause_notes_ko.text: 단순 만료일 출국(8531)을 넘어 출국 수단과 특정 일시를 지정하는 조항입니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Specifies both transport mode and departure deadline.

conditions.statutory_text: 8525The holder must leave Australia by a specified means of transport on a specified day or within a specified period.
statutory_paragraphs: 8525The holder must leave Australia by a specified means of transport on a specified day or within a specified period.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8525 - Must leave Australia on the date specified
conditions.dha_web_summary:
You must leave Australia:
on the date or within the period specified in your visa grant letter
by the transport specified in your grant letter

conditions.title_ko: 비자 만료 전 7일 이내 캔버라 이민성 본부 우편 주소 신고
conditions.title_en: Post Residential Address Notice to ACT Central Office Before Expiry
conditions.summary_ko: 비자 효력이 종료되기 7일 전부터 만료 당일 사이에 호주 내 거주지 주소를 캔버라(ACT) 이민성 본부로 서면 우편 통지해야 합니다.
conditions.summary_en: Between 7 days before visa cessation and the day it ceases, post written notice of your Australian residential address to Immigration's ACT Central Office.
forbidden_ko: 만료 7일 이전 조기 발송하거나 만료일 도과 후 미발송
forbidden_en: Failing to post the written address notice within the 7-day window prior to visa cessation
obligations_ko: 비자 만료 7일 전~만료일 당일 사이 ACT 본부 우편 발송 (만료 전 이미 출국 또는 새 비자 취득 여부 확인)
obligations_en: Post written notification to the ACT Central Office during the 7-day pre-cessation window
exceptions_ko: 비자 종료 7일 전 이전에 이미 출국해 효력이 다한 특수 경우 등 사안별 확인 필요
exceptions_en: Check whether a subsequent visa or early departure superseded the notice window.
conditions.waiver_ko: 과거 종이 우편 기반의 오래된 Schedule 8 조항이지만 현행 417·기타 비자 재량 목록에도 남아 있으므로 부과 여부를 승인서에서 확인해야 합니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Legacy postal reporting clause still listed as discretionary on several subclasses.

clause_notes_ko.text: 이메일/온라인이 아니라 'ACT Central Office로의 우편(posting)'을 명시한 고전 조문입니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Specifically mandates posting written notice to the ACT Central Office.

conditions.statutory_text: 8526The holder must notify the Secretary in writing, not earlier than 7 days before the day the visa ceases to be in effect, and not later than that day, of the holder’s place of residence in Australia by posting the notification to the Central Office of Immigration in the Australian Capital Territory.
statutory_paragraphs: 8526The holder must notify the Secretary in writing, not earlier than 7 days before the day the visa ceases to be in effect, and not later than that day, of the holder’s place of residence in Australia by posting the notification to the Central Office of Immigration in the Australian Capital Territory.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8526 - Let us know where you are living in Australia
conditions.dha_web_summary:
You must notify the Department in writing of your place of residence in Australia, 7 days before the visa ceases. You must post the notification to the Central Office of Immigration in the
Australian Capital Territory.
Complete and submit
Form 929 - Change of address and/or passport details (PDF).
For the full list of conditions relevant to your visa, see the Federal Register of Legislation.

conditions.title_ko: 출발·입국 시 결핵(Tuberculosis) 비감염 의무
conditions.title_en: Free From Tuberculosis at Travel and Entry
conditions.summary_ko: 호주로 출발하는 시점 및 호주 입국 시점에 활동성 결핵(TB)이 없어야 합니다(ETA 601 · eVisitor 651 · 600 일부 등 강제 부착).
conditions.summary_en: You must be free from tuberculosis at the time you travel to and enter Australia (mandatory on ETA 601 and eVisitor 651).
forbidden_ko: 결핵 감염 상태에서 호주행 항공편 탑승 또는 입국 시도
forbidden_en: Travelling to or entering Australia while infected with tuberculosis
obligations_ko: 입국 전 건강 상태 확인 (결핵 이력·증상이 있는 경우 ETA/601 대신 사전 검진이 포함된 Subclass 600 등으로 신청)
obligations_en: Ensure TB-free status before travelling; apply for a visa with health clearance if any TB history exists
exceptions_ko: 없음
exceptions_en: None.
conditions.waiver_ko: ETA(601)를 간편히 받은 뒤 결핵 치료 중 입국하면 공항에서 즉시 8527 위반으로 비자 취소 및 입국 거부될 수 있습니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Breach can result in immediate cancellation at the border.

clause_notes_ko.text: 601 ETA와 651 eVisitor에 사전 건강검진 없이 자동 부여되는 핵심 보건 조건입니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Mandatory border-entry health condition on Subclasses 601 and 651.

conditions.statutory_text: 8527The holder must be free from tuberculosis at the time of travel to, and entry into, Australia.
statutory_paragraphs: 8527The holder must be free from tuberculosis at the time of travel to, and entry into, Australia.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8527 - Must be free from Tuberculosis
conditions.dha_web_summary: You must be free from tuberculosis when you travel to and enter Australia.

conditions.title_ko: 합산 12개월 이상 징역형 전과 보유자 입국 금지 (ETA 601 · 651)
conditions.title_en: No Criminal Convictions Totalling 12+ Months Sentence at Travel/Entry
conditions.summary_ko: 호주 출발·입국 시점에 실형 복역 여부(집행유예 포함)를 불문하고 선고 형기 합계가 12개월 이상인 형사 전과가 있어서는 안 됩니다(ETA 601 · eVisitor 651 강제).
conditions.summary_en: At travel and entry, you must not have one or more criminal convictions whose total sentence(s)—whether served or suspended—equal 12 months or more.
forbidden_ko: 집행유예·가석방·미복역 형을 포함해 합산 형기 12개월 이상 전과자가 ETA(601) 또는 eVisitor(651)로 입국
forbidden_en: Travelling to or entering Australia on an ETA (601) or eVisitor (651) with sentences totalling 12+ months (even if suspended/unserved)
obligations_ko: 해당 전과가 있다면 ETA(601) 신청 대신 범죄경력 심사가 진행되는 일반 관광비자(Subclass 600)로 사전 정식 심사 신청
obligations_en: Declare convictions honestly and apply for a Subclass 600 Visitor visa instead of an ETA if you have any 12+ month sentence history
exceptions_ko: 없음 (ETA 신청 시 '어떠한 범죄 유죄판결도 없어야' 질문에 허위 체크 시 PIC 4020 및 입국 거부 별도 발생)
exceptions_en: No exemption on 601/651; also beware false declarations triggering s 101 / PIC 4020.
conditions.waiver_ko: 한국에서 '징역 O월, 집행유예 O년'을 받은 경우 '집행유예라 안 살았으니 괜찮다'고 착각해 ETA로 입국했다가 공항에서 입국 거부되는 대표적 함정입니다.
conditions.waiver_en: 'Whether served or not' catches suspended sentences—a classic border trap for ETA travellers.

clause_notes_ko.text: 조문 괄호 안 'whether served or not(실제 복역 여부와 무관)' 때문에 집행유예(suspended sentence)도 형기 계산에 그대로 합산됩니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Explicitly counts total sentences 'whether served or not', capturing suspended sentences.

conditions.statutory_text: 8528The holder must not have one or more criminal convictions, for which the sentence or sentences (whether served or not) are for a total period of 12 months duration or more, at the time of travel to, and entry into, Australia.
statutory_paragraphs: 8528The holder must not have one or more criminal convictions, for which the sentence or sentences (whether served or not) are for a total period of 12 months duration or more, at the time of travel to, and entry into, Australia.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8528 - Have no criminal convictions for which sentence is 12 months or more
conditions.dha_web_summary:
You must not have any criminal convictions for which the sentences total 12 months or more, whether or not you have served the sentences.
Tell us if there is a
change to your situation.

conditions.title_ko: 호주 입국 후 지정 의사 건강검진 및 흉부 X-ray 검사 의무
conditions.title_en: Undergo Post-Arrival Medical Examination & Chest X-Ray
conditions.summary_ko: 호주 입국 후 연방의료관(MOC) 또는 지정 의사의 신체검사와 방사선과 전문의의 흉부 X-ray 검사를 받아야 합니다.
conditions.summary_en: After entering Australia, you must undergo an official medical examination and a chest x-ray (unless exempt due to age under 11 or certified pregnancy).
forbidden_ko: 입국 후 지정 검진 미이행
forbidden_en: Failing to complete post-entry medical and chest x-ray examinations
obligations_ko: (a) 지정 의료기관 건강검진 및 (b) 호주 내 방사선과 전문의 흉부 X-ray 실시
obligations_en: Complete designated medical check (a) and chest x-ray (b) post-arrival
exceptions_ko: (b)(i) 만 11세 미만 아동 (MOC 별도 요청 없는 경우 X-ray 면제)
(b)(ii) 임신 확인 + 주 보건당국 결핵 검사·서약 완료로 MOC가 X-ray 유예를 승인한 임산부
exceptions_en: (b)(i) Children under 11 unless requested by a MOC
(b)(ii) Confirmed pregnant women under State/Territory chest clinic supervision where deferral is approved
conditions.waiver_ko: 입국 전 건강검진 대신 입국 후 추적 검진을 조건으로 비자를 승인할 때 사용됩니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Health-follow-up condition for post-entry clearance.

clause_notes_ko.text: 만 11세 미만 및 임산부에 대한 X-ray 면제 요건이 상세히 적혀 있습니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Details age-based (<11) and pregnancy carve-outs from chest x-rays.

conditions.statutory_text:
8529The holder must, after entering Australia:
(a)undergo a medical examination carried out by:
(i)a Commonwealth Medical Officer; or
(ii)a medical practitioner approved by the Minister; or
(iii)a medical practitioner employed by an organisation approved by the Minister; and
(b)undergo a chest xray examination conducted by a medical practitioner who is qualified as a radiologist in Australia, unless the holder:
(i)is under 11 years of age and is not a person in respect of whom a Commonwealth Medical Officer has requested such an examination; or
(ii)is a person:
(A)who is confirmed by a Commonwealth Medical Officer to be pregnant; and
(B)who has been examined for tuberculosis by a chest clinic officer employed by a health authority of a State or Territory; and
(C)who has signed an undertaking to place herself under the professional supervision of a health authority in a State or Territory and to undergo any necessary treatment; and
(D)whom the Minister is satisfied should not be required to undergo a chest xray examination at this time.
statutory_paragraphs: 8529The holder must, after entering Australia:
(a)undergo a medical examination carried out by:
(i)a Commonwealth Medical Officer; or
(ii)a medical practitioner approved by the Minister; or
(iii)a medical practitioner employed by an organisation approved by the Minister; and
(b)undergo a chest xray examination conducted by a medical practitioner who is qualified as a radiologist in Australia, unless the holder:
(i)is under 11 years of age and is not a person in respect of whom a Commonwealth Medical Officer has requested such an examination; or
(ii)is a person:
(A)who is confirmed by a Commonwealth Medical Officer to be pregnant; and
(B)who has been examined for tuberculosis by a chest clinic officer employed by a health authority of a State or Territory; and
(C)who has signed an undertaking to place herself under the professional supervision of a health authority in a State or Territory and to undergo any necessary treatment; and
(D)whom the Minister is satisfied should not be required to undergo a chest xray examination at this time.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8529 - Must have medical examination and chest x-ray
conditions.dha_web_summary:
After entering Australia, you must:
have a medical examination by an approved medical practitioner
You do not need a chest x-ray if:
you are under 11 years old and a Commonwealth Medical Officer has not requested a chest x-ray, or a Commonwealth Medical Officer has confirmed that you are pregnant, and
you have been examined for tuberculosis by a chest clinic officer, and
you have signed an undertaking to place yourself under the professional supervision of a health authority to have any necessary treatment, and
we are satisfied you don’t need to have a chest x-ray at this time.
See
how to arrange a medical examination.

conditions.title_ko: 승인된 단체 관광 일정 이탈 금지 (ADS 스트림)
conditions.title_en: Must Not Deviate From Organised Tour (ADS)
conditions.summary_ko: 승인된 단체관광(Approved Destination Status, Subclass 600.252) 비자로 입국한 경우 정해진 단체 투어 일정에서 이탈할 수 없습니다.
conditions.summary_en: You must not deviate from the organised tour arrangements under Subclass 600 ADS stream (cl 600.252).
forbidden_ko: 지정 단체 투어 팀에서 이탈해 개별 행동·잠적
forbidden_en: Leaving or deviating from the approved ADS tour group
obligations_ko: 전 일정 지정 여행사·가이드 인솔 투어 동행
obligations_en: Stay with the approved organised tour throughout your stay
exceptions_ko: 없음
exceptions_en: None.
conditions.waiver_ko: Subclass 600 ADS 스트림 필수 조건(cl 600.614)입니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Mandatory on Subclass 600 Approved Destination Status stream.

clause_notes_ko.text: 8101·8207·8503과 함께 600 ADS 스트림에 강제 부착됩니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Mandatory for ADS group tourists under cl 600.614.

conditions.statutory_text: 8530The holder must not deviate from the organised tour referred to in clause 600.252 of Schedule 2.
statutory_paragraphs: 8530The holder must not deviate from the organised tour referred to in clause 600.252 of Schedule 2.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8530 - Must follow your approved tour arrangements
conditions.dha_web_summary:
You must follow the travel schedule set by your travel agent. You can’t go anywhere that is not part of your tour.

conditions.title_ko: 허용 체류기간 만료 후 불법 잔류 금지 (Must Leave Before Expiry)
conditions.title_en: Must Not Remain After Permitted Period of Stay Ends
conditions.summary_ko: 비자에 허용된 체류기간이 종료된 이후 호주 내에 머물러서는 안 됩니다(관광 초청 스트림 600·임시부모 870 등에 강제).
conditions.summary_en: You must not remain in Australia after the end of the stay period permitted by the visa (mandatory on Sponsored Family 600 & 870).
forbidden_ko: 비자 허용 체류기간 만료 이후 오버스테이(불법체류)
forbidden_en: Staying in Australia after the permitted period of stay expires
obligations_ko: 허용 체류만료일 이전 출국 또는 만료 전 합법적인 후속 비자 접수/승인 확보 (8503 없는 경우)
obligations_en: Depart before your permitted stay period ends
exceptions_ko: 새 실질 비자를 적법하게 신청해 유효한 브리징 비자가 발효된 경우(단, 8531+8503이 함께 붙은 600 초청 스트림 등은 국내 신청 자체가 차단되므로 만료 전 출국 필수)
exceptions_en: Note: where paired with 8503 (e.g., Sponsored Family 600), onshore renewal is barred so departure before expiry is mandatory.
conditions.waiver_ko: 초청 관광(600.612)에서 8531을 어기고 오버스테이하면 향후 초청인의 스폰서 보증금 몰수 및 초청 자격 제한(12개월+ 등)으로 이어질 수 있습니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Breach on Sponsored Family 600 can forfeit security bonds and penalise the Australian sponsor.

clause_notes_ko.text: 단순 일반 비자 만료(불법체류)를 넘어 조건 위반으로 기록되어 추후 비자·보증금 심사에서 불이익을 줍니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Turns overstay into a formal visa condition breach affecting future sponsorship/bonds.

conditions.statutory_text: 8531The holder must not remain in Australia after the end of the period of stay permitted by the visa.
statutory_paragraphs: 8531The holder must not remain in Australia after the end of the period of stay permitted by the visa.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8531 - Must leave before visa expiry
conditions.dha_web_summary: 8531 - Must leave before visa expiry: The holder must not remain in Australia after the end of the period of stay permitted by the visa.

conditions.title_ko: 만 18세 미만 유학생 숙소·복지 승인 유지 및 조기 입국 금지
conditions.title_en: Under-18 Student Welfare & Accommodation Arrangements
conditions.summary_ko: 만 18세 미만 학생비자(500) 소지자는 부모/적격 친척과 동거하거나, 교육기관(또는 국방·외교부)이 승인한 숙소·복지(CAAW) 체계가 개시되는 날 이후에만 입국·체류해야 합니다.
conditions.summary_en: Student visa holders under 18 must live with a parent/custodian/approved 21+ relative, OR keep provider/Minister-approved welfare arrangements (CAAW) and not enter Australia before the nominated welfare start date.
forbidden_ko: 교육기관 CAAW(복지 승인)에 명시된 복지 개시일보다 먼저 호주 입국
부모·지정 친척이나 승인된 홈스테이·기숙사에서 무단 이탈
forbidden_en: Arriving in Australia before your education provider's nominated CAAW welfare start date
Changing accommodation or leaving approved care without guardian/provider sign-off
obligations_ko: (a) 부모·보호자·만 21세 이상 지정 친척과 거주 OR (b)/(c)/(d) 학교·장관의 숙소·지원·복지 승인 유지 및 시작일 준수
obligations_en: Maintain approved living/welfare arrangements (a)–(d) and respect the nominated arrival start date
exceptions_ko: 만 18세 생일이 지나 성인이 되면 해당 보호 연령 조건 적용 종료
exceptions_en: Ceases to apply once the student turns 18.
conditions.waiver_ko: 모든 500 주신청자에게 강제 부착(cl 500.611(1)(a))되지만 실제 조문은 '만 18세 미만인 경우(If the holder has not turned 18)'에만 작동합니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Mandatory on Subclass 500 grants, but applies operationally only while under 18.

clause_notes_ko.text: 미성년 조기유학생이 CAAW 개시일 하루 전에 입국하면 비자 조건 위반으로 공항에서 문제가 생깁니다. 반드시 CAAW 시작일 이후 항공권을 발권해야 합니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Strictly bars entry before the CAAW commencement date nominated by the school.

conditions.statutory_text:
8532If the holder has not turned 18:
(a)the holder must stay in Australia with a person who is:
(i)a parent of the holder or a person who has custody of the holder; or
(ii)a relative of the holder who:
(A)is nominated by a parent of the holder or a person who has custody of the holder; and
(B)has turned 21; and
(C)is of good character; or
(b)the arrangements for the holder’s accommodation, support and general welfare must be approved by the education provider for the course to which the holder’s visa relates, and the holder must not enter Australia before the day nominated by the education provider as the day on which those arrangements are to commence; or
(c)in the case that the holder is a Defence student—both:
(i)the arrangements for the holder’s accommodation, support and general welfare must be approved by the Defence Minister; and
(ii)the holder must not enter Australia before the day those arrangements are to commence; or
(d)in the case that the holder is a Foreign Affairs student—both:
(i)the arrangements for the holder’s accommodation, support and general welfare must be approved by the Foreign Minister; and
(ii)the holder must not enter Australia before the day those arrangements are to commence.
statutory_paragraphs: 8532If the holder has not turned 18:
(a)the holder must stay in Australia with a person who is:
(i)a parent of the holder or a person who has custody of the holder; or
(ii)a relative of the holder who:
(A)is nominated by a parent of the holder or a person who has custody of the holder; and
(B)has turned 21; and
(C)is of good character; or

(b)the arrangements for the holder’s accommodation, support and general welfare must be approved by the education provider for the course to which the holder’s visa relates, and the holder must not enter Australia before the day nominated by the education provider as the day on which those arrangements are to commence; or
(c)in the case that the holder is a Defence student—both:
(i)the arrangements for the holder’s accommodation, support and general welfare must be approved by the Defence Minister; and
(ii)the holder must not enter Australia before the day those arrangements are to commence; or
(d)in the case that the holder is a Foreign Affairs student—both:
(i)the arrangements for the holder’s accommodation, support and general welfare must be approved by the Foreign Minister; and
(ii)the holder must not enter Australia before the day those arrangements are to commence.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8532 - Maintaining welfare arrangements for minors
conditions.dha_web_summary:
If you are younger than 18 years of age, you must have  accommodation and support, and your general welfare must be maintained for the duration
To maintain your welfare, you must stay in Australia with:
your parent or legal custodian or
a relative who has been nominated by your parents or custodians who is aged over 21 and is of good character or
have accommodation, support and general welfare arrangements in place that have been approved by your education provider
You must not change your arrangements without the written approval of your education provider. If your welfare arrangements are approved by your education provider you must not travel to Australia until your welfare arrangements start
