conditions.title_ko: 학교에 주소(7일) 및 학교 변경(새 CoE 수령 후 7일) 통보 의무
conditions.title_en: Notify Education Provider of Address & Provider Changes Within 7 Days
conditions.summary_ko: 모든 학생비자(500) 주신청자 의무 조건으로, 입국 후 7일 내·이사 후 7일 내 호주 거주지를 학교에 알리고, 학교를 옮길 경우 새 CoE(또는 입학증명)를 받은 날로부터 7일 내에 기존 학교에 알려야 합니다.
conditions.summary_en: Mandatory on Subclass 500: notify your education provider of your Australian address within 7 days of arrival or any address change, and notify your current provider within 7 days of receiving a new CoE/enrolment evidence.
forbidden_ko: 이사 후 7일 초과 주소 미신고
타 학교 새 CoE 발급 후 7일 내 기존 학교 통지 누락
forbidden_en: Failing to report arrival/address changes within 7 days
Failing to notify your existing provider within 7 days of receiving a new CoE
obligations_ko: (a) 해외 승인 시 입국 후 7일 내 주소 통지
(b)(i) 주소 변경 후 7일 내 통지
(b)(ii) 편입·전학 시 새 CoE 수령 7일 내 기존 학교 통지
obligations_en: Notify provider within 7 days of arrival (a), address change (b)(i), or new CoE receipt (b)(ii)
exceptions_ko: 없음
exceptions_en: None.
conditions.waiver_ko: 이민성 ImmiAccount가 아니라 '교육기관(education provider)'에 통지해야 하는 의무입니다(이민성 연락처 갱신도 별도 권장).
conditions.waiver_en: Must be notified directly to the education provider (separate from updating ImmiAccount).

clause_notes_ko.text: 이민성이 연락을 취할 때 학교에 등록된 주소를 쓰는 경우가 많아, 주소 미갱신 시 중요한 통지서를 놓치는 원인이 됩니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Ensures education providers hold current address and transfer records.

conditions.statutory_text:
8533The holder must:
(a)in the case of a holder who was outside Australia when the visa was granted, notify the education provider of the holder’s residential address in Australia within 7 days after arriving in Australia; and
(b)in all cases:
(i)notify the education provider of any change in the holder’s residential address in Australia within 7 days after the change occurs; and
(ii)notify his or her current education provider of a change of education provider within 7 days after the holder receives:
(A)a confirmation of enrolment from the new education provider; or
(B)if no confirmation of enrolment is required to be sent, or if a failure of electronic transmission has prevented an education provider from sending a confirmation of enrolment—evidence that the applicant has been enrolled by the new education provider.
statutory_paragraphs: 8533The holder must:

(a)in the case of a holder who was outside Australia when the visa was granted, notify the education provider of the holder’s residential address in Australia within 7 days after arriving in Australia; and
(b)in all cases:
(i)notify the education provider of any change in the holder’s residential address in Australia within 7 days after the change occurs; and
(ii)notify his or her current education provider of a change of education provider within 7 days after the holder receives:
(A)a confirmation of enrolment from the new education provider; or

(B)if no confirmation of enrolment is required to be sent, or if a failure of electronic transmission has prevented an education provider from sending a confirmation of enrolment—evidence that the applicant has been enrolled by the new education provider.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8533 - Inform provider of address
conditions.dha_web_summary:
You must let your education provider know your residential  address within 7 days of arriving in Australia if you were outside Australia when your visa was granted.
If your residential address changes you must let your education provider know within 7 days after the change.
Notify your current education provider that​ you have changed your education provider within 7 days of receiving:
a confirmation of enrolment from your new education provider, or
evidence you have been enrolled by the new education provider
We will contact you through your school. If you don’t update your contact details we won’t be able to contact you.
See the Regulation

conditions.title_ko: 호주 내 추가 비자 제한 (485·590·보호비자 및 수료 후 웨이버 예외)
conditions.title_en: No Further Stay — Student/Guardian (Permits 485, 590, Protection & Post-Course Waiver)
conditions.summary_ko: 학생(500)·가디언(590) 비자에 붙으며 호주 내 추가 비자 발급을 제한하지만, 8503과 달리 졸업생 비자(485)·학생가디언(590)·보호비자는 호주 내 신청이 허용되며 코스 수료 후에는 482·186·189·190·491·494 신청을 위한 웨이버(reg 2.05(5A))도 가능합니다.
conditions.summary_en: Restricts onshore grants while in Australia EXCEPT Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate), Subclass 590 (Student Guardian), and Protection visas; plus reg 2.05(5A) allows waiver after course completion for 482, 186, 189, 190, 491, 494.
forbidden_ko: 예외 비자(485·590·보호비자) 및 적법한 8534 웨이버 승인 없이 호주 내 다른 비자(예: 500 재연장·820 파트너 등) 진행
forbidden_en: Seeking onshore grants other than 485/590/Protection without first obtaining an 8534 waiver
obligations_ko: 졸업 후 485 신청 시 온라인 제한이 걸리는 경우 서면·절차 안내 확인, 스폰서·기술이민 진행 시 코스 수료 후 reg 2.05(5A) 웨이버 신청
obligations_en: Check lodgement pathway for 485 or request a reg 2.05(5A) waiver upon completing your course before lodging 482/186/GSM
exceptions_ko: (a) 보호비자, (b) Subclass 485 졸업생 비자, (c) Subclass 590 학생가디언 비자 직접 신청 가능
reg 2.05(5A): 비자 발급 대상 과정(course)을 수료하고 GSM(189/190/491)·186·191·482(SID)·494 신청 진정의사가 있는 경우 웨이버 가능
reg 2.05(4): 통제 불가한 중대·인도적 사정 변화 시 일반 웨이버 가능
exceptions_en: Onshore grant allowed for Protection, 485, and 590 visas
Waiver under reg 2.05(5A) after course completion for GSM, 186, 191, 482 (SID), 494
General waiver under reg 2.05(4) for major uncontrollable compassionate/compelling changes
conditions.waiver_ko: 500 학생비자에서는 심사관 재량(cl 500.611(2)(b)), 590 가디언 비자에서는 강제(cl 590.611)로 부과됩니다. 8503과 제목은 똑같지만 열려 있는 경로가 크게 다릅니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Discretionary on Subclass 500; mandatory on Subclass 590. Distinct from 8503 because 485/590 remain open and reg 2.05(5A) provides a post-course waiver pathway.

clause_notes_ko.text: 조문 구조상 485·590·보호비자 외에는 호주 내 승인을 막지만, 실무상 파트너(820)나 학생비자 추가 연장을 원할 때는 8534 웨이버가 없으면 호주 밖으로 나가야 합니다.
학생이 학업을 성공적으로 '수료(completed the course)'한 뒤 482(SID)·186·189·190·491·494를 신청하려 할 때 별도 불가항력 사유 없이도 웨이버할 수 있는 규정이 있습니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Carves out Protection, 485, and 590 from the onshore bar.
Post-course completion waiver pathway specifically for GSM, 186, 191, 482 (SID), and 494.

conditions.drift_ko: 이민성 웹 8534 Scenario 페이지에는 이미 폐지·종료된 Subclass 132, 187, 188과 구 명칭 482 (Temporary Skill Shortage), 종이서식 Form 1409가 그대로 적혀 있습니다. 현행 법령 reg 2.05(5A) 정본에는 482 (Skills in Demand), 191, 494 등이 명시되어 있습니다.
conditions.drift_en: Home Affairs' 8534 Scenario text still lists repealed Subclasses 132/187/188 and outdated 'TSS 482' / paper Form 1409 notes, whereas current reg 2.05(5A) reflects Subclass 482 (Skills in Demand), 191, and 494.
conditions.statutory_text:
8534The holder will not be entitled to be granted a substantive visa, other than:
(a)a protection visa; or
(b)a Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate) visa; or
(c)a Subclass 590 (Student Guardian) visa;
while the holder remains in Australia.
statutory_paragraphs: 8534The holder will not be entitled to be granted a substantive visa, other than:
(a)a protection visa; or
(b)a Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate) visa; or
(c)a Subclass 590 (Student Guardian) visa;
while the holder remains in Australia.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8534 - No further stay
conditions.dha_web_summary:
While you are in Australia, we will not grant you a new
substantive visa, other than:
a Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate) visa, or
a Subclass 590 (Student Guardian) visa, or
a Protection visa
For the full list of conditions relevant to your visa, see the Federal Register of Legislation.
conditions.dha_web_scenario:
Condition 8534 can be applied to subclass 500 Student visa holders and their family members at our discretion.
The case officer that assesses your application will decide whether to apply the condition.
Applying for a graduate visa
If condition 8534 applies to your current visa you can only apply for the Temporary Graduate visa using the paper form.
You don’t need to ask us to waive the condition before you submit your application.
Download and complete Form 1409 Application for a Temporary Graduate visa. Ensure you tick the box saying you want to waive this condition.
Applying for any other visa
If you have completed the course we granted you the visa for, you don’t need to ask us to waive condition 8534 to make a valid application for one of these visas:
General Skilled Migration visa (for example Subclass 189 or 190)
Subclass 132 (Business Talent) visa
Subclass 186 (Employee Nomination Scheme) visa
Subclass 187 (Regional Sponsored Migration Scheme) visa
Subclass 188 (Business Innovation and Investment (Provisional)) visa
Subclass 482 (Temporary Skill Shortage) visa
You can
ask us to waive this condition in limited circumstances if you want to apply for any other visa, including a further Student visa.

conditions.title_ko: 호주 내 추가 비자 제한 (정부·외교 후원 학생·보호비자만 예외)
conditions.title_en: No Further Stay — Government-Sponsored Student (DFAT/Defence/Foreign Govt)
conditions.summary_ko: 호주 연방정부(DFAT·국방부) 또는 외국 정부 장학·후원을 받아 발급된 학생비자(500)에 주로 붙으며, 호주 내에서는 정부 후원 학생비자(Class TU)와 보호비자 외에 다른 비자를 받을 수 없습니다.
conditions.summary_en: Imposed on DFAT/Defence/government-sponsored students: blocks all onshore substantive visas except a government-supported Student visa or Protection visa.
forbidden_ko: 후원 종료 후 호주 내에서 485·482·820·일반 학생비자 등으로 임의 전환 시도
forbidden_en: Applying onshore for 485, 482, 820, or unsponsored visas without waiver
obligations_ko: 후원 계약상 본국 귀국 의무 준수 (추가 학업 시 정부 후원 확인서 첨부)
obligations_en: Comply with sponsorship return obligations or attach government support for any further Class TU visa
exceptions_ko: (a) 보호비자, (b) 연방정부 또는 외국 정부의 지원을 받는 학생비자(Class TU) 신청
reg 2.05(4): 통제 불가한 중대·인도적 사정 변화 시 웨이버 가능
exceptions_en: (a) Protection visa, (b) Government-supported Class TU Student visa, or reg 2.05(4) waiver
conditions.waiver_ko: 8534와 달리 485 졸업생 비자 예외도, 과정 수료 후 482·189 전환 웨이버 특례(reg 2.05(5A))도 적용되지 않습니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Much stricter than 8534: neither 485 nor reg 2.05(5A) applies.

clause_notes_ko.text: 외교부·국방부 장학생은 강제(500.611(1)(d)), 기타 정부 재정지원은 재량(500.611(2)(a)) 부착됩니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Mandatory for DFAT/Defence students; discretionary for other government-funded students.

conditions.statutory_text:
8535The holder will not be entitled to be granted a substantive visa, other than:
(a)a protection visa; or
(b)a Student (Temporary) (Class TU) visa that is granted to the holder on the basis of support from the Commonwealth government or a foreign government;
while the holder remains in Australia.
statutory_paragraphs: 8535The holder will not be entitled to be granted a substantive visa, other than:
(a)a protection visa; or
(b)a Student (Temporary) (Class TU) visa that is granted to the holder on the basis of support from the Commonwealth government or a foreign government;
while the holder remains in Australia.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8535 - No further stay
conditions.dha_web_summary:
While you are in Australia, we will not grant you a new substantive visa other than:
a Student (Temporary) (Class TU) visa we grant you because you have support from the Commonwealth or a foreign government, or
a protection visa
For the full list of conditions relevant to your visa, visit the Federal Register of Legislation.
conditions.dha_web_scenario:
Condition 8535 is mandatory on subclass 500 Student visas for students sponsored by the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade or Department of Defence.
Applying for a student visa
If condition 8535 applies to your current visa, attach a letter of support from the Australian Government or a foreign government with your new application. You don’t need to ask us to waive the condition before you submit your application.
Applying for any other visa
If condition 8535 applies to your current visa and you want to apply for any other visa, there are some limited circumstances in which you can ask us to waive this condition.
You can’t apply for a further visa in Australia other than:
a Student (Temporary) (Class TU), with the support of the Commonwealth or a foreign government, or
a protection visa

conditions.title_ko: 승인된 전문 개발 프로그램 중단·이탈 금지
conditions.title_en: Must Not Discontinue or Deviate From Professional Development Program
conditions.summary_ko: 비자 승인의 근거가 된 전문 개발 프로그램(Professional Development Program)을 중도에 그만두거나 승인 내용에서 벗어나서는 안 됩니다.
conditions.summary_en: You must not discontinue or deviate from the professional development program on which your visa was granted.
forbidden_ko: 승인된 연수·전문 개발 과정 중도 포기 또는 임의 프로그램 변경
forbidden_en: Stopping or altering the approved professional development program
obligations_ko: 지정 프로그램 전 과정 성실 이수
obligations_en: Complete the approved professional development program as granted
exceptions_ko: 없음
exceptions_en: None.
conditions.waiver_ko: 구 402/연수 계열 비자 조건입니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Legacy training/professional development program compliance condition.

clause_notes_ko.text: 프로그램 중도 이탈 시 조건 위반이 됩니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Requires continuous participation in the approved program.

conditions.statutory_text: 8536The holder must not discontinue, or deviate from, the professional development program in relation to which the visa was granted.
statutory_paragraphs: 8536The holder must not discontinue, or deviate from, the professional development program in relation to which the visa was granted.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8536 - Must not stop or change professional development programs
conditions.dha_web_summary: You must not stop or change professional development program we granted you the visa to do.

conditions.title_ko: 가디언 비자(590) 학생과 동거·주거·생활·복지 제공 의무
conditions.title_en: Student Guardian (590) — Reside With & Provide Welfare for Student
conditions.summary_ko: 학생 가디언 비자(Subclass 590) 보유자는 피후견 학생이 호주에 머무는 동안 함께 호주에 거주하며 같은 거처에서 숙소·지원·일반 복지를 직접 제공해야 합니다.
conditions.summary_en: Subclass 590 Guardians must reside in Australia while the nominating student is in Australia, live with the student, and provide accommodation, support, and general welfare.
forbidden_ko: 피후견 학생을 호주에 남겨두고 무단 출국하거나 별거(따로 거주)
미성년 학생의 주거·생활·복지 관리 소홀
forbidden_en: Living separately from the nominating student or leaving them unattended in Australia
obligations_ko: (1) 학생 체류 중 호주 상주
(2)(a)-(c) 학생과 동일 거처 동거 및 숙식·경제적 지원·일반 복지 제공
obligations_en: Reside in Australia (1), live with the student (2)(a), and provide accommodation, support, and welfare (2)(b)–(c)
exceptions_ko: 불가피한 단기 출국 시 8538 절차에 따라 사전 증빙·대체 보호 승인을 받아야 함
exceptions_en: Short absences require strict compliance with Condition 8538 prior approval rules.
conditions.waiver_ko: 590 가디언 비자 강제 부착 조건(cl 590.611)입니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Mandatory on all Subclass 590 Student Guardian visas.

clause_notes_ko.text: 학생과 다른 집(또는 다른 주)에 따로 살면 즉시 8537 위반으로 비자가 취소될 수 있습니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Living apart from the student breaches 8537.

conditions.statutory_text:
8537(1)While the nominating student (within the meaning of Part 590 of Schedule 2) in relation to the holder is in Australia, the holder must reside in Australia.
(2)While the holder is in Australia, the holder must:
(a)stay with the nominating student (within the meaning of Part 590 of Schedule 2) in relation to the holder; and
(b)provide appropriate accommodation and support for the nominating student; and
(c)provide for the general welfare of the nominating student.
statutory_paragraphs: 8537(1)While the nominating student (within the meaning of Part 590 of Schedule 2) in relation to the holder is in Australia, the holder must reside in Australia.
(2)While the holder is in Australia, the holder must:
(a)stay with the nominating student (within the meaning of Part 590 of Schedule 2) in relation to the holder; and
(b)provide appropriate accommodation and support for the nominating student; and
(c)provide for the general welfare of the nominating student.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8537 - Live with the student and provide for their accommodation, support and welfare
conditions.dha_web_summary:
You must live in Australia while the nominating student is in Australia.
While you and the nominating student are in Australia, you must:
stay with them
provide them with appropriate accommodation
support them
provide for their general welfare
For more information​ see Welfare arrangements for students under 18.

conditions.title_ko: 가디언(590)이 학생 없이 출국 시 사전 사유·대체 복지 승인 의무
conditions.title_en: Guardian (590) Leaving Without Student — Prior Compelling Proof & Welfare Approval
conditions.summary_ko: 590 가디언 비자 소지자가 학생을 호주에 두고 혼자 호주를 떠나려면, 출국 전 반드시 이민성에 불가피한·인도적 사유와 대체 숙소·보호 조치(만 18세 미만은 학교 승인 포함) 증빙을 제출해야 합니다.
conditions.summary_en: Before leaving Australia without the nominating student, a 590 Guardian must first give the Minister evidence of compelling/compassionate reasons and approved alternative accommodation/welfare arrangements (including education-provider approval if under 18).
forbidden_ko: 사전 승인·증빙 제출 없이 학생만 호주에 남겨두고 한국 등 해외로 출국
forbidden_en: Departing Australia without the student prior to submitting compelling-reason proof and alternative care approvals
obligations_ko: (a) 불가피·인도적 사유 증빙, (b) 귀국 시까지 대체 보호 계획, (c) 만 18세 미만 학생은 교육기관(학교) 사전 승인서 확보 후 출국 전 이민성 제출
obligations_en: Submit evidence of compelling/compassionate reasons (a), alternative welfare plan (b), and provider approval if under 18 (c) before departure
exceptions_ko: 학생과 함께 출국·귀국하는 경우에는 적용되지 않음
exceptions_en: Does not apply when travelling together with the nominating student.
conditions.waiver_ko: 590 비자 강제 조건(cl 590.611)이며, 공항 출국 전 반드시 이민성에 사전 서류를 접수하고 확인을 받아야 안전합니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Mandatory on Subclass 590; submit all evidence to Immigration before departing.

clause_notes_ko.text: 어린 자녀를 학교/지인에게 맡기고 부모가 급히 잠깐 한국에 다녀올 때 8538 절차를 건너뛰어 비자가 취소되는 사례가 적지 않습니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Crucial safeguard before any solo trip offshore by a 590 guardian.

conditions.statutory_text:
8538If the holder leaves Australia without the nominating student (within the meaning of Part 590 of Schedule 2) in relation to the holder, the holder must first give to the Minister evidence that:
(a)there are compelling or compassionate reasons for doing so; and
(b)the holder has made alternative arrangements for the accommodation, support and general welfare of the nominating student until the holder’s return to Australia; and
(c)if the nominating student has not turned 18, the alternative arrangements are approved by the education provider for the course to which the nominating student’s visa relates.
statutory_paragraphs: 8538If the holder leaves Australia without the nominating student (within the meaning of Part 590 of Schedule 2) in relation to the holder, the holder must first give to the Minister evidence that:
(a)there are compelling or compassionate reasons for doing so; and
(b)the holder has made alternative arrangements for the accommodation, support and general welfare of the nominating student until the holder’s return to Australia; and
(c)if the nominating student has not turned 18, the alternative arrangements are approved by the education provider for the course to which the nominating student’s visa relates.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8538 - Not leave Australia without the student without our approval
conditions.dha_web_summary:
You can't leave Australia without the student visa holder unless you have made appropriate welfare arrangements.
If you need to leave Australia without the student you are caring for (the nominating student), you must first show us:
there are compassionate and compelling reasons for leaving Australia without the student
you have made
alternative arrangements for the student’s accommodation, support and general welfare until you return
that their education provider has endorsed​ the alternative arrangements, if the student is under 18.
We will let you know if we have approved the alternative arrangements.
To submit your change of welfare arrangements, see ‘Your study situation has changed​’.
If you do not maintain appropriate welfare arrangements, your visa may be cancelled.
​
​

conditions.title_ko: 지정 지방(Regional Area) 내 거주·학업·근무 의무 (구 489 등)
conditions.title_en: Live, Study & Work Only in Designated Regional Area (Schedule 6A/6D)
conditions.summary_ko: 구 489 등 지방 비자 조건으로, 호주 체류 중 비자 승인일(연속 보유 시 최초 비자 승인일) 기준 입법고시상 지정된 지역·지방(regional area)에서만 거주·학업·근무해야 합니다.
conditions.summary_en: You must live, study, and work only in a regional area specified by legislative instrument for item 6A1001/6D101 as in force when the visa (or first such visa) was granted.
forbidden_ko: 지정 지방 지역을 벗어나 시드니·멜버른·브리즈번 등 비지정 대도시에서 거주, 취업 또는 대면 학업
forbidden_en: Living, working, or studying outside the applicable regional postcodes in force at visa grant
obligations_ko: 비자 승인 시점 고시 기준 지정 지역 내에서만 거주·근로·학업 유지
obligations_en: Keep all residence, employment, and study within the relevant regional area
exceptions_ko: 단순 단기 여행·휴가 출장은 거주·근무가 아니나, 원격근무·출장 장기화 시 실제 근무·거주지 판정 주의 필요
exceptions_en: Brief leisure travel is distinct from residing/working, though remote work or extended placements outside the region carry breach risks.
conditions.waiver_ko: 현행 491/494에는 8579가 적용되며, 구 489 및 연계 010/020 브리징 승계 시 8539가 붙습니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Legacy counterpart to Condition 8579 (which applies to 491 and 494).

clause_notes_ko.text: 우편번호 목록 변경 시 '비자 승인 시점' 기준 고시가 고정 적용됩니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Locks regional postcode eligibility to the instrument in force at grant.

conditions.statutory_text:
8539While the holder is in Australia, the holder must live, study and work only in an area specified by the Minister in an instrument in writing for item 6A1001 of Schedule 6A or item 6D101 of Schedule 6D, as in force:
(a)when the visa was granted; or
(b)if the holder has held more than 1 visa that is subject to this condition—when the first of those visas was granted.
statutory_paragraphs: 8539While the holder is in Australia, the holder must live, study and work only in an area specified by the Minister in an instrument in writing for item 6A1001 of Schedule 6A or item 6D101 of Schedule 6D, as in force:
(a)when the visa was granted; or
(b)if the holder has held more than 1 visa that is subject to this condition—when the first of those visas was granted.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8539 - Live, study and work in a specified area
conditions.dha_web_summary:
While you are in Australia you must live, work and study only in an area specified by the minister in a written instrument. The instrument must have been in force at the time your visa was granted. If you have held more than one visa through the extended pathway that is subject to this condition, you are required to live in an area specified by the minister when the first of those visas was granted.
Your visa grant letter will list the areas specified in the ministerial instrument at the time your visa is granted.
If you want to stay in Australia but don’t want to stay in a specified area you must apply for another visa.
Understanding your work rights
The department is working with the Fair Work Ombudsman to help employees and employ​​ers understand and follow Australian Workplace laws.
Information on pay rates, shift calculations, leave arrangements and notice and redundancy entitlements is in the
Pay and Conditions Tool (PACT).
The Fair Work Ombudsman website has more information on workplace rights and entitlements for
visa holders and migrant workers​.​

conditions.title_ko: 호주 내 추가 비자 제한 (462 취업관광·보호비자만 예외)
conditions.title_en: No Further Stay — Except Subclass 462 (Work & Holiday) & Protection
conditions.summary_ko: 호주 입국 후 호주 체류 중에는 Subclass 462(취업관광) 비자와 보호비자를 제외한 어떠한 실질 비자도 받을 수 없습니다.
conditions.summary_en: Once in Australia, you will not be entitled to be granted a substantive visa other than a Protection visa or Subclass 462 (Work and Holiday) while onshore.
forbidden_ko: Subclass 462 및 보호비자 외 학생·파트너·취업 등 다른 실질 비자 국내 신청·승인
forbidden_en: Onshore grant of any substantive visa apart from Protection or Subclass 462
obligations_ko: 462 연장 신청 외 타 비자 전환이 필요하면 출국 후 신청하거나 웨이버 여부 검토
obligations_en: Apply offshore for non-462/non-protection visas unless waived
exceptions_ko: Subclass 462 (Work and Holiday) 비자 및 보호비자 (reg 2.05(4) 웨이버 가능 여부 사안별 검토)
exceptions_en: Protection visas and Subclass 462 visas (plus potential reg 2.05(4) waiver in compelling/compassionate circumstances).
conditions.waiver_ko: 주로 일부 462 비자 재량 부과(462.612) 시 등장하는 조건입니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Discretionary condition associated with Subclass 462.

clause_notes_ko.text: 8503에 Subclass 462 예외만 열어둔 형태입니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Variant of 8503 that leaves Subclass 462 applications open onshore.

conditions.statutory_text: 8540The holder will not, after entering Australia, be entitled to be granted a substantive visa, other than a protection visa or a Subclass 462 (Work and Holiday) visa, while the holder remains in Australia.
statutory_paragraphs: 8540The holder will not, after entering Australia, be entitled to be granted a substantive visa, other than a protection visa or a Subclass 462 (Work and Holiday) visa, while the holder remains in Australia.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8540 - No further application
conditions.dha_web_summary:
While you are in Australia we will not grant you a new substantive visa other than a:
​Work and Holiday visa (subclass 462), or
protection visa

conditions.title_ko: 호주 강제퇴거(Removal) 절차 전면 협조 및 방해 금지
conditions.title_en: Facilitate & Do Not Obstruct Removal From Australia
conditions.summary_ko: 이민성의 호주 출국·송환(removal) 절차 준비와 집행에 가능한 모든 협조를 해야 하며, 이를 방해하려는 어떠한 시도도 해서는 안 됩니다.
conditions.summary_en: You must do everything possible to facilitate your removal from Australia and must not attempt to obstruct removal arrangements.
forbidden_ko: 여권 발급 비협조, 신원 불응, 송환 지연·방해 행위 일체
forbidden_en: Obstructing travel document procurement or removal arrangements
obligations_ko: (a) 송환 절차 최대한 협조, (b) 송환 준비·집행 방해 금지 (주로 070 BVR)
obligations_en: Cooperate fully with removal (a) and avoid any obstruction (b)
exceptions_ko: 적법한 법률 대리 및 사법·재심 절차 이용 자체는 방해가 아니나 지시 불응은 위반 가능
exceptions_en: Lawful legal representation is separate from obstructing administrative removal directions.
conditions.waiver_ko: 070 BVR(Removal Pending) 강제 부착 조건입니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Mandatory on Subclass 070 Bridging (Removal Pending).

clause_notes_ko.text: 8542·8543과 함께 070 비자의 송환 협조 3대 조건을 이룹니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Core removal-cooperation rule on BVR 070.

conditions.statutory_text:
8541The holder:
(a)must do everything possible to facilitate his or her removal from Australia; and
(b)must not attempt to obstruct efforts to arrange and effect his or her removal from Australia.
statutory_paragraphs: 8541The holder:
(a)must do everything possible to facilitate his or her removal from Australia; and
(b)must not attempt to obstruct efforts to arrange and effect his or her removal from Australia.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8541 - Must do whatever you can to help us remove you from Australia
conditions.dha_web_summary:
You must not try to stop us from arranging your removal or removing you from Australia.
You must do everything you can to help us arrange your removal from Australia.

conditions.title_ko: 송환(Removal) 지시에 따른 대면 출석 보고 의무
conditions.title_en: Report in Person for Removal as Directed
conditions.summary_ko: 장관이 구두 또는 서면으로 내린 송환 지시에 따라 지정된 대로 대면 출석해 보고해야 합니다.
conditions.summary_en: You must report in person for removal from Australia in accordance with oral or written directions from the Minister.
forbidden_ko: 송환 관련 대면 출석 명령 불응·잠적
forbidden_en: Failing to report in person when directed for removal
obligations_ko: 구두·서면 송환 출석 지시 이행
obligations_en: Present yourself in person as instructed for removal
exceptions_ko: 없음
exceptions_en: None.
conditions.waiver_ko: 070 BVR 강제 부착 조건입니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Mandatory on Subclass 070.

clause_notes_ko.text: 송환 집행을 위한 직접 출석 의무입니다.

clause_notes_en.text: In-person reporting specifically for removal execution.

conditions.statutory_text: 8542The holder must report in person for removal from Australia in accordance with instructions given, orally or in writing, by the Minister to the holder for the purpose of that removal.
statutory_paragraphs: 8542The holder must report in person for removal from Australia in accordance with instructions given, orally or in writing, by the Minister to the holder for the purpose of that removal.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8542 - Make yourself available for removal from Australia
conditions.dha_web_summary: You must follow any instructions we give you to make yourself available for removal from Australia in accordance with instructions given by us.

conditions.title_ko: 송환 준비를 위한 지정 일시·장소 출석 의무
conditions.title_en: Attend Specified Place/Time to Facilitate Removal
conditions.summary_ko: 송환 준비·절차 진행을 위해 장관이 구두 또는 서면으로 지정한 장소·날짜·시간에 반드시 출석해야 합니다.
conditions.summary_en: You must attend at the place, date, and time specified orally or in writing by the Minister to facilitate removal arrangements.
forbidden_ko: 영사관 면담·서류 확인 등 송환 준비 소환 불출석
forbidden_en: Missing scheduled appointments arranged to facilitate removal
obligations_ko: 지정된 장소·일시에 정확히 출석
obligations_en: Attend all removal-preparation appointments as directed
exceptions_ko: 없음
exceptions_en: None.
conditions.waiver_ko: 070 BVR 강제 부착 조건입니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Mandatory on Subclass 070.

clause_notes_ko.text: 8542(송환 당일 출석)와 달리 대사관·인터뷰 등 송환 '준비' 단계 출석을 포괄합니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Covers preparatory appointments (e.g., consular interviews) for removal.

conditions.statutory_text: 8543The holder must attend at a place, date and time specified, orally or in writing, by the Minister in order to facilitate efforts to arrange and effect his or her removal from Australia.
statutory_paragraphs: 8543The holder must attend at a place, date and time specified, orally or in writing, by the Minister in order to facilitate efforts to arrange and effect his or her removal from Australia.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8543 - Attend as directed for removal from Australia
conditions.dha_web_summary: You must be where we tell you to be, at a date or time we specify, so we can make arrangements to remove you.

conditions.title_ko: 동일 고용주 최대 6개월 근무 제한 (워킹홀리데이 417 · 462)
conditions.title_en: Max 6 Months With Any One Employer (WHM 417 & 462)
conditions.summary_ko: 워킹홀리데이(417·462) 비자 소지자는 이민성 차관(Secretary)의 사전 서면 허가 없이 한 고용주 밑에서 6개월을 초과하여 일할 수 없습니다.
conditions.summary_en: You must not be employed by any one employer for more than 6 months without prior written permission from the Secretary (mandatory on 417 and 462).
forbidden_ko: 사전 허가나 정책상 자동 면제 사유 없이 동일 고용주 아래 6개월 초과 근무
법인명만 바꾸고 실질 동일 사업장·동일 고용주에서 6개월 초과 편법 근무
forbidden_en: Working over 6 months for the same end-employer without exemption or written permission
Using labour-hire/ABN switches to remain at the exact same workplace beyond 6 months
obligations_ko: 비자 연장(2차·3차 승인) 또는 다른 WHM 비자 전환 시 6개월 카운트 초기화 시점 확인 및 6개월 만료 전 연장 허가 신청
obligations_en: Track the 6-month clock per visa grant and apply in advance for Form 1445 permission if no automatic exemption applies
exceptions_ko: 정책 지침(PAM3)상 별도 서면 허가 없이 6개월 초과가 자동 허용되는 직종·지역(예: 호주 전역 동식물 농업, 북부호주 지정 산업, 재해 복구, 특정 지역 관광·접객업, 1차 의료·보건, 동일 고용주의 서로 다른 물리적 사업장 순환 등) — 단 2026~2027 개편 포함 현행 자동면제 범위를 반드시 실시간 확인해야 함
exceptions_en: Current policy automatic exemptions (without applying for written permission): e.g., different physical locations up to 6 months each, plant/animal cultivation Australia-wide, disaster recovery, critical healthcare, and specified Northern Australia/regional hospitality sectors (always verify current DHA guidance)
conditions.waiver_ko: 일반 8503 웨이버가 아니라 조문 자체의 '사전 서면 허가(Form 1445)' 또는 공식 자동면제 요건을 활용합니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Uses Form 1445 prior written permission or official automatic policy exemptions.

clause_notes_ko.text: 법 조문은 '6개월 금지 + 사전 서면 허가 예외' 단 1문장이나, 이민성 정책(PAM3)이 광범위한 자동 면제 업종·지점 이동 예외를 운영하고 있어 반드시 박앤코 WHM 내비게이터에서 해당 업종/지역 여부를 교차 검증해야 합니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Statutory text is a single strict sentence, while departmental policy specifies extensive automatic sector/location exemptions.

scenarios.q_ko: 같은 회사인데 시드니 지점에서 6개월, 멜버른 지점에서 6개월 일하는 것도 위반인가요?
scenarios.q_en: Can I work 6 months in Sydney and another 6 months in Melbourne for the same company?
scenarios.a_ko: 고용주의 서로 다른 물리적 사업장(different locations)에서 근무하고 한 곳당 6개월을 넘지 않는 경우, 현행 이민성 정책상 사전 서면 허가 없이 허용되는 대표적 자동 면제 사유에 해당합니다. 단 재택근무나 동일 현장 내 부서 이동은 인정되지 않습니다.
scenarios.a_en: Under current Home Affairs policy, working at different physical locations for the same employer (max 6 months per location) is normally automatically exempt—though remote work from home does not restart the clock.

conditions.statutory_text: 8547The holder must not be employed by any 1 employer for more than 6 months, without the prior permission in writing of the Secretary.
statutory_paragraphs: 8547The holder must not be employed by any 1 employer for more than 6 months, without the prior permission in writing of the Secretary.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8547 - Not work for one employer for more than 6 months
conditions.dha_web_summary:
You must not be employed by any one employer for more than 6 months, without the prior permission in writing of the Secretary.
See Work for the same employer for 6 months.
Understanding your work rights
The Department is working with the Fair Work Ombudsman to help employees and employers understand and follow Australian Workplace laws.
Information on pay rates, shift calculations, leave arrangements and notice and redundancy entitlements is in the
Pay and Conditions Tool (PACT).
The Fair Work Ombudsman website has more information on workplace rights and entitlements for
visa holders and migrant workers.

conditions.title_ko: 최대 4개월 이내 학업·연수 제한 (워킹홀리데이 417 · 462)
conditions.title_en: Maximum 4 Months Study or Training (WHM 417 & 462)
conditions.summary_ko: 워킹홀리데이(417·462) 비자 소지자가 비자 기간 중 수강할 수 있는 학업·직업훈련·어학연수는 총합 최대 4개월(약 17주)로 제한됩니다.
conditions.summary_en: Mandatory on Subclass 417 & 462: you must not engage in any studies or training in Australia for more than 4 months in total.
forbidden_ko: 총합 4개월을 초과하는 어학원·자격증(RSA/바리스타 외 장기 코스)·대학·VET 수강
forbidden_en: Studying or training for more than 4 months total during the visa
obligations_ko: 단기 코스 합산 4개월 이내 관리 (4개월 이상 학업은 학생비자 500 전환 필요)
obligations_en: Keep all courses combined within 4 months (longer study requires Subclass 500)
exceptions_ko: 세컨드·서드 WHM 비자가 새로 승인되면 새 비자 기간 기준 4개월이 다시 부여됨
exceptions_en: A fresh WHM visa grant provides a new 4-month allowance for that visa period.
conditions.waiver_ko: 8201(3개월)보다 1개월 긴 4개월 상한이며, 417·462에 강제 부착됩니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Mandatory 4-month cap on 417 and 462 (1 month longer than 8201).

clause_notes_ko.text: 워홀에서 장기 영어 코스나 디플로마를 들으려다 4개월을 넘겨 위반하는 사례가 많으므로 주의해야 합니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Applies across all study or vocational training courses combined.

conditions.statutory_text: 8548The holder must not engage in any studies or training in Australia for more than 4 months.
statutory_paragraphs: 8548The holder must not engage in any studies or training in Australia for more than 4 months.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8548 - Maximum 4 months study
conditions.dha_web_summary:
You can’t study or train for more than a total of 4 months while you are in Australia on this visa.
Four months of study or training is 17 weeks and 3 days. It includes:
weekends
public holidays
non-teaching periods before exams
It does not include:
orientation periods
holiday periods
You can do work-based training and correspondence courses that you could take outside Australia. These don’t count towards the 4 months study or training.

conditions.title_ko: 지정 지역(Designated Area / 노퍽섬) 거주·학업·근무 의무
conditions.title_en: Live, Study & Work in Designated Area (reg 1.03 / Norfolk Island)
conditions.summary_ko: reg 1.03상의 지정 지역(또는 159 노퍽섬 스트림 특례 시 노퍽섬) 내에서만 거주·학업·근무해야 합니다(주로 구 지방비자 및 010/020 승계).
conditions.summary_en: You must live, study, and work only in a designated area under reg 1.03 as in force at grant (with a Norfolk Island study carve-out for dependants under 25).
forbidden_ko: 지정 지역 외 거소 이전·취업·학업 (노퍽섬 만 25세 미만 부양자녀의 호주 본토 유학 예외 제외)
forbidden_en: Residing, working, or studying outside the designated area in force at grant
obligations_ko: 비자 승인 시점 기준 지정 지역 내 거주·근무·학업 유지
obligations_en: Comply with designated area boundaries as at grant
exceptions_ko: (2) 159 노퍽섬 비자의 만 25세 미만 부양자녀가 호주 본토에서 8105 요건을 준수하며 유학하는 경우 예외
exceptions_en: (2) Under-25 dependant child of Norfolk Island resident studying elsewhere in Australia while meeting 8105 limits
conditions.waiver_ko: 현행 491/494의 8579와 구분되는 reg 1.03 지정지역 조건입니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Refers to reg 1.03 designated areas (distinct from current 8579).

clause_notes_ko.text: 노퍽섬(159) 부양자녀의 본토 대학 유학 특례 조항을 함께 두고 있습니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Contains specific Norfolk Island resident dependant study exemption.

conditions.statutory_text:
8549While the holder is in Australia, the holder must live, study and work only in a designated area, as in force:
(a)when the visa was granted; or
(b)if the holder has held more than 1 visa that is subject to this condition—when the first of those visas was granted.
Note:For designated area: see regulation 1.03.
(2)For a visa granted on the basis of satisfaction of clause 159.214 or 159.311 of Schedule 2, while the holder is in Australia, the holder must live, study and work only in Norfolk Island, apart from any period during the whole of which the visa holder:
(a)has not turned 25; and
(b)is a dependent child of a person who is ordinarily resident in Norfolk Island; and
(c)lives elsewhere in Australia for the purpose of study; and
(d)meets the requirements mentioned in condition 8105 (which relates to students engaging in work).
Note:Condition 8105 is not imposed on the visa.
statutory_paragraphs: 8549While the holder is in Australia, the holder must live, study and work only in a designated area, as in force:
(a)when the visa was granted; or
(b)if the holder has held more than 1 visa that is subject to this condition—when the first of those visas was granted.
Note:For designated area: see regulation 1.03.

(2)For a visa granted on the basis of satisfaction of clause 159.214 or 159.311 of Schedule 2, while the holder is in Australia, the holder must live, study and work only in Norfolk Island, apart from any period during the whole of which the visa holder:
(a)has not turned 25; and
(b)is a dependent child of a person who is ordinarily resident in Norfolk Island; and
(c)lives elsewhere in Australia for the purpose of study; and
(d)meets the requirements mentioned in condition 8105 (which relates to students engaging in work).
Note:Condition 8105 is not imposed on the visa.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8549 - Live, work and study in a designated area
conditions.dha_web_summary:
You must live, work and study in a designated area while you are in Australia on the visa.
If you have held more than one visa that is subject to this condition, the designated area that was in force when the first of those visas was granted will apply.
You can find the designated area in your visa grant letter. The website also has a complete listing of
Designated Areas of Australia
Former holders of Norfolk Island Immigration permits
If you hold a TP-159 visa we granted you because you held a Norfolk Island immigration permit on 30 June 2016, or you are the dependent child of someone who does, you must live, work and study only in Norfolk Island, unless you:
have not turned 25, and
are the dependent child of someone who normally lives in Norfolk Island, and
live elsewhere in Australia so you can study, and
meet the requirements of condition 8105 related to student work
Condition 8105 is not imposed on the visa.
Understanding your work rights
The Department is working with the Fair Work Ombudsman to help employees and employers understand and follow Australian Workplace laws.
Information on pay rates, shift calculations, leave arrangements and notice and redundancy entitlements is in the
Pay and Conditions Tool (PACT).
The Fair Work Ombudsman website has more information on workplace rights and entitlements for
visa holders and migrant workers.
For the full list of conditions relevant to your visa, see the Federal Register of Legislation.

conditions.title_ko: 성명·주소·전화·이메일·SNS·아이디 변경 최소 2영업일 전 사전 통지

conditions.waiver_en: Advance 2-working-day notice extending to online profiles and usernames.

clause_notes_ko.text: BVR 070의 8625/8626(사후 2영업일)과 달리 8550은 '최소 2영업일 전(not less than 2 working days before)' 사전 통지를 요구합니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Requires advance notification prior to the change taking effect.

name
address
phone number

conditions.title_ko: 보안화학물질·항공·해운·생물보안 시설 취업 전 장관 사전승인
conditions.title_en: Ministerial Approval Before Security-Sensitive Employment
conditions.summary_ko: 안보 우려 화학물질 취급 직종, 항공·해운 산업 직종, 고위험 생물보안 시설 근무를 시작하기 전에 반드시 장관의 사전 승인을 받아야 합니다.
conditions.summary_en: You must obtain ministerial approval before taking up jobs involving security-concern chemicals, aviation/maritime industries, or security-sensitive biological agents.
forbidden_ko: (1)(a)-(c) 보안 민감 산업·직종에 장관 승인 없이 취업
forbidden_en: Starting work in aviation, maritime, security-concern chemical, or biological-agent roles without prior approval
obligations_ko: 해당 산업 취업 전 이민성 장관의 서면 승인 확보
obligations_en: Seek ministerial approval prior to accepting such employment
exceptions_ko: 없음
exceptions_en: None.
conditions.waiver_ko: 국가안보·공공안전 보호 조건(050/070 등)입니다.
conditions.waiver_en: National-security employment clearance condition.

clause_notes_ko.text: 화학물질(COAG 지정 목록), 항공/해양 산업, 생물작용제 취급 시설에 대한 사전 취업 통제입니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Cross-references ministerial instrument on chemicals of security concern.

conditions.statutory_text:
8551(1)The holder must obtain the Minister’s approval before taking up employment in the following occupations, or occupations of a similar kind:
(a)occupations that involve the use of, or access to, chemicals of security concern;
(b)occupations in the aviation or maritime industries;
(c)occupations at facilities that handle securitysensitive biological agents.
(2)In this clause:
chemicals of security concern means chemicals specified by the Minister in an instrument in writing for this definition.
Note:The Minister’s instrument will refer to chemicals that have been identified, by the Council of Australian Governments, as chemicals of security concern. Without limiting what the Council might identify, the chemicals may include:
(a)industrial chemicals, including chemicals used in the retail, pharmaceutical or pool and spa sectors, that could be diverted from their lawful use to other purposes such as terroristrelated activities; and
(b)agricultural and veterinary chemicals that could be diverted from their lawful use to other purposes, including terroristrelated activities.
statutory_paragraphs: 8551(1)The holder must obtain the Minister’s approval before taking up employment in the following occupations, or occupations of a similar kind:
(a)occupations that involve the use of, or access to, chemicals of security concern;
(b)occupations in the aviation or maritime industries;
(c)occupations at facilities that handle securitysensitive biological agents.
(2)In this clause:
chemicals of security concern means chemicals specified by the Minister in an instrument in writing for this definition.

Note:The Minister’s instrument will refer to chemicals that have been identified, by the Council of Australian Governments, as chemicals of security concern. Without limiting what the Council might identify, the chemicals may include:

(a)industrial chemicals, including chemicals used in the retail, pharmaceutical or pool and spa sectors, that could be diverted from their lawful use to other purposes such as terroristrelated activities; and
(b)agricultural and veterinary chemicals that could be diverted from their lawful use to other purposes, including terroristrelated activities.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8551 - Have approval for certain employment
conditions.dha_web_summary:
You must have our approval to do any job:
that involves the use of or access to chemicals of security concern
in the aviation or maritime industries
at a facility  that handles security-sensitive biological agents

conditions.title_ko: 호주 국가안보 위해(ASIO법 제4조) 활동 금지

statutory_paragraphs: 8553The holder must not become involved in activities that are prejudicial to security (within the meaning of section 4 of the Australian Security Intelligence Organisation Act 1979).

sabotage

attacks on Australia's defence system
acts of foreign interference

conditions.title_ko: 무기·폭발물 및 관련 제조·사용 교본 취득 금지
conditions.title_en: No Acquisition of Weapons, Explosives or Instruction Material
conditions.summary_ko: 무기, 폭발물, 또는 무기·폭발물 사용법을 설명한 자료·문서를 취득하거나 보유해서는 안 됩니다.
conditions.summary_en: You must not acquire weapons, explosives, or instructional material/documentation on using weapons or explosives.
forbidden_ko: (1)(a)-(c) 무기·폭발물 또는 관련 매뉴얼·설명서 취득 금지
forbidden_en: Acquiring weapons, explosives, or instructional materials on their use
obligations_ko: 해당 물품·문서 일체 미취득
obligations_en: Refrain from acquiring any prohibited weapons, explosives, or manuals
exceptions_ko: 조문상 '무기(weapon)'는 신체에 상해를 가하기 위해 제작·개조된 물건을 의미
exceptions_en: 'Weapon' means anything made or adapted to inflict bodily injury.
conditions.waiver_ko: 050 BVE / 070 BVR 보안 조건입니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Strict public-safety prohibition.

clause_notes_ko.text: 8562(취업)·8563(사용·훈련)과 함께 무기·폭발물 통제 3종을 구성합니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Forms a trio with 8562 (employment) and 8563 (use/training).

statutory_paragraphs: 8554(1)The holder must not acquire any of the following goods:
(a)weapons;
(b)explosives;
(c)material or documentation that provides instruction on the use of weapons or explosives.
(2)In this clause:
weapon means a thing made or adapted for use for inflicting bodily injury.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8554 - Weapons acquisition
conditions.dha_web_summary:
You must not acquire any:
weapons
explosives
plans, documents or instructions on the use of weapons or explosives
For the full list of conditions relevant to your visa, see the Federal Register of Legislation.

conditions.title_ko: 비행 훈련·항공기 조종 전 장관 사전승인 의무
conditions.title_en: Ministerial Approval Before Flight Training or Flying Aircraft
conditions.summary_ko: 항공기 조종 훈련(flight training)이나 항공기 직접 조종 및 이와 유사한 활동을 하기 전에 반드시 장관의 사전 승인을 받아야 합니다.
conditions.summary_en: You must obtain the Minister's approval before undertaking flight training, flying aircraft, or similar activities.
forbidden_ko: 사전 승인 없이 조종 훈련, 경비행기·드론 등 유사 비행 조종 활동 수행
forbidden_en: Undertaking flight training or flying aircraft without ministerial approval
obligations_ko: 비행 관련 활동 전 사전 승인 확보
obligations_en: Obtain ministerial clearance prior to flight training or piloting
exceptions_ko: 일반 여객기 탑승은 해당하지 않음
exceptions_en: Normal passenger air travel is unaffected.
conditions.waiver_ko: 주로 050/070 안보 관리 조건입니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Security-clearance condition on BVE/BVR.

clause_notes_ko.text: 조종사 훈련 및 항공기 운항 전반을 사전 승인 대상으로 둡니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Covers flight training and piloting aircraft.

statutory_paragraphs: 8555The holder must obtain the Minister’s approval before undertaking the following activities, or activities of a similar kind:
(a)flight training;
(b)flying aircraft.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8555 - Must have approval to undertake aviation activities
conditions.dha_web_summary:
Unless you have our prior approval you must not:
fly an aircraft
learn to fly an aircraft
undertake any related activities

conditions.title_ko: UN 제재단체·테러조직·테러지원국과의 연락·교류 금지
conditions.title_en: No Communication or Association With Prescribed Terrorist/Sanctioned Entities
conditions.summary_ko: UN 헌장법 제재 목록 단체, 호주 형법(Criminal Code)상 규정된 테러조직 및 테러지원국과 연락하거나 교류해서는 안 됩니다.
conditions.summary_en: You must not communicate or associate with UN-sanctioned entities, prescribed terrorist organisations, or state sponsors of terrorism under the Criminal Code.
forbidden_ko: (a) UN 제재 단체, (b) 호주 형법 규정 테러조직, (c) 테러지원국과의 통신·교류 일체
forbidden_en: Any communication or association with listed entities (a)–(c)
obligations_ko: 금지 대상 단체·국가와의 직간접 접촉 차단
obligations_en: Avoid all contact or association with designated entities
exceptions_ko: 없음
exceptions_en: None.
conditions.waiver_ko: 엄격한 대테러·안보 금지 조항입니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Strict counter-terrorism prohibition.

clause_notes_ko.text: UN Charter Act Part 4 및 Criminal Code s 102.1 등과 직접 연계됩니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Links directly to UN Charter Act Part 4 and Criminal Code Div 102.

conditions.statutory_text:
8556The holder must not communicate or associate with:
(a)an entity listed under Part 4 of the Charter of the United Nations Act 1945; or
(b)an organisation prescribed by regulations made under the Criminal Code Act 1995 for the purposes of paragraph (b) of the definition of terrorist organisation in subsection 102.1(1) of the Criminal Code; or
(c)a state sponsor of terrorism (within the meaning of the Criminal Code).
statutory_paragraphs: 8556The holder must not communicate or associate with:
(a)an entity listed under Part 4 of the Charter of the United Nations Act 1945; or

(b)an organisation prescribed by regulations made under the Criminal Code Act 1995 for the purposes of paragraph (b) of the definition of terrorist organisation in subsection 102.1(1) of the Criminal Code; or
(c)a state sponsor of terrorism (within the meaning of the Criminal Code).
conditions.dha_web_title: 8556 - Must not communicate or associate with certain people or organisations
conditions.dha_web_summary:
You must not  communicate or associate with:
an entity listed under Part 4 of the Charter of the United Nations Act 1945, or
an organisation   prescribed by the Criminal Code Regulations 2002
For the full list of conditions relevant to your visa, see the Federal Register of Legislation.

conditions.title_ko: 적격 투자금(SIV/PIV/188) 전 비자 기간 유지 의무
conditions.title_en: Maintain Complying / Significant / Premium Investment Throughout Visa
conditions.summary_ko: 투자이민(188 등) 승인 근거가 된 적격 투자(complying / significant / premium investment, reg 5.19B–5.19D)를 비자 전체 기간 동안 계속 유지해야 합니다.
conditions.summary_en: You must hold your complying, complying significant, or complying premium investment (reg 5.19B–5.19D) for the whole visa period.
forbidden_ko: 비자 만료·영주권(888) 전환 전에 적격 투자금 임의 인출·처분 후 미재투자
forbidden_en: Withdrawing complying investments prematurely without authorised reinvestment
obligations_ko: 승인 당시 규정(reg 5.19B/C/D) 요건을 충족하는 투자 포트폴리오 전 기간 유지
obligations_en: Keep complying investment active for the entire visa duration
exceptions_ko: 규정 허용 범위 내 적격 자산 간 교체 투자(switching)는 시한 준수 시 허용
exceptions_en: Permitted switching between complying assets within regulatory grace rules.
conditions.waiver_ko: 신규 188 접수는 폐지됐으나 기존 보유자 및 888 전환 대기자가 반드시 지켜야 하는 핵심 조건입니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Ongoing compliance obligation for existing Subclass 188 holders.

clause_notes_ko.text: 승인 시점 기준 reg 5.19B(일반)·5.19C(고액 SIV)·5.19D(초고액 PIV) 기준을 각각 적용합니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Tracks historical reg 5.19B, 5.19C, and 5.19D investment rules in force at grant.

conditions.statutory_text:
8557The holder must hold for the whole of the visa period:
(a)if the visa was granted on the basis of a complying investment within the meaning of regulation 5.19B as in force at a particular time—a complying investment within the meaning of regulation 5.19B as in force at that time; or
(b)if the visa was granted on the basis of a complying significant investment within the meaning of regulation 5.19C as in force at a particular time—a complying significant investment within the meaning of regulation 5.19C as in force at that time; or
(c)if the visa was granted on the basis of a complying premium investment within the meaning of regulation 5.19D as in force at a particular time—a complying premium investment within the meaning of regulation 5.19D as in force at that time.
statutory_paragraphs: 8557The holder must hold for the whole of the visa period:

(a)if the visa was granted on the basis of a complying investment within the meaning of regulation 5.19B as in force at a particular time—a complying investment within the meaning of regulation 5.19B as in force at that time; or

(b)if the visa was granted on the basis of a complying significant investment within the meaning of regulation 5.19C as in force at a particular time—a complying significant investment within the meaning of regulation 5.19C as in force at that time; or

(c)if the visa was granted on the basis of a complying premium investment within the meaning of regulation 5.19D as in force at a particular time—a complying premium investment within the meaning of regulation 5.19D as in force at that time.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8557 - Maintain your investment
conditions.dha_web_summary:
You must hold a complying investment, complying significant investment or premium investment (whichever is applicable)  as long as the visa is valid.
For the full list of conditions relevant to your visa, see the Federal Register of Legislation.

conditions.title_ko: 연속 18개월 중 최대 12개월 체류 상한 (방문비자 600 장기체류 부모 등)
conditions.title_en: No More Than 12 Months Stay in Any 18-Month Period
conditions.summary_ko: 어떤 연속된 18개월 기간을 잡아 계산하더라도 호주 내 실제 체류 일수 합계가 12개월을 넘어서는 안 됩니다(관광비자 600 부모초청·장기 복수비자 등에 자주 부착).
conditions.summary_en: You must not stay in Australia for more than 12 months in any rolling 18-month period (common on long-validity Subclass 600 Visitor visas).
forbidden_ko: 3년/5년 장기 관광비자 기간 중 잠시 해외 출국했다 바로 재입국해 실질적으로 18개월 중 12개월을 초과 거주
forbidden_en: Doing brief offshore 'visa runs' so cumulative time onshore exceeds 12 months in any rolling 18 months
obligations_ko: 매 입국·체류 시 과거 18개월(약 547일) 역산 합산 체류일이 12개월(약 365일) 이하인지 확인
obligations_en: Calculate rolling 18-month cumulative onshore days before returning to Australia
exceptions_ko: 없음 (rolling window 방식이므로 달력 연도가 바뀌어도 누적 계산 리셋 안 됨)
exceptions_en: Rolling 18-month window—does NOT reset on 1 January or on each entry.
conditions.waiver_ko: 단기 출국만으로는 18개월 중 12개월 제한이 초기화되지 않으므로 '연속 비자런' 시 다음 입국이나 연장 때 8558 위반이 발생합니다.
conditions.waiver_en: A rolling cap; short trips offshore do not reset your past 18 months onshore.

clause_notes_ko.text: 600 관광비자 부모초청(3년/5년 멀티) 등에 붙을 경우, 12개월 꽉 채우고 나갔다면 최소 약 6개월 이상 해외에 있어야 다시 12개월 중 남은 일수 없이 들어올 수 있습니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Common on multi-year Visitor (600) grants; compare 8573 (12 in 24 months) and 8575/8576.

scenarios.q_ko: 8558이 붙은 3년짜리 관광비자로 호주에 11개월 있다가 한국에 2주만 다녀오면 다시 1년 있을 수 있나요?
scenarios.q_en: If I stay 11 months on a 3-year Visitor visa with 8558, leave for 2 weeks, and return, can I stay another 12 months?
scenarios.a_ko: 아닙니다. 2주 뒤 재입국해 1개월만 더 지나도 직전 18개월 합산 체류가 12개월을 넘기 때문에 8558 위반(비자 취소 및 재입국 거부 사유)이 됩니다.
scenarios.a_en: No. Within about a month of returning, your rolling 18-month stay will exceed 12 months, breaching Condition 8558.

conditions.statutory_text: 8558The holder must not stay in Australia for more than 12 months in any period of 18 months.
statutory_paragraphs: 8558The holder must not stay in Australia for more than 12 months in any period of 18 months.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8558 - Non Resident
conditions.dha_web_summary: 8558 - Non Resident: Cannot stay for more than 12 months in any 18 month period.

conditions.title_ko: 난민 보호 인정 본국(박해국) 서면 승인 없이 입국 금지
conditions.title_en: No Entry to Country of Protection Reference Without Written Approval
conditions.summary_ko: 호주로부터 보호 의무(난민·보충적 보호)를 인정받았던 그 국가로 장관의 사전 서면 승인 없이 들어가서는 안 됩니다.
conditions.summary_en: You must not enter the country by reference to which protection obligations were found unless the Minister approves in writing.
forbidden_ko: 보호비자·인도적 비자 근거 국가로의 사전 서면 승인 없는 방문·귀국
forbidden_en: Travelling back to the country of claimed persecution without prior written ministerial approval
obligations_ko: 불가피한 사정으로 방문 시 출국 전 장관 서면 허가 확보
obligations_en: Obtain written ministerial permission before entering that country
exceptions_ko: 장관의 사전 서면 승인을 받은 경우
exceptions_en: Written approval by the Minister.
conditions.waiver_ko: 임시 보호(785/790) 등의 핵심 조건으로, 박해국 무단 귀국 시 비자 취소로 직결됩니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Applies to protection-related visas; unauthorised return undermines protection claims.

clause_notes_ko.text: 8570은 본국 금지 + 제3국 여행까지 승인제로 두는 반면, 8559는 박해국 입국 금지에 초점을 둡니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Compare 8570, which also restricts travel to any other country without compassionate/compelling approval.

conditions.statutory_text:
8559The holder must not enter the country by reference to which:
(a)the holder; or
(b)for a member of the family unit of another holder—the other holder;
was found to be a person to whom Australia has protection obligations unless the Minister has approved the entry in writing.
statutory_paragraphs: 8559The holder must not enter the country by reference to which:
(a)the holder; or
(b)for a member of the family unit of another holder—the other holder;
was found to be a person to whom Australia has protection obligations unless the Minister has approved the entry in writing.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8559 - Travel restriction
conditions.dha_web_summary:
​You must not enter the country from which you (or the primary visa holder, if you hold the visa as a family member) were found to engage Australia’s protection obligations, unless the Department approves the entry in writing.
If you travel to that country without our written approval, we might cancel your visa.
You can travel to any other country without our permission.
See how to
request permission to travel.

conditions.title_ko: 안보 우려 화학물질 취득 전 장관 사전승인 의무
conditions.title_en: Ministerial Approval Before Acquiring Security-Concern Chemicals
conditions.summary_ko: 호주 정부(COAG)가 안보 우려 물질로 지정한 산업·농약·수의약품 화학물질을 취득하기 전 장관 승인을 받아야 합니다.
conditions.summary_en: Obtain ministerial approval before acquiring chemicals of security concern specified by legislative instrument.
forbidden_ko: 고시된 안보 우려 화학물질 무단 구입·취득
forbidden_en: Acquiring listed security-concern chemicals without ministerial approval
obligations_ko: 해당 물질 취급·구입 필요 시 사전 승인 신청
obligations_en: Obtain approval prior to acquiring specified chemicals
exceptions_ko: 고시 대상이 아닌 일반 가정용 물품
exceptions_en: Only covers chemicals specified by the Minister's instrument.
conditions.waiver_ko: 050/070 안보 조건입니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Security condition on 050/070 bridging visas.

clause_notes_ko.text: 조문 주석에 소매·약국·수영장용 화학물질 및 농·수의용 화학물질 중 테러 전용 우려 품목을 언급하고 있습니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Applies to COAG-identified precursor chemicals.

conditions.statutory_text:
8560(1)The holder must obtain the Minister’s approval before acquiring chemicals of security concern.
(2)In this clause:
chemicals of security concern means chemicals specified by the Minister in an instrument in writing for this definition.
Note:The Minister’s instrument will refer to chemicals that have been identified, by the Council of Australian Governments, as chemicals of security concern. Without limiting what the Council might identify, the chemicals may include:
(a)industrial chemicals, including chemicals used in the retail, pharmaceutical or pool and spa sectors, that could be diverted from their lawful use to other purposes such as terroristrelated activities; and
(b)agricultural and veterinary chemicals that could be diverted from their lawful use to other purposes, including terroristrelated activities.
statutory_paragraphs: 8560(1)The holder must obtain the Minister’s approval before acquiring chemicals of security concern.
(2)In this clause:
chemicals of security concern means chemicals specified by the Minister in an instrument in writing for this definition.

Note:The Minister’s instrument will refer to chemicals that have been identified, by the Council of Australian Governments, as chemicals of security concern. Without limiting what the Council might identify, the chemicals may include:

(a)industrial chemicals, including chemicals used in the retail, pharmaceutical or pool and spa sectors, that could be diverted from their lawful use to other purposes such as terroristrelated activities; and
(b)agricultural and veterinary chemicals that could be diverted from their lawful use to other purposes, including terroristrelated activities.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8560 - Have approval before acquiring certain chemicals
conditions.dha_web_summary: You must have our approval before you acquire any chemicals of security concern.

conditions.title_ko: 장관 지시(ASIO 인터뷰 포함) 지정 일시·장소 면담 출석 의무
conditions.title_en: Attend Visa/ASIO Interview When Directed
conditions.summary_ko: 장관(구두 또는 서면)이 비자 관련 면담(호주 안보정보기구 ASIO 면담 포함) 출석을 지시하면 지정된 장소·일시에 반드시 응해야 합니다.
conditions.summary_en: If directed orally or in writing, attend an interview relating to your visa (including an ASIO interview) at the specified place, date, and time.
forbidden_ko: 비자·ASIO 면담 소환 지시 불응
forbidden_en: Failing to attend a directed visa or ASIO interview
obligations_ko: 지시받은 장소·날짜·시간에 성실 출석
obligations_en: Attend as directed
exceptions_ko: 없음
exceptions_en: None.
conditions.waiver_ko: 070 BVR·050 BVE 등에서 활용되는 인터뷰 응소 의무입니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Mandatory attendance when directed.

clause_notes_ko.text: 491/494의 일반 인터뷰 조항(8581)과 달리 ASIO 면담이 명시돼 있습니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Expressly encompasses ASIO interviews.

conditions.statutory_text: 8561If the holder is directed, orally or in writing, by the Minister to attend, at a specified place, on a specified day and at a specified time, an interview that relates to the holder’s visa (including an interview with the Australian Security Intelligence Organisation), the holder must comply with the direction.
statutory_paragraphs: 8561If the holder is directed, orally or in writing, by the Minister to attend, at a specified place, on a specified day and at a specified time, an interview that relates to the holder’s visa (including an interview with the Australian Security Intelligence Organisation), the holder must comply with the direction.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8561 - Must attend  interview as required
conditions.dha_web_summary: You must attend an interview related to your visa if we tell you to.

conditions.title_ko: 무기·폭발물 사용·접근 관련 직종 취업 금지
conditions.title_en: No Employment Involving Weapons or Explosives
conditions.summary_ko: 무기나 폭발물을 사용하거나 이에 접근할 수 있는 직업 또는 이와 유사한 직종에 취업해서는 안 됩니다.
conditions.summary_en: You must not take up employment in occupations involving the use of, or access to, weapons or explosives (or similar occupations).
forbidden_ko: 무기·폭발물 취급 또는 접근 가능 직무(광산 발파, 보안총기, 탄약 등) 취업
forbidden_en: Taking jobs involving use of or access to weapons or explosives
obligations_ko: 취업 전 해당 직무에 폭발물·무기 취급 포함 여부 확인
obligations_en: Avoid roles with access to weapons or explosives
exceptions_ko: 없음
exceptions_en: None.
conditions.waiver_ko: 050/070 등 공공안전 조건입니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Public-safety condition.

clause_notes_ko.text: 취업 자체를 막는 규정이며, 취득(8554)·훈련(8563)과 구분됩니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Bars employment access to weapons or explosives.

conditions.statutory_text:
8562(1)The holder must not take up employment in:
(a)occupations that involve the use of, or access to, weapons or explosives; or
(b)occupations of a similar kind.
(2)In this clause:
weapon means a thing made or adapted for use for inflicting bodily injury.
statutory_paragraphs: 8562(1)The holder must not take up employment in:

conditions.title_ko: 보호 의무 인정국 입국 절대 금지 + 기타 제3국 여행 사전 서면 승인

conditions.statutory_text:
8570The holder must not:
(a)enter a country by reference to which:
(i)the holder was found to be a person in respect of whom Australia has protection obligations; or
(ii)for a member of the family unit of another holder—the other holder was found to be a person in respect of whom Australia has protection obligations; or
(b)enter any other country unless:
(i)the Minister is satisfied that there are compassionate or compelling circumstances justifying the entry; and
(ii)the Minister has approved the entry in writing.
statutory_paragraphs: 8570The holder must not:
(a)enter a country by reference to which:
(i)the holder was found to be a person in respect of whom Australia has protection obligations; or
(ii)for a member of the family unit of another holder—the other holder was found to be a person in respect of whom Australia has protection obligations; or
(b)enter any other country unless:
(i)the Minister is satisfied that there are compassionate or compelling circumstances justifying the entry; and

conditions.dha_web_title: 8570 - Travel restriction

You must not enter the country from which you (or the primary visa holder, if you hold the visa as a family member) were found to engage Australia’s protection obligations.
You must not enter any other country unless we:

have given written approval
If you travel to any other country without our written approval, your visa may be cancelled.

Federal Register of Legislation.

statutory_paragraphs: 8573The holder must not stay in Australia for more than 12 months in any period of 24 months.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8573 - You must not stay in Australia for more than 12 months in 24 months
conditions.dha_web_summary:
You must not stay in Australia for more than 12 months in any 24-month period.
Calculate your maximum 12-month stay from the date you first arrive in Australia on the visa the condition applies to. Don’t include any time you are out of the country in your calculations. Resume the calculation from the date you return.
Any days you are in Australia must be included in your calculation, even if they are not consecutive. The 24-month period is any 24 consecutive months.
Work out how long you have stayed here
Write down the date you first arrived on the visa.
Count 24 months from the date you wrote in Step 1.
Ensure you have not stayed here more than 12 months in total within the 24-month time range.
If you stay in Australia for more than 12 months in total in a 24-month period we might cancel your visa and apply a re-entry ban.

obligations_en: Update ImmiAccount within 14 days for any change across items (a)–(f)
exceptions_ko: 없음
exceptions_en: None.
conditions.waiver_ko: 491·494 주·부신청자 모두 강제(cl 491.612, 494.612/613)이며, 추후 191 영주권 심사 시 8578·8579 준수 이력을 확인합니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Mandatory on 491 & 494; compliance history matters directly when applying for Subclass 191 PR.

clause_notes_ko.text: 특히 원격근무지 변경이나 새 여권 발급 시에도 14일 내 갱신을 놓치는 경우가 많습니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Covers both personal contact/passport changes and employer/workplace addresses.

statutory_paragraphs: 8578The holder must notify Immigration of a change to any of the following within 14 days after the change occurs:
(a)the holder’s residential address;
(b)an email address of the holder;
(c)a phone number of the holder;
(d)the holder’s passport details;
(e)the address of an employer of the holder;
(f)the address of the location of a position in which the holder is employed.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8578 - Notify us if your passport or contact details change
conditions.dha_web_summary:
You must let us know within 14 days if any of the following change while you are in Australia on this visa:
the address where you live
your email address
your phone number
your passport details including your name
your employer's address
the address where you work.

conditions.title_ko: 지정 지방(Designated Regional Area) 거주·근무·학업 의무 (491 · 494)
conditions.title_en: Live, Work & Study Only in Designated Regional Area (491 & 494)
conditions.summary_ko: 491(지방 기술이민)·494(지방 고용주 스폰서) 보유자 및 동반가족은 시드니·멜버른·브리즈번을 제외한 지정 지방 지역에서만 거주·근무·학업해야 합니다(우편번호 기준은 491은 비자 승인일, 494는 관련 노미네이션 신청일 기준).
conditions.summary_en: Mandatory on 491 & 494 (primary and dependants): live, work, and study ONLY in a designated regional area (as in force at visa grant for 491, or at nomination date for 494).
forbidden_ko: 시드니·멜버른·브리즈번 등 비지정 대도시에서 실거주, 근무(대도시 사무실 출근·재택 소속 포함 주의), 대면 학업
골드코스트·선샤인코스트·퍼스·애들레이드 등 지방 지정 지역을 벗어나 무단 거주
forbidden_en: Living, working, or studying in Sydney, Melbourne, or Brisbane (outside designated regional postcodes)
Relocating out of a regional area prior to Subclass 191 grant
obligations_ko: 주신청자와 동반가족 모두 주거·직장·학교를 모두 지정 지방 지역 안에 유지
494에서 스폰서 이직 시 새 노미네이션 기준일과 지방 거주 구간((2)-(5)) 연속 충족
obligations_en: Maintain residence, employment, and study inside designated regional postcodes throughout the visa period
exceptions_ko: 일시적 출장·휴가 방문은 허용되나, 대도시에 거처를 두거나 대도시 회사에 주된 근무지를 두면 위반 위험이 큼
exceptions_en: Short holidays/business trips are permitted, but maintaining a metro home/primary workplace risks breach.
conditions.waiver_ko: 491/494에서 191 영주권으로 전환하려면 8579 등 비자 조건 준수가 필수적입니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Mandatory condition on 491/494; compliance is scrutinised at Subclass 191 stage.

clause_notes_ko.text: 491 비자는 '비자 승인 시점'에 유효했던 지방 우편번호 고시가 고정 기준입니다.
494 비자는 '관련 노미네이션 신청 시점' 기준의 지방 지역을 적용하며, 스폰서를 변경해 후속 노미네이션을 받을 때 구간별 기준이 전환됩니다.

clause_notes_en.text: For 491, regional status is assessed against the instrument in force at visa grant.
For 494, regional status is anchored to when the relevant nomination was made, including subsequent nominations.

scenarios.q_ko: 491 비자로 골드코스트에 살면서 브리즈번 회사에 재택근무로 소속돼 일해도 되나요?
scenarios.q_en: On a 491 visa living in the Gold Coast, can I work remotely for an employer headquartered in Brisbane?
scenarios.a_ko: 매우 주의해야 합니다. 8579는 거주·근무·학업 모두 지정 지방 내일 것을 요구하므로, 고용주 사업장·계약상 근무지·업무 수행 장소가 브리즈번(비지방)으로 평가될 경우 위반 쟁점이 될 수 있어 계약 및 실근무 구조 사전 검토가 필수입니다.
scenarios.a_en: Proceed with extreme caution. Because 8579 requires living, working, and studying in a designated regional area, remote arrangements tied to a Brisbane office can raise compliance risks depending on employment terms and physical duties.

conditions.statutory_text:
8579(1)If the visa is a Subclass 491 (Skilled Work Regional (Provisional)) visa, the holder, while in Australia, must live, work and study only in a part of Australia that was a designated regional area at the time the visa was granted.
(2)If:
(a)the visa is a Subclass 494 (Skilled Employer Sponsored Regional (Provisional)) visa; and
(b)the holder is:
(i)a person (the primary person) who satisfied the primary criteria for the grant of the visa; or
(ii)a person who is a member of the family unit of a person (the primary person) who satisfied the primary criteria for the grant of a Subclass 494 (Skilled Employer Sponsored Regional (Provisional)) visa;
then, while in Australia during the regional residency period, the holder must live, work and study only in a part of Australia that was a designated regional area at the time the relevant nomination in relation to the primary person was made.
(3)For the purposes of subclause (2), the relevant nomination in relation to the primary person is:
(a)if the nomination (the first nomination) identified in the primary person’s application is the first and only nomination that has been approved under subsection 140GB(2) of the Act in relation to the primary person for the purposes of the visa—the first nomination; or
(b)if:
(i)after the first nomination was approved, another nomination (a later nomination) has been approved under that subsection in relation to the primary person for the purposes of the visa; and
(ii)the primary person has commenced work, as the holder of the visa, in the position associated with the occupation nominated by that later nomination;
that later nomination.
(4)If the relevant nomination in relation to the primary person is the first nomination, then, for the purposes of subclause (2), the regional residency period is the period that:
(a)starts:
(i)if the holder was in Australia at the time of grant—at that time; or
(ii)otherwise—at the time the holder first enters Australia as the holder of the visa; and
(b)ends:
(i)if another nomination is approved under subsection 140GB(2) of the Act in relation to the primary person for the purposes of the visa—at the end of the day before the day on which the primary person commences work, as the holder of the visa, in the position associated with the occupation nominated by that nomination; or
(ii)otherwise—at the time the holder’s visa ceases to have effect.
(5)If the relevant nomination in relation to the primary person is a later nomination, then, for the purposes of subclause (2), the regional residency period is the period that:
(a)starts at the start of the day on which the primary person commences work, as the holder of the visa, in the position associated with the occupation nominated by the later nomination; and
(b)ends:
(i)if another nomination is approved under subsection 140GB(2) of the Act in relation to the primary person for the purposes of the visa—at the end of the day before the day on which the primary person commences work, as the holder of the visa, in the position associated with the occupation nominated by that nomination; or
(ii)otherwise—at the time the holder’s visa ceases to have effect.
