conditions.dha_web_title: 8579 - Live, study and work in a designated regional area
conditions.dha_web_summary:
While you are in Australia, you must live, study and work in an area that is on the list of designated regional areas in an instrument.
If you hold a subclass 491 visa, the area must have been on the list of designated regional areas on the date we granted your visa.
If you hold a subclass 494 visa and you are a primary visa holder, the area must have been on the list of designated regional areas when your most recently approved nomination was lodged by your employer.
If you hold a subclass 494 visa and you are a secondary visa holder, the area must have been on the list of designated regional areas when the primary visa holder's most recently approved nomination was lodged by their employer.
Understanding your work rights
The Department is working with the Fair Work Ombudsman to help employees and employers understand and follow Australian Workplace laws.
Information on pay rates, shift calculations, leave arrangements and notice and redundancy entitlements is in the
Pay and Conditions Tool (PACT).
The Fair Work Ombudsman website has more information on workplace rights and entitlements for
visa holders and migrant workers.

conditions.title_ko: 이민성 서면 요구 시 28일 내 거주·직장·학교 주소 증빙 제출 (491 · 494)
conditions.title_en: Provide Address Evidence Within 28 Days When Requested (491/494)
conditions.summary_ko: 장관이 서면으로 요청할 경우 요청일로부터 28일 이내에 거주지 주소, 각 고용주·근무지 주소, 재학 교육기관 주소 증빙을 제출해야 합니다.
conditions.summary_en: Mandatory on 491 & 494: if requested in writing by the Minister, provide documentary evidence of your residential, employer, workplace, and/or school addresses within 28 days.
forbidden_ko: 이민성 실거주 증빙 요청 수령 후 28일 초과 미제출
forbidden_en: Failing to supply requested address evidence within 28 days of a written request
obligations_ko: 요청일 기준 28일 내 임대차계약서·공과금·급여명세서·재학증명 등 (a)-(d) 증빙 제출
obligations_en: Submit supporting address records (a)–(d) within 28 days of written notice
exceptions_ko: 서면 요청이 있는 경우에만 작동하나, 평소 지방 실거주·근무 증빙을 모아두어야 28일 내 대응 가능
exceptions_en: Triggered by written request; keep leases, payslips, and utility bills organised continuously.
conditions.waiver_en: Mandatory compliance-audit condition on 491 and 494.

clause_notes_ko.text: 임대계약·뱅크스테이트먼트·전기세·고용계약·학교 재학증명 등 지방 생활 증빙을 상시 보관하십시오.

clause_notes_en.text: Covers residence, employer head office, work site, and study institution addresses.

statutory_paragraphs: 8580If requested, in writing, by the Minister to do so, the holder must provide evidence of any or all of the following within 28 days after the date of the request:
(a)the holder’s residential address;
(b)the address of each employer of the holder;
(c)the address of each location of each position in which the holder is employed;
(d)the address of an educational institution attended by the holder.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8580 - Provide evidence of your live, study or work address if requested
conditions.dha_web_summary:
If we send you a letter asking you to, you must provide us with evidence of:
the address where you live
the address all your employers
the addresses where you work
the address of any school, college or university that you attend.
The letter will tell you what sort of evidence we need and how you should send it to us.
We might ask for evidence of all your addresses or only some of your addresses.
You will have 28 days to provide us with the evidence we have asked for.

conditions.title_ko: 이민성 서면 요구 시 지정 방식·일시 인터뷰 출석 의무 (491 · 494)
conditions.title_en: Attend Interview When Requested in Writing (491/494)
conditions.summary_ko: 이민성 장관이 서면으로 인터뷰 출석을 요청할 경우 지정된 장소·방식 및 일시에 면담에 응해야 합니다.
conditions.summary_en: Mandatory on 491 & 494: attend an interview in person or in the manner/time specified if requested in writing by the Minister.
forbidden_ko: 서면 인터뷰 통지에 정당한 사유 없이 불참
forbidden_en: Failing to attend a requested compliance interview
obligations_ko: (a) 지정 장소·시간 또는 (b) 지정 방식(화상·전화 등)·시간에 인터뷰 응소
obligations_en: Attend as directed under (a) or (b)
exceptions_ko: 없음
exceptions_en: None.
conditions.waiver_ko: 491·494 강제 부착 조건으로 지방 실제 정착 여부 확인용 면담 소환 권한입니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Mandatory interview-attendance condition on 491 and 494.

clause_notes_ko.text: 8578·8579·8580과 함께 491/494 지방 비자의 4대 필수 준수 조건을 이룹니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Forms the 4-condition regional audit framework alongside 8578, 8579, and 8580.

conditions.statutory_text:
8581If requested, in writing, by the Minister to do so, the holder must attend an interview:
(a)at a place and time specified in the request; or
(b)in a manner, and at a time, specified in the request.
statutory_paragraphs: 8581If requested, in writing, by the Minister to do so, the holder must attend an interview:
(a)at a place and time specified in the request; or
(b)in a manner, and at a time, specified in the request.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8581 - You must attend an interview if we ask you to in a letter
conditions.dha_web_summary: ​We might ask you to attend an interview at a specific address or we might conduct the interview over the phone or internet. The letter will contain the details of the interview time and how or where you must attend.

conditions.title_ko: 482(SID) 지명 직종·스폰서 전속 근무 및 180일/365일 유예 시계
conditions.title_en: 482 (SID) — Nominated Occupation, Employer & 180/365-Day Mobility Clock
conditions.summary_ko: 482 비자 주신청자 필수 조건으로, 최근 승인된 노미네이션의 지정 직종·스폰서(또는 연관법인)에서만 일해야 하며 퇴사·중단 시 1회 연속 최대 180일 · 비자 전체 기간 누적 최대 365일 유예 범위 내에서만 새 스폰서 승인을 기다릴 수 있습니다.
conditions.summary_en: Mandatory on primary Subclass 482 (SID): work only in your nominated occupation and sponsor's business (or associated entity), start within 90 days, keep mandatory licences, and do not cease work for more than 180 consecutive days or 365 days total.
forbidden_ko: 지정 직종 외 다른 직무·직업으로 임의 전환 또는 부업(ABN·투잡) 수행
새 고용주 노미네이션이 '승인'되기 전에 새 직장으로 먼저 출근해 근무 시작 (접수만으론 불가, 단 180일/365일 유예 기간 중 합법적 타 직종 근로는 별도 쟁점 — 조문 (5) 확인)
연속 180일 초과 또는 비자 총 기간 누적 365일 초과 미근무(186 TRT 경력 산정 공백도 별도 주의)
forbidden_en: Working in a non-nominated occupation or running side work/ABN while employed by your sponsor
Exceeding 180 consecutive days or 365 cumulative days without working in accordance with subclauses (1) and (2)
Working without holding a mandatory occupational licence/registration
obligations_ko: (4) 승인(국내) 또는 입국(해외) 후 90일 내 근무 개시
(5) 퇴사·휴직 등으로 지정 근무 중단 시 연속 180일·비자 전체 누적 365일 이내 새 노미네이션 승인 또는 새 비자 취득
(6) 필수 면허·등록 90일 내 취득 및 취소·거절 시 지체 없이 이민성 서면 통지
obligations_en: Commence work within 90 days (4); keep cessation within 180 consecutive / 365 total days (5); hold and maintain any mandatory licence within 90 days and notify Immigration promptly if refused/revoked (6)
exceptions_ko: (3)(a) reg 2.72(13) 고시 예외 직종(CEO·의료인 등)
(3)(b) 노동법상 퇴사 예고 기간(notice period) 이행을 위해 기존 고용주에게 계속 근무하는 경우
(5) 2024년 7월 1일 이후 개시된 180일/365일 유예 기간 중에는 생계 등을 위해 타 직종·타 고용주 근무가 조건 위반으로 간주되지 않도록 개정됨(단, 해당 기간은 186 TRT 2년 경력에는 산입되지 않을 수 있음)
exceptions_en: (3)(a) Exempt occupations under reg 2.72(13) legislative instrument
(3)(b) Working out a statutory/industrial notice period

(5) Post-1 July 2024 mobility reform allows up to 180 consecutive / 365 total days of cessation (and working for other employers during that window) without breaching 8607, though note 186 TRT counting impacts
conditions.waiver_ko: 웨이버 규정이 없으므로 직종이나 고용주를 바꾸려면 새 노미네이션 승인(고용주 변경) 또는 새 482 비자(직종 변경)가 필요합니다.
conditions.waiver_en: No waiver; changing occupations requires a new 482 visa, and changing employers requires an approved nomination (unless exempt under (3)(a)).

clause_notes_ko.text: Labour Agreement 스트림은 노미네이션 당사자에게만, Core/Specialist Skills 스트림은 호주 내 승인 스폰서 또는 연관법인(associated entity) 근무를 허용합니다(해외 사업체 스폰서 제외).
입국·승인 후 90일 내 착수 의무((4))와, 종전 60일에서 대폭 늘어난 연속 180일 / 누적 365일 유예 시계((5))를 규정합니다.
호주에서 법적으로 면허·자격 등록이 필수인 직종(예: 의사·간호사·전기기술자·배관 등)은 90일 내 면허 취득 및 정지·거절 시 이민성 통지 의무가 있습니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Distinguishes Labour Agreement, Overseas Business Sponsor, and Australian Sponsor (including associated entities).
90-day commencement rule and the 180-consecutive / 365-total day cessation mobility window.
90-day licensing requirement and mandatory written notification to Immigration if any mandatory authorisation is refused or revoked.

scenarios.q_en: Can I drive Uber or do casual work during the 180-day 8607 grace period after leaving my 482 sponsor?

conditions.statutory_text:
8607(1)The holder must work only in the occupation (the nominated occupation) nominated by the nomination identified in the application for the most recent Subclass 482 (Skills in Demand) visa granted to the holder.
(2)Unless subclause (3) applies, the holder must:
(a)if the most recent Subclass 482 (Skills in Demand) visa granted to the holder is in the Labour Agreement stream—work only for the person who nominated the nominated occupation; or
(b)if the most recent Subclass 482 (Skills in Demand) visa granted to the holder is in the Specialist Skills stream or Core Skills stream and the person who nominated the nominated occupation was an overseas business sponsor at the time the nomination was approved—work only in a position in the person’s business; or
(c)if the most recent Subclass 482 (Skills in Demand) visa granted to the holder is in the Specialist Skills stream or Core Skills stream and the person who nominated the nominated occupation was not an overseas business sponsor at the time the nomination was approved—work only in a position in the person’s business or a business of an associated entity of the person.
(3)This subclause applies if:
(a)the nominated occupation is an occupation specified by the Minister in an instrument made under subregulation 2.72(13); or
(b)the holder is continuing to work for a person for the purpose of fulfilling a requirement under a law relating to industrial relations and relating to the giving of notice.
(4)Subject to subclause (6), the holder must commence work within:
(a)if the holder was outside Australia when the visa was granted—90 days after the holder’s arrival in Australia; or
(b)if the holder was in Australia when the visa was granted—90 days after the holder’s visa was granted.
(5)The holder may cease to work in accordance with subclauses (1) and (2) for a period, but:
(a)any such period must not exceed 180 consecutive days; and
(b)the total number of days on which the holder does not work in accordance with subclauses (1) and (2) must not exceed 365 during the visa period for the holder’s visa.
(6)If the holder is required to hold a licence, registration or membership (an authorisation) that is mandatory to perform the nominated occupation in the location where the holder’s position is situated, the holder must:
(a)hold the authorisation within:
(i)if the holder was outside Australia when the visa was granted—90 days after the holder’s arrival in Australia; or
(ii)if the holder was in Australia when the visa was granted—90 days after the holder’s visa was granted; and
(b)continue to hold the authorisation while the holder is performing the occupation; and
(c)notify Immigration, in writing, as soon as practicable if an application for the authorisation is refused; and
(d)comply with each condition or requirement to which the authorisation is subject; and
(e)not engage in work that is inconsistent with the authorisation, including any conditions or requirements to which the authorisation is subject; and
(f)notify Immigration, in writing, as soon as practicable if the authorisation ceases to be in force or is revoked or cancelled.

conditions.dha_web_title: 8607 - Must only work in nominated occupation
conditions.dha_web_summary:
You must only work in the occupation nominated in your most recently granted Temporary Skill Shortage (subclass 482) or Skills in Demand (subclass 482) visa. You cannot work in a different occupation unless you apply for, and we grant you, a new Skills in Demand (subclass 482) visa.
Note that on 7 December 2024, the Skills in Demand (subclass 482) visa replaced the Temporary Skills Shortage (subclass 482) visa.
You must only work for the business that nominated you, unless you have an exemption.
If you have an Australian business sponsor and we granted your visa in one of the following streams, you can also work for an associated entity of your sponsor:
Short-term or Medium-term stream of the Temporary Skill Shortage (subclass 482) visa
Specialist Skills or Core Skills stream of the Skills in Demand (subclass 482) visa.
If you want to change your employer, your new employer must get a nomination approved before you can start work for them.
If your employment with your sponsor ends, you can stop working, or work outside of the above conditions for:
up to 180 days in a single period
up to 365 days in total across the period we grant your visa for.
These time periods start from 1 July 2024. They do not include any earlier periods of time when you stopped working under the condition in place before that date.
You can work for other businesses if:
the occupation is specified by the minister in an instrument
your employment is ending, and you are finishing a notice period.
You must start work within 90 days of:
arriving in Australia, if you were outside Australia when we granted your visa
us granting your visa, if you were in Australia when we granted your visa.
Find out what to do if your situation changes.
Licenses, registrations and memberships
You must hold any licence, registration or membership for the job we granted your visa for, if it is mandatory, and you must comply with its provisions.
You must not work if it is illegal to do the job we granted your visa for without a licence, registration or membership. You must not do work that is inconsistent with your licence, registration or membership.
You must hold the mandatory licence, registration or membership within 90 days of:
arriving in Australia, if you were outside Australia when we granted your visa.
us granting your visa, if you were in Australia when we granted your visa.
You must let us know in writing as soon as you can if the licence, registration or membership ends or is refused, cancelled or revoked.
Email sponsor.notifications@abf.gov.au.
Understanding your work rights
The department is working with the Fair Work Ombudsman to help employees and employers understand and follow Australian Workplace laws.
Information on pay rates, shift calculations, leave arrangements and notice and redundancy entitlements is in the Pay and Conditions Tool (PACT).
The Fair Work Ombudsman website has more information on workplace rights and entitlements for visa holders and migrant workers.​

conditions.dha_web_title: 8608 - Must work only in the nominated occupation
conditions.dha_web_summary:
You must work only in the occupation nominated in your most recent Subclass 494 (Skilled Employer Sponsored Regional (Provisional)) visa application. You cannot work in a different occupation unless you apply for and are granted a new Skilled Employer Sponsored Regional (Provisional) visa.
Unless an exemption applies, you can only work:
for the business that nominated you, if your visa was granted under a Labour agreement
for the business that nominated you or an associated entity, if your visa was granted under a Standard Business Sponsorship.
If you want to change your employer, your new proposed employer must get a nomination approved before you can start work for them.
If your employment with your sponsor ends, you can stop working or work outside of the above conditions for a limited time:
up to 180 days in a single period
up to 365 days in total across the period your visa is granted for.
These time periods start from 1 July 2024. They do not include any earlier periods of time when you stopped working under the condition in place before that date.
You can work for other businesses if:
the occupation is specified by the Minister in an instrument
your employment is ending, and you are serving out a notice period.
You must start work within 90 days of:
arriving in Australia, if you were outside Australia when the visa was granted
being granted your visa, if you were in Australia when the visa was granted.
Find out what to do if your situation changes.
Licenses, registrations and memberships
If it is mandatory to have a licence, registration or membership to do the job we granted you the visa to do you must hold that licence, registration or membership and comply with its provisions.
If it is illegal to do the job you were granted you the visa to do without a licence, registration or membership, you must not work. You must not do work that is inconsistent with the licence, registration or membership.
You must hold the mandatory licence, registration or membership within 90 days of:
arriving in Australia, if you were outside Australia when the visa was granted.
being granted the visa, if you were in Australia when it was granted.
You must let us know in writing as soon as you can if the licence, registration or membership ends, or is cancelled, refused or revoked.
Email sponsor.notifications@abf.gov.au.
Understanding your work rights
The Department is working with the Fair Work Ombudsman to help employees and employers understand and follow Australian Workplace laws.
Information on pay rates, shift calculations, leave arrangements and notice and redundancy entitlements is in the Pay and Conditions Tool (PACT).
The Fair Work Ombudsman website has more information on workplace rights and entitlements for visa holders and migrant workers​

clause_notes_en.text: Distinguishes regional centre/other regional area (cl 485.232/234) from designated regional area (cl 485.233/235).

conditions.statutory_text:
8610(1)If the visa is a Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate) visa in the PostHigher Education Work stream that was granted on the basis that the holder met the requirements of clause 485.232 or 485.234 of Schedule 2, the holder, while in Australia, must live, work and study only in a part of Australia that was a regional centre or other regional area at the time the visa was granted.
(2)If the visa is a Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate) visa granted on the basis of satisfying the secondary criteria in relation to a primary applicant mentioned in subclause (1), the holder, while in Australia, must live, work and study only in a part of Australia that was a regional centre or other regional area at the time the visa was granted.
(3)If the visa is a Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate) visa in the PostHigher Education Work stream that was granted on the basis that the holder met the requirements of clause 485.233 or 485.235 of Schedule 2, the holder, while in Australia, must live, work and study only in a part of Australia that was a designated regional area at the time the visa was granted.
(4)If the visa is a Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate) visa granted on the basis of satisfying the secondary criteria in relation to a primary applicant mentioned in subclause (3), the holder, while in Australia, must live, work and study only in a part of Australia that was a designated regional area at the time the visa was granted.
statutory_paragraphs: 8610(1)If the visa is a Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate) visa in the PostHigher Education Work stream that was granted on the basis that the holder met the requirements of clause 485.232 or 485.234 of Schedule 2, the holder, while in Australia, must live, work and study only in a part of Australia that was a regional centre or other regional area at the time the visa was granted.

(2)If the visa is a Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate) visa granted on the basis of satisfying the secondary criteria in relation to a primary applicant mentioned in subclause (1), the holder, while in Australia, must live, work and study only in a part of Australia that was a regional centre or other regional area at the time the visa was granted.

(3)If the visa is a Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate) visa in the PostHigher Education Work stream that was granted on the basis that the holder met the requirements of clause 485.233 or 485.235 of Schedule 2, the holder, while in Australia, must live, work and study only in a part of Australia that was a designated regional area at the time the visa was granted.

(4)If the visa is a Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate) visa granted on the basis of satisfying the secondary criteria in relation to a primary applicant mentioned in subclause (3), the holder, while in Australia, must live, work and study only in a part of Australia that was a designated regional area at the time the visa was granted.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8610 - Live, work and study only in designated regional area
conditions.dha_web_summary:
While you are in Australia, you must live, work and study in a designated regional area.
If you hold a second subclass 485 Post-Higher Education Work stream visa or second subclass 485 Post-Study Work stream visa, the area must have been a designated regional area on the date this visa was granted.
Understanding your work rights
The Department is working with the Fair Work Ombudsman to help employees and employers understand and follow Australian Workplace laws.
Information on pay rates, shift calculations, leave arrangements and notice and redundancy entitlements is in the Pay and Conditions Tool (PACT).
The Fair Work Ombudsman website has more information on workplace rights and entitlements for visa holders and migrant workers.​

conditions.title_ko: PALM 스킴(403 태평양노동이동) 스폰서·DEWR 승인 배치 외 근로·자영 금지
conditions.title_en: PALM Scheme (403) — Work Only for Sponsor / DEWR-Endorsed Arrangement
conditions.summary_ko: Subclass 403 PALM(Pacific Australia Labour Mobility) 비자 보유자는 지정 스폰서 또는 담당 부처(DEWR)가 승인한 재배치 약정 외에는 일할 수 없으며 개인 자영업(on own account)도 금지됩니다.
conditions.summary_en: Subclass 403 PALM stream workers must only work for their sponsor or under a DEWR-endorsed arrangement and must never work on their own account.
forbidden_ko: (a) 미승인 타 사업장 이직·투잡
(b) 개인 ABN 등 자영업 활동
forbidden_en: Working outside the approved sponsor/DEWR arrangement or working on one's own account
obligations_ko: PALM 스폰서 및 정부 승인 배치 조건 내 근무
obligations_en: Remain within approved PALM sponsor or DEWR arrangements
exceptions_ko: DEWR이 공식 승인한 스폰서 간 재배치(endorsed arrangement)
exceptions_en: Reallocation endorsed by the administering Department (DEWR).
conditions.waiver_ko: 403 PALM 스트림 전용 근로 조건입니다(이민성 웹의 구 8577을 대체).
conditions.waiver_en: Current statutory PALM condition (superseding legacy 8577).

clause_notes_ko.text: 이민성 웹에는 구 8577이 남아 있으나 현행 Schedule 8의 현업 조문은 8611입니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Replaces older legacy 403 seasonal worker conditions.

conditions.statutory_text:
8611If the visa is a Subclass 403 visa in the Pacific Australia Labour Mobility stream, the holder:
(a)must not work other than:
(i)for the holder’s sponsor in relation to the visa; or
(ii)for another person in accordance with an arrangement endorsed by a Department responsible for administering the scheme known as the Pacific Australia Labour Mobility scheme; and
(b)must not engage in work on the holder’s own account.
statutory_paragraphs: 8611If the visa is a Subclass 403 visa in the Pacific Australia Labour Mobility stream, the holder:
(a)must not work other than:
(i)for the holder’s sponsor in relation to the visa; or
(ii)for another person in accordance with an arrangement endorsed by a Department responsible for administering the scheme known as the Pacific Australia Labour Mobility scheme; and
(b)must not engage in work on the holder’s own account.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8611 - Work limitation
conditions.dha_web_summary:
You must continue to be employed by your approved sponsor or another employer in​ accordance with an arrangement by the Department of Employment and Workplace Relations (DEWR) for the duration of your visa.
Unless approved under an arrangement with​ DEWR, y​ou must not:
work for any other sponsor
change employers, unless approved by an arrangement with DEWR​
work for yourself
do any work that does not fit the purpose of your visa
Understanding your work rights
The Department is working with the Fair Work Ombudsman to help employees and employers understand and follow Australian Workplace laws.
Information on pay rates, shift calculations, leave arrangements and notice and redundancy entitlements is in the
Pay and Conditions Tool (PACT).
The Fair Work Ombudsman website has more information on workplace rights and entitlements for
visa holders and migrant workers.
For the full list of conditions relevant to your visa, see the Federal Register of Legislation.​

conditions.title_ko: 동거인 성명·생년월일 신고(승인 5영업일 내) 및 변동 시 2영업일 내 통지
conditions.title_en: Notify Household Members Within 5 Working Days & Changes Within 2 Working Days
conditions.summary_ko: 같은 거주지 주소에 통상 함께 사는 모든 동거인의 성명과 생년월일을 승인 후 5영업일 내에 신고하고, 동거인이 바뀌면 2영업일 내에 이민성에 알려야 합니다(070 BVR).
conditions.summary_en: Notify Immigration of the full name and date of birth of every person ordinarily residing at your address within 5 working days of grant, and any change within 2 working days (070 BVR).
forbidden_ko: 동거인 명단·변동 신고 기한 도과 또는 누락
forbidden_en: Failing to declare household residents within 5 working days or changes within 2 working days
obligations_ko: (a) 승인 5영업일 내 동거인 전원 성명·생년월일 제출
(b) 동거 변동 후 2영업일 내 신고
obligations_en: Report household residents within 5 working days (a) and updates within 2 working days (b)
exceptions_ko: 없음
exceptions_en: None.
conditions.waiver_ko: 070 BVR(강제퇴거 대기 브리징) 거주 관리 조건입니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Subclass 070 BVR household reporting rule.

clause_notes_ko.text: 8612~8626은 070 BVR(Removal Pending)에서 사회 내 안전·소재 관리를 위해 부과되는 특화 조항군입니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Part of the 070 BVR monitoring suite.

conditions.statutory_text:
8612The holder:
(a)must, within 5 working days of the grant, notify Immigration of the full name, and date of birth, of each person who ordinarily resides with the holder at the holder’s residential address; and
(b)must notify Immigration of any change in the persons who ordinarily reside with the holder at the holder’s residential address within 2 working days after the change occurs.
statutory_paragraphs: 8612The holder:
(a)must, within 5 working days of the grant, notify Immigration of the full name, and date of birth, of each person who ordinarily resides with the holder at the holder’s residential address; and
(b)must notify Immigration of any change in the persons who ordinarily reside with the holder at the holder’s residential address within 2 working days after the change occurs.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8612 - Notify Immigration of your household members
conditions.dha_web_summary:
You must notify Immigration of the full name and date of birth of each person who lives at your address within 5 working days of being granted your visa.
You must notify Immigration of any change in persons who live at your address within 2 working days after the change occurs.​

conditions.title_ko: 주(State) 경계 이동 또는 해외 출국 최소 7영업일 전 사전 신고 (070 BVR)
conditions.title_en: Notify Interstate or Overseas Travel at Least 7 Working Days Before
conditions.summary_ko: 호주 내 다른 주(State/Territory)로 이동하거나 해외로 출국하려면 출발 최소 7영업일 전에 이민성에 사전 통지해야 합니다.
conditions.summary_en: Notify Immigration of any interstate or overseas travel at least 7 working days before undertaking the travel.
forbidden_ko: 7영업일 전 사전 신고 없이 타 주 이동 또는 출국
forbidden_en: Travelling interstate or overseas without 7 working days' advance notice
obligations_ko: 타 주·해외 이동 예정일 기준 최소 7영업일 전 이민성 통지
obligations_en: Give at least 7 working days' prior notice before interstate/international travel
exceptions_ko: 없음
exceptions_en: None.
conditions.waiver_ko: 070 BVR 이동 관리 조건입니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Applies on Subclass 070 BVR.

clause_notes_ko.text: 같은 주(State) 내 단거리 이동이 아니라 주 경계를 넘는(interstate) 여행 및 해외 출국에 적용됩니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Triggered by interstate or international travel.

conditions.statutory_text: 8614The holder must notify Immigration of any travel interstate or overseas by the holder at least 7 working days before undertaking the travel.
statutory_paragraphs: 8614The holder must notify Immigration of any travel interstate or overseas by the holder at least 7 working days before undertaking the travel.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8614 - Notify of travel
conditions.dha_web_summary: ​​Must notify of travel interstate or overseas 7 days before the travel.​​

conditions.title_ko: 미성년자·취약계층 접촉 단체 가입·연계 신고 (5영업일 / 변경 2영업일)
conditions.title_en: Notify Association With Minors/Vulnerable-Person Organisations
conditions.summary_ko: 미성년자나 취약계층과 우연적 수준을 넘는 접촉을 하는 단체와의 연계·가입 내역을 승인 5영업일 내 신고하고, 가입·탈퇴 변동 시 2영업일 내 통지해야 합니다(정치·정부 소통 목적 단체 제외).
conditions.summary_en: Notify Immigration within 5 working days (and changes within 2 working days) of any association/membership with an organisation involving more than incidental contact with minors or vulnerable persons (political communication bodies exempt).
forbidden_ko: 해당 단체 가입·연계·탈퇴 내역 기한 내 미신고
forbidden_en: Failing to report qualifying associations within 5 working days or changes within 2 working days
obligations_ko: (1)(a)-(b) 5영업일 내 최초 신고 및 변동 후 2영업일 내 신고
obligations_en: Report within 5 working days of grant (a) and 2 working days of any change (b)
exceptions_ko: (2)(a)-(b) 정부·정치적 사안에 관한 소통을 목적 또는 주기능으로 하는 단체는 제외
exceptions_en: (2) Organisations engaged in governmental or political communications.
conditions.waiver_ko: 070 BVR 아동·취약계층 보호 연계 조항입니다(실제 근무·봉사 금지는 8622).
conditions.waiver_en: Reporting rule complementing Condition 8622's substantive prohibition.

clause_notes_ko.text: 헌법적 정치 소통 자유를 고려한 (2)항 예외를 두고 있습니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Includes implied-freedom political communication carve-out in (2).

conditions.statutory_text:
8615(1)The holder must:
(a)within 5 working days of the grant, notify Immigration of the details of the holder’s association with, or membership of, any organisation that engages in activities involving more than incidental contact with minors or vulnerable persons (within the meaning of Part 070 of Schedule 2); and
(b)notify Immigration of any change in those details (including the beginning or end of any association or membership) within 2 working days after the change occurs.
(2)Subclause (1) does not apply in relation to the following:
(a)an organisation formed for a purpose of engaging in communications on governmental or political matters;
(b)an organisation whose regular functions or activities involve communications on governmental or political matters.
statutory_paragraphs: 8615(1)The holder must:

(a)within 5 working days of the grant, notify Immigration of the details of the holder’s association with, or membership of, any organisation that engages in activities involving more than incidental contact with minors or vulnerable persons (within the meaning of Part 070 of Schedule 2); and
(b)notify Immigration of any change in those details (including the beginning or end of any association or membership) within 2 working days after the change occurs.
(2)Subclause (1) does not apply in relation to the following:
(a)an organisation formed for a purpose of engaging in communications on governmental or political matters;
(b)an organisation whose regular functions or activities involve communications on governmental or political matters.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8615 - Notify Immigration of association with any organisation that engages in activities involving more than incidental contact with minors and vulnerable people
conditions.dha_web_summary:
You must notify Immigration of the details of any association you have with any organisation, including membership of an organisation within 5 days of being granted your visa.
You must notify Immigration of any change in these details within 2 days of the change occurring.

conditions.title_ko: 형사 기소·유죄 전과자와의 접촉 신고 의무 (치료·법률·우연 접촉 제외)
conditions.title_en: Notify Contact With Persons Charged/Convicted of Criminal Offences
conditions.summary_ko: 본인이 형사 기소되었거나 유죄 판결을 받은 사실을 아는 인물과 접촉한 세부 사항을 이민성에 통지해야 합니다(치료·재활·법률절차·우연적 접촉 제외).
conditions.summary_en: Notify Immigration of details of any contact with a person you know has been charged with or convicted of a criminal offence (excluding therapy, legal proceedings/advice, and incidental contact).
forbidden_ko: 치료·법률·단순 스침이 아닌 형사 전과/기소 인물과의 실질적 교류 미신고
forbidden_en: Unreported non-incidental contact with known charged/convicted individuals
obligations_ko: 해당 접촉 발생 시 이민성에 접촉 내역 통지
obligations_en: Report non-exempt contact to Immigration
exceptions_ko: (2)(a) 치료·재활 서비스 이용 중 접촉, (b) 소송·법률자문 관련 접촉, (c) 우연적·스쳐가는 접촉(incidental contact)
exceptions_en: (2) Therapeutic/rehabilitative services, legal proceedings/advice, and incidental contact.
conditions.waiver_ko: 070 BVR 조건입니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Subclass 070 BVR compliance condition.

clause_notes_ko.text: 변호사·재판·치료 과정 접촉 및 우발적 만남은 예외로 보호됩니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Explicitly carves out legal advice, therapy, and incidental encounters.

conditions.statutory_text:
8616(1)The holder must notify Immigration of the details of any contact with any individual who is known by the holder to have been charged with, or convicted of, a criminal offence.
(2)Subclause (1) does not apply to:
(a)contact in the course of attending a therapeutic or rehabilitative service; or
(b)contact in connection with legal proceedings or legal advice; or
(c)incidental contact.
statutory_paragraphs: 8616(1)The holder must notify Immigration of the details of any contact with any individual who is known by the holder to have been charged with, or convicted of, a criminal offence.
(2)Subclause (1) does not apply to:
(a)contact in the course of attending a therapeutic or rehabilitative service; or
(b)contact in connection with legal proceedings or legal advice; or
(c)incidental contact.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8616 - Notify Immigration of contacts
conditions.dha_web_summary:
You must notify Immigration of any contact you have with any person who has been charged with, or convicted of, a criminal offence.
This does not apply to:
Contact in the course of attending a therapeutic or rehabilitation service; or
Contact in connection with legal proceedings or legal advice; or
Incidental contact.​

conditions.title_ko: 30일 내 AUD 10,000 이상 수취·송금 발생 후 5영업일 내 신고
conditions.title_en: Notify AUD 10,000+ Transfers Received or Sent Within 5 Working Days
conditions.summary_ko: 임의의 30일 기간 동안 타인으로부터 합계 AUD 10,000 이상을 받거나 타인에게 합계 AUD 10,000 이상을 이체한 경우 발생 후 5영업일 이내에 이민성에 신고해야 합니다.
conditions.summary_en: Notify Immigration within 5 working days if you receive or transfer amounts totalling AUD 10,000 or more within any 30-day period.
forbidden_ko: 30일 누적 AUD 10,000 이상 입금·송금 후 5영업일 내 미신고 (분할 송금 포함 합산)
forbidden_en: Failing to report cumulative 30-day receipts or transfers of AUD 10,000+ within 5 working days
obligations_ko: (a) 30일 내 AUD 10,000+ 수취 및 (b) 30일 내 AUD 10,000+ 이체 발생 시 5영업일 내 통지
obligations_en: Report within 5 working days of reaching AUD 10,000+ in any 30-day window
exceptions_ko: 없음 (1건이 아니라 30일 합산액 기준)
exceptions_en: Aggregated over any rolling 30-day period.
conditions.waiver_ko: 070 BVR 금융 추적 조건입니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Subclass 070 BVR financial-monitoring condition.

clause_notes_ko.text: 한 번에 만 달러가 아니라 '30일 합계(totalling AUD 10,000 or more)' 기준임에 유의하십시오.

clause_notes_en.text: Aggregates amounts across any 30-day window.

statutory_paragraphs: 8617The holder must notify Immigration of each of the following matters within 5 working days after the matter occurs:
(a)the holder receives, within any period of 30 days, an amount or amounts totalling AUD10 000 or more from one or more other persons;
(b)the holder transfers, within any period of 30 days, an amount or amounts totalling AUD10 000 or more to one or more other persons.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8617 - Notify Immigration of finances

conditions.title_ko: AUD 10,000 이상 채무 발생·파산 선고·중대한 변동 5영업일 내 신고
conditions.title_en: Notify AUD 10,000+ Debt, Bankruptcy or Significant Changes Within 5 Working Days
conditions.summary_ko: AUD 10,000 이상의 채무를 부담하거나 파산 선고를 받거나 채무·파산 상태에 중대한 변동이 생기면 5영업일 이내에 이민성에 신고해야 합니다.
conditions.summary_en: Notify Immigration within 5 working days if you incur debts totalling AUD 10,000+, are declared bankrupt, or have any significant change in your debts/bankruptcy.
forbidden_ko: AUD 10,000 이상 채무 발생, 파산 선고 또는 주요 변동 후 5영업일 초과 미신고
forbidden_en: Failing to report AUD 10,000+ debts, bankruptcy, or significant debt changes within 5 working days
obligations_ko: (1) AUD 10,000+ 채무, (2) 파산 선고, (3) 주요 변동 모두 발생일 후 5영업일 내 신고
obligations_en: Notify within 5 working days for (1) debts >= AUD 10,000, (2) bankruptcy, or (3) significant changes
exceptions_ko: 없음
exceptions_en: None.
conditions.waiver_ko: 070 BVR 금융 건전성·신용 보고 조건입니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Subclass 070 BVR debt and bankruptcy reporting condition.

clause_notes_ko.text: 이민성 웹의 구 8619('7일 내 재정보고')는 현행 Schedule 8에서 8617·8618 체계로 정비되었습니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Replaces legacy Condition 8619.

conditions.statutory_text:
8618(1)If the holder incurs a debt or debts totalling AUD10 000 or more, the holder must notify Immigration within 5 working days after the holder incurs the debt or debts.
(2)If the holder is declared bankrupt, the holder must notify Immigration within 5 working days after the holder is so declared.
(3)The holder must notify Immigration of any significant change in relation to the holder’s debts or bankruptcy within 5 working days after the change occurs.
statutory_paragraphs: 8618(1)If the holder incurs a debt or debts totalling AUD10 000 or more, the holder must notify Immigration within 5 working days after the holder incurs the debt or debts.
(2)If the holder is declared bankrupt, the holder must notify Immigration within 5 working days after the holder is so declared.
(3)The holder must notify Immigration of any significant change in relation to the holder’s debts or bankruptcy within 5 working days after the change occurs.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8618 - Notify Immigration of debts
conditions.dha_web_summary:
You must notify Immigration within five working days of incurring a debt, or debts, totalling AUD $10,000 or more.
You must notify Immigration within 5 working days if you are declared bankrupt.
You must notify Immigration of any significant change in relation to your debts or bankruptcy within 5 working days.

conditions.title_ko: 야간 통행금지 (밤 10시~오전 6시 신고 주소지 체류 의무 · 070 BVR)
conditions.title_en: Curfew Requirement (10pm–6am at Notified Address · 070 BVR)
conditions.summary_ko: 특별히 장관이 다른 8시간 이내 시간대를 서면 지정하지 않는 한 매일 밤 10시부터 다음 날 오전 6시까지 신고된 주소지에 머물러야 합니다(병원 입원·구금 기간 예외).
conditions.summary_en: Remain at your notified address between 10 pm and 6 am (or another ministerial window up to 8 hours), subject to reg 2.25AF arrest/hospital exemptions.
forbidden_ko: 통행금지 시간(기본 22:00~06:00) 중 사전 신고 없는 주소지 이탈
forbidden_en: Being away from your notified address during curfew hours without prior notice
obligations_ko: (1)-(3) 8513/8625 주소, 사전 신고한 친밀 관계자 거처, 또는 전날 낮 12시(정오)까지 사전 통보한 임시 주소에 야간 체류
obligations_en: Stay overnight at your primary notified address, registered close-relationship address, or an address notified before 12 pm the day prior
exceptions_ko: Note(reg 2.25AF): 체포·구금 중이거나 병원·정신건강시설 입원 치료 중에는 조건 미적용 간주
(3)(c) 전날 정오(12 pm)까지 사전에 다른 체류 주소를 통지한 경우 그 주소 체류 가능
exceptions_en: reg 2.25AF suspends curfew while in custody or admitted as a hospital inpatient; (3)(c) allows temporary overnight addresses notified by 12 pm the day before.
conditions.waiver_ko: 현행 Schedule 8에는 존재하지만 이민성 conditions-list 웹 API에는 아직 누락된 중요 조항입니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Present in Schedule 8 (F2026C01194), though currently omitted from Home Affairs' web conditions-list API.

conditions.statutory_text:
8620(1)The holder must, between 10 pm on one day and 6 am the next day or between such other times as are specified in writing by the Minister, remain at a notified address for the holder for those days.
(2)If the Minister specifies other times for the purposes of subclause (1), the times must not be more than 8 hours apart.
(3)In this clause:
notified address for a holder for a particular day or days means any of the following:
(a)either:
(i)the address notified by the holder under condition 8513; or
(ii)if the holder has notified another address under condition 8625—the last address so notified by the holder;
(b)an address at which the holder stays regularly because of a close personal relationship with a person at that address, and which the holder has notified to Immigration for the purposes of this paragraph;
(c)if, for the purposes of this paragraph, the holder notifies Immigration of an address for that day or those days no later than 12 pm on the day before that day or the earliest day of those days (as the case may be)—that address.
Note:Under regulation 2.25AF, a visa is taken to not be subject to this condition during any period in which the visa holder is:
(a)under arrest or detained in custody; or
(b)admitted as an inpatient to receive treatment at a public or private hospital, registered mental health facility or other registered medical facility.
statutory_paragraphs: 8620(1)The holder must, between 10 pm on one day and 6 am the next day or between such other times as are specified in writing by the Minister, remain at a notified address for the holder for those days.
(2)If the Minister specifies other times for the purposes of subclause (1), the times must not be more than 8 hours apart.
(3)In this clause:
notified address for a holder for a particular day or days means any of the following:
(a)either:
(i)the address notified by the holder under condition 8513; or
(ii)if the holder has notified another address under condition 8625—the last address so notified by the holder;

(b)an address at which the holder stays regularly because of a close personal relationship with a person at that address, and which the holder has notified to Immigration for the purposes of this paragraph;

(c)if, for the purposes of this paragraph, the holder notifies Immigration of an address for that day or those days no later than 12 pm on the day before that day or the earliest day of those days (as the case may be)—that address.
Note:Under regulation 2.25AF, a visa is taken to not be subject to this condition during any period in which the visa holder is:
(a)under arrest or detained in custody; or
(b)admitted as an inpatient to receive treatment at a public or private hospital, registered mental health facility or other registered medical facility.

conditions.title_ko: 전자 위치추적 장치 상시 착용 및 관리 의무 (070 BVR)
conditions.title_en: Wear & Maintain Electronic Monitoring Device at All Times (070 BVR)
conditions.summary_ko: 전자 위치추적 장치(발목 전자장치 등)를 항상 착용하고, 담당 직원의 장착·수리·제거에 협조하며, 정상 작동(충전 등)을 유지하고 고장 시 즉시 알려야 합니다.
conditions.summary_en: Wear an electronic monitoring device at all times, permit fitting/maintenance/removal by authorised officers, keep it in working order, and report faults as soon as practicable.
forbidden_ko: 장치 임의 훼손·제거, 충전·관리 소홀, 고장 인지 후 미신고
forbidden_en: Removing/tampering with the device, obstructing officers, failing to keep it charged/working, or delaying fault reports
obligations_ko: (1)-(4) 장치 상시 착용, 담당관 점검·장착 협조, 정상 작동 유지 및 이상 발견 즉시 통보
obligations_en: Wear at all times (1), allow officer servicing (2), keep working (3), and report malfunctions promptly (4)
exceptions_ko: Note(reg 2.25AF): 체포·구금 중 또는 병원·정신건강시설 입원 치료 중에는 적용 정지
exceptions_en: reg 2.25AF suspends the condition during arrest/custody or hospital inpatient admission.

clause_notes_en.text: Covers both the worn device and related monitoring equipment.

conditions.drift_ko: 8620과 함께 이민성 웹 conditions-list API에 누락돼 있으나 현행 Schedule 8에 살아있는 법정 조건입니다.
conditions.drift_en: Missing from Home Affairs' online conditions-list API despite being active in Schedule 8.
conditions.statutory_text:
8621(1)The holder must wear a monitoring device at all times.
(2)The holder must allow an authorised officer to fit, install, repair or remove the following:
(a) the holder’s monitoring device;
(b)any related monitoring equipment for the holder’s monitoring device.
(3)The holder must take any steps specified in writing by the Minister, and any other reasonable steps, to ensure that the following remain in good working order:
(a) the holder’s monitoring device;
(b)any related monitoring equipment for the holder’s monitoring device.
(4)If the holder becomes aware that either of the following is not in good working order:
(a)the holder’s monitoring device;
(b)any related monitoring equipment for the holder’s monitoring device;
the holder must notify an authorised officer of that as soon as practicable.
(5)In this clause:
monitoring device means any electronic device capable of being used to determine or monitor the location of a person or an object or the status of an object.
related monitoring equipment, for a monitoring device, means any electronic equipment necessary for operating the monitoring device.
Note:Under regulation 2.25AF, a visa is taken to not be subject to this condition during any period in which the visa holder is:
(a)under arrest or detained in custody; or
(b)admitted as an inpatient to receive treatment at a public or private hospital, registered mental health facility or other registered medical facility.

(b)admitted as an inpatient to receive treatment at a public or private hospital, registered mental health facility or other registered medical facility.

conditions.title_ko: 미성년자·취약계층과 우연적 수준 초과 접촉 업무·정기활동 금지 (유·무급 불문)
conditions.title_en: No Work or Regular Organised Activity With Minors/Vulnerable Persons
conditions.summary_ko: 보수 유무나 WWCC(아동근무확인) 필요 여부와 상관없이 미성년자 또는 취약계층과 우연적 수준(incidental contact)을 넘어 접촉하는 일이나 정기 단체활동을 할 수 없습니다(070 BVR).
conditions.summary_en: Prohibits any work or regular organised activity involving more than incidental contact with minors or vulnerable persons, whether paid or unpaid and regardless of whether a working-with-children check applies.
forbidden_ko: (1)-(2) 보육·학교·장애인·노인복지·청소년 스포츠 코치 등 유·무급 직무 및 정기 모임 참여
forbidden_en: Any paid or unpaid work or regular organised activity with more than incidental contact with minors/vulnerable people
obligations_ko: 미성년·취약계층 대면 접촉 직종 및 정기 활동 완전 배제
obligations_en: Avoid all roles or organised activities involving contact with children or vulnerable persons
exceptions_ko: 일상생활 중 우연한(incidental) 마주침
exceptions_en: Purely incidental everyday contact.
conditions.waiver_ko: 구 8613을 대체해 070 BVR에 직접 규정된 조항입니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Current Subclass 070 statutory replacement for legacy 8613.

clause_notes_ko.text: 자원봉사('or otherwise') 및 WWCC 불필요 활동까지 포괄 차단합니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Applies whether paid or unpaid and regardless of WWCC requirements.

conditions.statutory_text:
8622(1)The holder must not perform any work, or participate in any regular organised activity, involving more than incidental contact with a minor or vulnerable person (within the meaning of Part 070 of Schedule 2).
(2)Subclause (1) applies:
(a)whether the work or activity is for reward or otherwise; and
(b)whether or not a working with children or vulnerable people check (however described) is required in relation to the work.
statutory_paragraphs: 8622(1)The holder must not perform any work, or participate in any regular organised activity, involving more than incidental contact with a minor or vulnerable person (within the meaning of Part 070 of Schedule 2).
(2)Subclause (1) applies:
(a)whether the work or activity is for reward or otherwise; and
(b)whether or not a working with children or vulnerable people check (however described) is required in relation to the work.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8622 - No work involving contact with a minor or vulnerable person
conditions.dha_web_summary:
You must not perform any work, or participate in any regular organised activity involving more than incidental contact with a child or vulnerable person.​
This applies whether or not you receive money for the work.

conditions.title_ko: 학교·차일드케어·데이케어 센터 반경 50미터 이내 접근 금지 (070 BVR)
conditions.title_en: Must Not Go Within 50 Metres of School or Childcare Centre
conditions.summary_ko: 학교(school), 차일드케어 센터, 데이케어 센터 부지로부터 50미터 이내 거리로 접근해서는 안 됩니다.
conditions.summary_en: You must not go within 50 metres of a school, childcare centre, or day care centre.
forbidden_ko: 학교·보육시설 경계 50m 반경 내 출입·체류
forbidden_en: Entering within a 50-metre radius of any school, childcare, or day care centre
obligations_ko: 이동 동선·거주지 선정 시 학교·어린이집 반경 50m 이상 이격 유지
obligations_en: Keep at least 50 metres clear of all schools and childcare facilities
exceptions_ko: 조문상 예외 문구 없음
exceptions_en: No statutory carve-out in the text of 8623.
conditions.waiver_ko: 070 BVR 보호 대상자 분리 조건입니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Strict exclusion zone on applicable 070 BVR grants.

clause_notes_ko.text: 단순 1문장이지만 동선과 대중교통 정류장 위치까지 주의가 필요한 엄격한 거리 제한입니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Strict 50m proximity ban.

statutory_paragraphs: 8623The holder must not go within 50 metres of a school, childcare centre or day care centre.

conditions.title_ko: 범죄 피해자 및 피해자 가족 접촉·접촉 시도 금지 (070 BVR)
conditions.title_en: No Contact With Offence Victim or Victim's Family
conditions.summary_ko: 관련 범죄의 피해자 또는 피해자의 가족(배우자·사실혼·부모·후견인·자녀·형제자매 포함)에게 연락·접촉하거나 접촉을 시도해서는 안 됩니다.
conditions.summary_en: You must not contact, or attempt to contact, the victim of the offence or any member of the victim's family.
forbidden_ko: (1)-(2) 피해자 본인 및 배우자·부모·후견인·자녀·형제자매에 대한 직·간접 연락 및 접근 시도
forbidden_en: Contacting or attempting to contact the victim or their spouse/partner, parent/guardian, child, or sibling
obligations_ko: 피해자 및 가족 일체에 대한 일체의 연락·접촉 차단
obligations_en: Maintain zero direct or indirect contact
exceptions_ko: 없음
exceptions_en: None.
conditions.waiver_ko: 070 BVR 피해자 보호 조건입니다.
conditions.waiver_en: Victim-protection condition on Subclass 070 BVR.

clause_notes_ko.text: 실제 접촉뿐 아니라 '접촉 시도(attempt to contact)'(SNS·제3자 전달 포함)도 금지합니다.

clause_notes_en.text: Prohibits both actual contact and attempted contact.

statutory_paragraphs: 8624(1)The holder must not contact, or attempt to contact, the victim of the offence or a member of the victim’s family.
(2)In this clause:
member of the victim’s family includes, without limitation, each of the following:
(a)a spouse or de facto partner of the victim;
(b)a parent or guardian of the victim;
(c)a child of the victim;
(d)a sibling of the victim.
conditions.dha_web_title: 8624 - Do not contact the victim
conditions.dha_web_summary: You must not contact or attempt to contact the victim of the offence or a member of the victim's family. ​

conditions.title_ko: 성명·주소·전화·이메일 변경 후 2영업일 이내 장관 신고 (070 BVR)

conditions.summary_en: Notify the Minister of any change to your name, address, phone number, or email address within 2 working days after the change occurs.
forbidden_ko: 연락처·주소 변경 후 2영업일 초과 미신고

obligations_ko: (a) 이름, (b) 주소, (c) 전화, (d) 이메일 변경 후 2영업일 내 통지
obligations_en: Report changes to (a)–(d) within 2 working days
exceptions_ko: 없음
exceptions_en: None.

conditions.title_ko: 온라인 프로필·사용자명(아이디) 변경 후 2영업일 이내 장관 신고 (070 BVR)
conditions.title_en: Notify Online Profile or Username Changes Within 2 Working Days (070 BVR)

clause_notes_en.text: Pairs with 8625 on Subclass 070 BVR.

statutory_paragraphs: 8626The holder must notify the Minister of any change in the following:

Understanding your work rights
The Department is working with the Fair Work Ombudsman to help employees and employers understand and follow Australian Workplace laws.
Information on pay rates, shift calculations, leave arrangements and notice and redundancy entitlements is in the
Pay and Conditions Tool (PACT).
The Fair Work Ombudsman website has more information on workplace rights and entitlements for
visa holders and migrant workers.
For the full list of conditions relevant to your visa, see the Federal Register of Legislation.
